For developers parsing install results: when using automated scripts with `claude plugin install --json` to install plugins, it used to be hard to tell from the output whether a plugin's own install command ran into trouble.

The returned output now indicates whether the install command wrote to stderr, and whether it exited with an error, was killed, or timed out. ⟦A delivery receipt with "delivery timed out" and "box opened" fields added lets you tell what happened from the slip alone without opening the package.⟧

items.original: Added `commandPrinted` to `claude plugin install --json` results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and `commandFailed` when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器 /metrics 補上派工耗時與輪詢修正
title.en: Self-hosted runner /metrics adds dispatch timing and fixes poll age

body.zh-TW:
給負責監控自架執行器的維運人員：`/metrics` 端點新增了兩項計時指標，方便追蹤派工後的等待時間，也順帶修好一項容易誤導的舊數值。

由協調器啟動的執行器現在會記錄從發出工單到註冊完成的秒數；為特定工作階段啟動的執行器，則會記錄從工單發出到接手第一個工作階段的秒數。另外，從未成功輪詢時，距上次成功輪詢的秒數過去會誤顯示為 0，這個問題已修好。
body.en:
For operators monitoring self-hosted runners: the `/metrics` endpoint now includes two timing metrics to track wait times after dispatch, along with a fix for a misleading legacy value.

Runners spawned by an orchestrator now record the seconds from work order issuance to registration completion, while runners started for a specific session record the seconds from work order issuance to taking over their first session. Also, the seconds since the last successful poll previously misreported as 0 when a runner had never polled successfully, and that issue is now fixed.

items.original:
Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_registered_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order issued to registration accepted, on orchestrator-spawned runners
Added `claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds` to the self-hosted runner's `/metrics`: seconds from work order to first session handed over, on runners started for a session
Fixed the self-hosted runner's `last_poll_age_seconds` reading 0 while the runner had never polled successfully

title.zh-TW: 長對話壓縮與網頁抓取不再卡住數分鐘
title.en: Long conversation compaction and WebFetch no longer freeze for minutes

body.zh-TW:
跑完一整段長對話或剛喚醒電腦，終端機有時會突然動彈不得好幾分鐘，這批問題現在都修好了。

壓縮過長的對話紀錄後，Claude Code 不會再緊接著凍結好幾分鐘。

用 WebFetch 抓取某些網頁時，工作階段不會再卡住數分鐘，也不會莫名回傳空白結果。

在 Linux 與 WSL 上休眠兩分鐘以上再送出第一句提問時，不會再對已經斷掉的連線傻等三分鐘。
body.en:
Cases where the terminal suddenly froze for several minutes after a long conversation or waking your computer are now fixed.

After compacting an overly long conversation history, Claude Code no longer freezes for several minutes immediately afterward.

Fetching certain pages with WebFetch no longer stalls the session for minutes or unexpectedly returns an empty result.

On Linux and WSL, sending the first prompt after sleeping for two minutes or more no longer waits three minutes on a connection that has already died.

items.original:
Fixed Claude Code freezing for up to several minutes right after compacting a very long conversation
Fixed WebFetch freezing the session for minutes on some pages, and returning an empty result for some others
Fixed the first prompt after a sleep of two minutes or more waiting three minutes on a connection that had died, on Linux and WSL

title.zh-TW: ExitWorktree 不再誤刪其他工作階段的副本
title.en: ExitWorktree no longer deletes another session's copy

body.zh-TW: 平行開好幾個終端機跑任務，以前退出時有時會誤刪別處正在用的工作區。現在執行 `ExitWorktree` 或從退出對話框離開，不會再誤刪其他工作階段正使用的 worktree（工作樹，Git 平行開多份專案副本的功能）。
body.en: When running tasks across several terminals in parallel, exiting used to occasionally delete a workspace still in use elsewhere. Running `ExitWorktree` or leaving from the exit dialog no longer deletes a worktree (a Git feature for keeping parallel copies of a project) that another session is actively using.

items.original: Fixed `ExitWorktree` and the worktree exit dialog deleting a worktree that another running Claude Code session was working in

title.zh-TW: 並行存檔與磁碟滿時的備份問題修正
title.en: Fixes for concurrent saves and full-disk backups

body.zh-TW:
同時開著多個視窗或指令操作，本地紀錄與備份不再互相踩掉。

好幾個 Claude Code 行程同時儲存使用者設定時，改動不會再莫名遺失。

同時執行多道 `claude plugin` 指令時，已安裝清單裡的外掛不會再不見。

多筆任務更新同時寫入時，任務之間的相依關係與中繼資料不會再丟失。

硬碟空間滿了的時候，`~/.claude.json` 不完整的備份不會再被保留下來，也不會把原本完好的舊備份擠掉。
body.en:
Running multiple windows or commands at the same time no longer causes local records and backups to overwrite one another.

When several Claude Code processes save user settings simultaneously, changes are no longer lost.

Running multiple `claude plugin` commands at the same time no longer causes plugins to vanish from the installed list.

When multiple task updates are written at the same time, task dependencies and metadata are no longer lost.

When the disk is full, incomplete backups of `~/.claude.json` are no longer kept or allowed to displace intact older backups.

items.original:
Fixed changes to user settings being lost when several Claude Code processes saved them at the same time
Fixed plugins going missing from the installed list when several `claude plugin` commands ran at the same time
Fixed task dependencies and metadata being lost when several task updates ran at the same time
Fixed incomplete backups of `~/.claude.json` being kept, and displacing good ones, when the disk was full

title.zh-TW: 接續對話與 claude -p 寫檔失敗處理更可靠
title.en: More reliable session resuming and claude -p write-failure handling

body.zh-TW:
拿指令接續上次進度或寫自動化管線，遇到異常狀況不再無聲失敗或開出空白對話。

最後一筆儲存訊息的時間戳缺漏或無效時，`--continue` 與 `--resume` 不會再開出空的工作階段或直接失敗。

透過 `claude -p --continue` 執行時，SessionStart 掛鉤寫入的環境變數不再遺失。

把 `claude -p` 的輸出寫入滿載磁碟的檔案時，現在會印出錯誤並回傳狀態碼 1，不再默默以狀態碼 0 結束；不過若遇到已滿的 NFS 遠端掛載目錄，仍可能偵測不到。
body.en:
When you use commands to pick up where you left off or build automation pipelines, unexpected conditions no longer cause silent failures or blank sessions.

When the last saved message has a missing or invalid timestamp, `--continue` and `--resume` no longer open an empty session or fail outright.

When running via `claude -p --continue`, environment variables written by a SessionStart hook are no longer lost.

When writing `claude -p` output to a file on a full disk, it now prints an error and exits with status code 1 instead of silently exiting with status code 0; however, a full remote NFS mount may still go undetected.

items.original:
Fixed `--continue` and `--resume` opening an empty session or failing when the last saved message had a missing or invalid timestamp
Fixed environment variables written by a SessionStart hook being lost with `claude -p --continue`
Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 with no message when its output went to a file on a full disk: it now prints an error and exits 1, though a full NFS export may go unnoticed

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具結構與子代理共用連線等問題修正
title.en: Fixes for MCP tool schemas and shared subagent connections

body.zh-TW:
工作階段同時掛載多個 MCP 工具或子代理，先前常碰到的異常報錯與連線中斷問題現在都有解了。

當許多 MCP 工具帶著會被 API 拒絕的輸入結構時，對話回合不會再因「JSON schema is invalid」失敗，工作階段檔案也不會膨脹好幾 MB。

子代理各自宣告使用同一個 MCP 伺服器時，其中一個結束不會再把伺服器關掉，其他子代理與主工作階段仍可繼續用。

企業允許或拒絕清單排除了內建畫圖工具 `easel` 時，它仍會維持封鎖。不過每次啟動時，不會再跳出「MCP server blocked by enterprise policy: easel」的警告。
body.en:
Unexpected errors and dropped connections when a session loads multiple MCP tools or subagents at once are now resolved.

When many MCP tools carry input schemas that the API rejects, turns no longer fail with "JSON schema is invalid", and session files no longer bloat by several megabytes.

When subagents each declare the same MCP server, one finishing no longer shuts the server down, so other subagents and the main session can keep using it.

When an enterprise allowlist or denylist excludes the built-in chart tool `easel`, it still stays blocked. However, the "MCP server blocked by enterprise policy: easel" warning no longer appears at every startup.

items.original:
Fixed turns failing with "JSON schema is invalid", and session files growing by many megabytes, when many MCP tools have an input schema that the API refuses
Fixed an MCP server that subagents declare being shut down when one of them finished, while other subagents or the session were still using it
Fixed an "MCP server blocked by enterprise policy: easel" warning showing at every start when an MCP allowlist or denylist excludes the built-in chart tool, which stays blocked

title.zh-TW: Linux 大型忽略資料夾不再拖慢 Bash 指令
title.en: Large ignored folders on Linux no longer slow down Bash commands

body.zh-TW: 讀取較慢的程式碼庫如果塞了像 `node_modules` 這類龐大的排除目錄，跑命令時常得乾等好幾秒。在 Linux 上這還會讓該工作階段後續完全不顯示檔案差異，現在這個問題已經修好。
body.en: In slower repositories packed with large ignored directories like `node_modules`, running commands often meant waiting for seconds. On Linux, this also stopped file diffs from showing for the rest of the session, and that issue is now fixed.

items.original: Linux: Fixed Bash commands waiting seconds and showing no file diff for the rest of a session in slow repositories with large ignored folders such as `node_modules`

title.zh-TW: Windows 搜尋與 Bash 加速，磁碟錯誤說清楚
title.en: Faster Windows search and Bash, plus clearer drive errors

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 電腦開工作階段搜尋或跑指令，現在順手許多，碰到無法驗證的磁碟機也不會只看到一頭霧水的錯誤。

沒有自訂啟動檔的電腦上，若 Git Bash 啟動花上 10 到 60 秒，同一工作階段剩下的 Bash 指令不會再跟著變慢。

Grep 與 Glob 搜尋本機路徑時，內建 ripgrep 不再每次都另開主控台，速度因此加快。

工作階段資料夾位在無法驗證的磁碟機上時，錯誤訊息現在會說明原因，並告訴你重試有沒有幫助。
body.en:
Running searches or commands in a Windows session is now much smoother, and hitting an unverifiable drive no longer leaves you with a confusing error.

On machines without custom startup files, if Git Bash takes 10 to 60 seconds to start, the remaining Bash commands in the same session no longer slow down along with it.

When Grep and Glob search local paths, the built-in ripgrep no longer opens a separate console each time, making searches faster.

When a session folder sits on a drive that cannot be verified, the error message now explains why and tells you whether retrying can help.

items.original:
Windows: Fixed Bash commands running slower for the rest of a session after Git Bash took 10 to 60 seconds to start, on machines with no custom start-up files
Windows: Improved Grep and Glob speed by no longer starting a console host for each built-in ripgrep search on a local path
Windows: Improved the error when a session's folder is on a drive Claude Code can't verify: it says why, and whether retrying can help

title.zh-TW: 檔案復原與權限附註、打字內容不再弄丟
title.en: File rewinds, permission notes, and typed text stay intact

body.zh-TW:
剛改完檔案、在批准視窗補充說明或正專心打字，手邊的紀錄與文字現在都能好好留著。

修改檔案的回合剛結束，兩筆排隊提問或疊加技能接著一起執行時，`/rewind` 不會再誤還原成更早的版本。

批准權限提示時順手附上的文字與圖片，即使核准後的指令或工具接著失敗，附帶內容也不會被丟掉。

在全螢幕模式下收到規劃內容時，你原本打到一半還沒送出的後半段文字會完整保留。
body.en:
Whether you just edited a file, added notes in an approval prompt, or were in the middle of typing, your history and text now stay safely preserved.

Right after a turn that modified a file, when two queued prompts or stacked skills run together, `/rewind` no longer mistakenly restores an earlier version.

Text and images attached when approving a permission prompt are no longer dropped even if the approved command or tool subsequently fails.

When a plan arrives in fullscreen mode, the rest of the text you were halfway through typing and had not sent yet is preserved in full.

items.original:
Fixed `/rewind` sometimes restoring an older version of a file when two queued prompts, or stacked skills, ran together right after a turn that changed it
Fixed text and images added when approving a permission prompt being dropped when the approved command or tool then failed
Fixed the rest of what you were typing being lost when a plan arrived in fullscreen mode

title.zh-TW: claude.ai 連結器在提及與移除檢查的修復
title.en: Fixes for claude.ai connector mentions, removal, and checks

body.zh-TW:
在終端機裡搭配 claude.ai 連結器工作，以前容易在提及資源、共用網址或檢查連線時卡關。

在終端機輸入框用 `@` 提及來自 claude.ai 連結器與外掛伺服器的 MCP 資源時，資源現在會正常附加上去。

兩個名稱不同的 claude.ai 連結器就算共用同一個伺服器網址，也不會再被漏掉。

在 `/mcp` 檢查「Connect on claude.ai」時，只要 claude.ai 已有對應伺服器網址但少了查詢參數的連結器，不會再誤報未連線。

用 `claude mcp remove` 移除 claude.ai 連結器時，現在會明確提示改到 `/mcp` 關閉或到 claude.ai 上刪除。
body.en:
Working with claude.ai connectors in the terminal used to hit snags when mentioning resources, sharing URLs, or checking connections.

When you `@`-mention MCP resources from claude.ai connectors and plugin servers in the terminal prompt box, those resources are now attached properly.

Two claude.ai connectors with different names are no longer dropped even when they share the same server URL.

During the "Connect on claude.ai" check in `/mcp`, as long as claude.ai has a connector at the matching server URL without its query parameters, it no longer falsely reports as not connected.

When removing a claude.ai connector with `claude mcp remove`, it now clearly tells you to turn it off in `/mcp` or delete it on claude.ai instead.

items.original:
Fixed MCP resources from claude.ai connectors and plugin servers not being attached when @-mentioned in the terminal's prompt box
Fixed claude.ai connectors with different names being dropped when they share a server URL (anthropics/claude-code#101856)
Fixed `claude mcp remove` giving no way forward for a claude.ai connector: it now says to turn it off in /mcp or remove it on claude.ai
Fixed the /mcp "Connect on claude.ai" check saying "not connected" when claude.ai has a connector at the server's URL without its query

title.zh-TW: Chrome 短暫斷線後會正常恢復連線狀態
title.en: Chrome restores connection status after brief disconnects

body.zh-TW: 瀏覽器明明開著也已經登入，過去只要出現短暫的連線問題，Claude in Chrome 就會一直停在「not connected」狀態。這個問題已經修好，不會再卡在未連線畫面。
body.en: Even when your browser was open and signed in, a brief connection issue used to leave Claude in Chrome stuck in the "not connected" state. That issue is now fixed, so it no longer gets stuck on the disconnected screen.

items.original: Fixed Claude in Chrome staying "not connected" after a brief connection problem, even though Chrome was open and signed in

title.zh-TW: 切換或指定模型後，系統提示與備援不再跑錯
title.en: System prompts and fallbacks stay aligned after model switches

body.zh-TW:
不管是在啟動時鎖定模型、對話途中切換，或開出多層子代理，模型指令與備援現在會跟著對齊。

在 Amazon Bedrock Mantle 未選模型直接開啟終端機工作階段時，不會再忽略已鎖定的 Opus 模型，宣布切換備援後也不會繼續呼叫不可用的預設模型。

在 `/context` 之後、送出第一則訊息前更換模型，系統提示不會再留著舊模型的指示。

在回合中途換模型時，Claude 偶爾會對提交署名提醒回話而提早結束回合，這情況已修好；不過若由組織管理設定強制加上拉取請求署名行，仍可能發生。

在 `opusplan` 或 `haiku` 的計畫模式下，子代理再開出的下層代理與分岔不會再錯用計畫模式模型。
body.en:
Whether you pin a model at startup, switch mid-conversation, or spin up nested subagents, model instructions and fallbacks now stay aligned.

When starting a terminal session on Amazon Bedrock Mantle with no model selected, a pinned Opus model is no longer ignored, and it no longer keeps calling an unavailable default model after announcing a fallback.

When you switch models after `/context` and before sending the first message, the system prompt no longer keeps the old model's instructions.

When switching models mid-turn, Claude occasionally replied to its commit attribution reminder and ended the turn early, which is now fixed; however, this can still happen if managed organization settings enforce a pull request attribution line.

In plan mode under `opusplan` or `haiku`, subagents and forks spawned by a subagent no longer mistakenly run on the plan-mode model.

items.original:
Fixed terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock (Mantle) started with no model selected ignoring a pinned Opus model, and still calling an unavailable default model after announcing a fallback
Fixed the system prompt keeping the earlier model's instructions when the model was changed after `/context` but before the first message
Fixed Claude sometimes replying to its commit attribution reminder and ending the turn early after the model changed mid-turn; it can still happen where managed settings set the PR attribution line
Fixed a subagent's own subagents and forks running on the plan-mode model in plan mode under `opusplan` or `haiku`

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 減少卡頓，補上圖片檢視指引
title.en: Less freezing in Code Mode, plus image viewing guidance

body.zh-TW:
在 Code Mode 跑長腳本或處理大量檔案，畫面卡住與誤會報錯的情況少了許多。

有路徑範圍規則或讀取拒絕規則的專案裡，腳本一次讀完數百個檔案後不再停頓好一陣子。

子代理的腳本呼叫數千次工具後，終端機卡住的時間變短許多。

按下 `Esc` 中斷後，被停下的指令下方會顯示「Interrupted」，不再出現一片紅字錯誤。現在 Claude 在這個模式下也知道怎麼檢視圖片和 PDF 了。
body.en:
Running long scripts or handling large batches of files in Code Mode now comes with far fewer screen freezes and misleading errors.

In projects with path-scoped rules or Read deny rules, scripts no longer pause for a long stretch after reading hundreds of files at once.

After a subagent's script makes thousands of tool calls, the terminal freezes for far less time.

After pressing `Esc` to interrupt, "Interrupted" now appears under the stopped command instead of a wall of red error text. Claude now also knows how to view images and PDFs in this mode.

items.original:
Fixed a long pause in Code Mode after code that read hundreds of files in projects with path-scoped rules or Read deny rules
Improved Code Mode: Claude is now told how to look at images and PDFs
Improved Code Mode: after Esc, "Interrupted" now shows under the stopped command in place of a red error
Improved Code Mode: the terminal freezes for far less time after a subagent's script makes thousands of tool calls

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 圖表工具與快取還原問題修復
title.en: Fixes for Code Mode chart tool and cache restoration

body.zh-TW:
在 Code Mode 搭配工具、自動模式或壓縮對話使用，幾個狀態與資源追蹤的錯誤已經修好。

Claude 在此模式呼叫內建圖表工具不會再失敗；在自動模式與略過權限模式下，腳本裡的 MCP 工具要求結束回合時也會正常生效。

在自動模式下，腳本載入技能後若有模組附加註記，先前的思考與提示詞快取（cache，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）不會再被清掉重寫。

按下 `Esc` 與執行 `/compact` 後，腳本讀過的檔案會正確還原；在 Claude 首次回覆前查 `/context`，系統工具數量也不再少算。
body.en:
Several state and resource tracking bugs when using Code Mode with tools, auto mode, or compacted conversations are now fixed.

Calling the built-in chart tool in this mode no longer fails; in auto mode and bypass permissions mode, an MCP tool's request from a script to end the turn now takes effect properly.

In auto mode, if a mod adds a note after a script loads a skill, earlier thinking and the prompt cache are no longer cleared and rewritten.

After pressing `Esc` and running `/compact`, files read by a script are restored properly; checking `/context` before Claude's first reply no longer undercounts system tools.

items.original:
Fixed the built-in chart tool failing when Claude called it in Code Mode
Fixed Code Mode ignoring an MCP tool's request to end the turn from a script in auto and bypass permissions modes
Fixed Code Mode in auto mode dropping earlier thinking and rewriting the prompt cache when a mod added a note after a script loaded a skill
Fixed Code Mode not restoring a file that a script had read after Esc and `/compact`
Fixed `/context` undercounting system tools in Code Mode before Claude's first reply

title.zh-TW: 背景子代理停止與 MCP 任務追蹤問題修復
title.en: Background Subagent Stop and MCP Task Tracking Fixes

body.zh-TW:
把任務或代理丟到背景繼續跑，停止訊號與權限狀態現在能正確跟上。

被停掉的背景子代理不會再自己跑回來；在應用程式或 SDK 啟動的工作階段裡，就算代理剛好快完成才被停止，Claude 也不會再繼續傻等它。

背景工作階段在核准計畫後重新喚醒時，不會再退回先前的權限模式。

把工作階段切到背景時，正在跑的 MCP 任務不會再被誤報成已停止，背景工作階段也能接著追蹤任務進度；但若該伺服器使用標準輸入輸出或自訂標頭，則不支援。
body.en:
When you send tasks or agents to run in the background, stop signals and permission states now stay in sync.

Stopped background subagents no longer start back up on their own. In sessions started by an app or the SDK, Claude no longer keeps waiting for a background agent that was stopped just as it finished.

Background sessions no longer fall back to their previous permission mode when waking up after approving a plan.

When you move a session to the background, a running MCP task is no longer falsely reported as stopped, and the background session can continue following its progress, except when the server uses stdio or sets custom headers.

items.original:
Fixed a stopped background subagent sometimes not staying stopped
Fixed Claude still waiting for a background agent that was stopped just as it finished, in sessions run by an app or the SDK
Fixed background sessions sometimes waking in their previous permission mode after approving a plan
Fixed a running MCP task being reported as stopped when you move a session to the background; the background session can now follow the task, but not if its server uses stdio or sets headers

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制的終端機紀錄與手機狀態顯示更準確
title.en: More Accurate Terminal Logs and Mobile Status for Remote Control

body.zh-TW:
在手機或網頁跟電腦終端機兩邊切換著看同一場對話，畫面上的提示與按鈕狀態現在對得起來。

從手機或網頁按下停止來結束背景代理時，終端機上出現的紀錄通知不會再偽裝成是你自己打字送出的訊息。

在對話進行到一半才開啟遠端控制時，手機應用程式不會再把 Diff 與拉取請求按鈕藏起來，也不會把早已停止的工作階段顯示成正在運作。
body.en:
When switching between your phone or the web and your computer's terminal in the same conversation, on-screen prompts and button states now match up.

When you tap Stop from a phone or the web to end a background agent, the log note shown in the terminal no longer looks as if you typed and sent it yourself.

When you turn on Remote Control mid-conversation, the mobile apps no longer hide the Diff and pull request buttons, or show an already stopped session as working.

items.original:
Remote Control: Fixed the note about background agents ended by a Stop from a phone or the web showing in the terminal as if you had typed it
Remote Control: Fixed the mobile apps hiding the Diff and pull request buttons, or showing a stopped session as working, after turning it on mid-conversation

title.zh-TW: 語言伺服器卡住時 Esc 可中斷，啟動中也不撞車
title.en: Esc Cancels Stalled Language Server Calls; Startup Failures Also Fixed

body.zh-TW:
編輯程式碼依靠的語言伺服器反應慢半拍或正在啟動，現在不用整段乾等或直接報錯。

當 LSP 工具呼叫卡在遲遲不回的語言伺服器時，按下 `Esc` 就能直接中斷等待。另外，語言伺服器還在啟動期間同時湧入多筆呼叫與編輯時，工具呼叫與診斷資訊也不會再跟著失敗。
body.en:
When the language server you rely on for editing is slow to respond or still starting up, you no longer have to wait indefinitely or hit immediate errors.

When an LSP tool call hangs on an unresponsive language server, pressing `Esc` immediately cancels the wait. In addition, when multiple calls and edits arrive while a language server is still starting, tool calls and diagnostics no longer fail together.

items.original:
Fixed Esc not ending an LSP tool call that was waiting for a slow or stuck language server
Fixed LSP tool calls and diagnostics failing when several calls or edits arrived while a language server was still starting

title.zh-TW: /mcp 與 /plugin 分類與重連錯誤顯示優化
title.en: Better Grouping and Reconnect Error Display in /mcp and /plugin

body.zh-TW:
打開 `/mcp` 或 `/plugin` 整理外掛與外部工具伺服器，找來源跟查錯都省事多了。

`/mcp` 不再把外掛伺服器全都算成內建。外掛帶來的會列在「Plugin MCPs」底下，`--mcp-config` 與內建伺服器歸在「Other MCPs」，個別頁面也會標明所屬外掛。

在 `/mcp` 與 `/plugin` 按下重連後，若伺服器依然失敗或需要登入，頁面會停在原處直接秀出原因。全螢幕開啟 `/plugin` 時，有錯誤的外掛頁面一開始就會先顯示錯誤內容。
body.en:
Opening `/mcp` or `/plugin` to manage plugins and external tool servers now makes finding sources and checking errors much easier.

`/mcp` no longer lists all plugin servers as built-in. Those provided by plugins appear under "Plugin MCPs", `--mcp-config` and built-in servers go under "Other MCPs", and each server's page names its plugin.

After clicking Reconnect in `/mcp` and `/plugin`, if a server still fails or requires sign-in, the page stays open and shows the cause right away. When opening `/plugin` in fullscreen mode, a plugin page with errors now starts by showing those errors.

items.original:
Fixed `/mcp` listing plugin servers as built-in: they now stand under "Plugin MCPs", `--mcp-config` and built-in servers under "Other MCPs", and a server's page names its plugin
Improved Reconnect in `/mcp` and `/plugin`: a server's page now stays open, with the cause in view, when the server still fails or needs sign-in
Improved `/plugin` in fullscreen mode: the page of a plugin with errors now starts with those errors

title.zh-TW: /config 與 /resume 等指令顯示與搜尋優化
title.en: Improved Display and Search for /config, /resume, and /stats

body.zh-TW:
平常切換設定、翻舊紀錄或看使用統計，幾個不順手的小毛病都整理好了。

在 `/config` 搜尋設定時，開頭符合輸入字的項目大多會排在最前面，打「effort」能找到 Model，打「dark」或「light」能找到 Theme。在 24 列高的全螢幕視窗裡，專案指示選擇器也會完整秀出全部四個選項，不再只剩一個。

打開 `/resume` 清單時，那些你只開了 `/model` 之類畫面就離開的空工作階段不會再混在裡面。

`/stats` 統計新活動時改以你所在的本地時區計算天數，不再用 UTC 時區切日。
body.en:
Several minor friction points when toggling settings, browsing past sessions, or checking usage stats have been cleaned up.

When searching settings in `/config`, most items whose names start with what you type appear first; typing "effort" finds Model, and typing "dark" or "light" finds Theme. In a 24-row fullscreen window, the Project instructions picker now displays all four choices instead of only one.

When opening the `/resume` list, empty sessions where you only opened a screen such as `/model` and left are no longer mixed in.

`/stats` now counts days for new activity in your local time zone instead of splitting days by UTC.

items.original:
Fixed `/stats` counting new activity in UTC days instead of your local time zone
Fixed the Project instructions picker in `/config` showing only one of its four choices in a 24-row fullscreen window
Improved `/config` search: most settings whose name starts with what you type come first, "effort" finds Model, and "dark" or "light" finds Theme
Improved `/resume`: sessions where you only opened a screen such as `/model` and left are no longer listed

title.zh-TW: /ultrareview 切錯資料夾會喊停，額度不足先提醒
title.en: /ultrareview Stops on Wrong Folder and Warns on Low Spend Limit

body.zh-TW:
執行 `/ultrareview` 做深度審查前，現在會幫你把目標專案跟花費額度兩邊都顧好。

要是終端機的殼層已經切進另一個程式碼庫，`/ultrareview` 不會再審錯程式碼或莫名失敗，而是直接停下來並報出兩邊的資料夾名稱。在 Team 與 Enterprise 方案上，如果本月剩餘花費上限低於一次審查的常見費用，費用確認視窗也會清楚告訴你還剩多少額度。⟦好比送洗衣服前店員不只再三核對單號，還會先提醒儲值卡餘額快不夠付這趟洗衣費。⟧
body.en:
Before running `/ultrareview` for a deep review, both your target project and spending budget are now checked upfront.

If your terminal shell has moved into another repository, `/ultrareview` no longer reviews the wrong code or fails inexplicably; instead, it stops and names both folders. On Team and Enterprise plans, if your remaining monthly spend limit is less than what a review usually costs, the cost confirmation dialog also clearly tells you how much limit is left. ⟦Before taking in your laundry, the clerk double-checks the ticket number and warns you if your prepaid card balance is running too low to cover the wash.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/ultrareview` failing or reviewing the wrong code after the shell moved into another repository: it now stops and names both folders
Improved `/ultrareview`'s cost confirmation on Team and Enterprise plans: it now says how much of your monthly spend limit is left when that is less than a review usually costs

title.zh-TW: Grep 與 Read 等檔案讀取和格式錯誤修復
title.en: Grep, Read, and File Format Parsing Fixes

body.zh-TW:
拿工具搜尋文字或讀取文件，幾種特定格式造成的誤判與漏字都修好了。

未開啟多行模式卻在搜尋規則裡放進換行符號時，Grep 不再誤報找不到相符內容，而是直接回報被拒絕的規則。

帶有位元組順序記號存檔的 Jupyter 筆記本，現在能被 Read 與 NotebookEdit 工具正常讀取，不再誤判為無效 JSON。

CLAUDE.md 與記憶檔裡只要含有 HTML 註解，裡頭的參考式連結定義不會再被漏掉。用 `Read` 指定頁碼範圍讀取跨頁掃描檔時，每頁也不會再同時重複顯示左右兩半。
body.en:
Several misdetections and dropped items caused by specific formats when searching text or reading files have been fixed.

When a line break is included in a search pattern without multiline mode enabled, Grep no longer falsely reports no matches and instead reports the rejected pattern directly.

Jupyter notebooks saved with a byte order mark can now be read properly by the Read and NotebookEdit tools instead of being flagged as invalid JSON.

Link reference definitions inside CLAUDE.md and memory files are no longer dropped when the file contains an HTML comment. When using `Read` with a page range on a scanned two-page spread, each page no longer shows both halves duplicated together.

items.original:
Fixed Grep reporting no matches when the pattern held a line break without multiline mode; it now reports the rejected pattern
Fixed Jupyter notebooks saved with a byte order mark being reported as invalid JSON by the Read and NotebookEdit tools
Fixed link reference definitions being dropped from CLAUDE.md and memory files that contain an HTML comment
Fixed `Read` with a page range showing both halves of a scanned two-page spread on each of its pages

title.zh-TW: 執行中的監控器不再把舊對話留在記憶體
title.en: Running Monitors No Longer Keep Earlier Conversations in Memory

body.zh-TW: 開啟監控器持續盯著背景進度，過去它會把先前的對話內容一直佔在記憶體裡，直到監控結束才放掉。這個問題已經修好，執行中的監控器不會再這樣佔住先前對話。
body.en: When you start a Monitor to watch background progress, it used to hold earlier conversation content in memory until the monitor ended. This issue is fixed, so running Monitors no longer keep earlier conversations in memory like that.

items.original: Fixed running Monitors keeping the earlier conversation in memory until they end

title.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 大 PDF 誤報修正
title.en: Fix for False Prompt Length Errors on Large PDFs in Claude Desktop

body.zh-TW: 聊了一長串對話後，再加入超過上下文視窗大小的 PDF，回合過去可能會以「Prompt is too long」結束。這個問題發生在透過第三方供應商使用 Claude Desktop 的部分工作階段，排程任務除外，現在已修好。
body.en: After a long conversation, adding a PDF larger than the context window could end the turn with "Prompt is too long". This happened in some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, and is now fixed.

items.original: Fixed some Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers, other than scheduled tasks, ending a turn with "Prompt is too long" when a PDF larger than the context window followed a long conversation

title.zh-TW: 同名代理設定檔不再受檔案搜尋順序影響
title.en: Same-Name Agent Files No Longer Depend on File Search Order

body.zh-TW: 同時存了兩份名字一樣的使用者或專案代理設定，到底會套用哪一份常常令人摸不著頭緒。過去這取決於檔案搜尋列出的先後順序，這個問題已經修好，不會再跟著搜尋順序飄移。
body.en: When two user or project agent files declare the same name, it was often unclear which one would take effect. Previously, the choice depended on the order the file search listed them; this is now fixed so it no longer drifts with search order.

items.original: Fixed the choice between two user or project agent files declaring the same name depending on the order the file search listed them

title.zh-TW: 無日誌檔時 claude daemon logs 不再卡死
title.en: claude daemon logs no longer hangs when no log file exists

body.zh-TW: 在 Git 儲存庫資料夾裡執行 `claude daemon logs`，過去只要現場還沒有日誌檔案，指令就會一直卡住不會結束。這個問題已經修好，現在不會再無止境等下去。
body.en: Running `claude daemon logs` inside a Git repository folder previously hung indefinitely whenever no log file existed yet. This is fixed, and the command no longer waits forever.

items.original: Fixed `claude daemon logs` never exiting inside a git repository when there is no log file

title.zh-TW: Edit 掛鉤指令與圖表、排版顯示問題修復
title.en: Fixes for Edit hook commands, diagrams, and layout rendering

body.zh-TW:
平常編輯設定、看對話排版或檢視圖表產物時，偶爾會碰到文字莫名消失、樣式缺漏或改不動的狀況，這批顯示與編輯錯誤都已經修好。

同一段 Markdown 裡，若粗體或斜體後面隔一段還有反斜線接表情符號，粗斜體緊接著的一兩個字元不會再被藏起來。

在 Claude 設定檔裡編輯原本就合法的部分掛鉤指令時，Edit 工具不會再拒絕修改。

HTML 產物裡的 Mermaid 圖表現在會保留原本的換行與 stereotype（類別圖中標示類別用途的構造型註記），不再缺漏。
body.en:
When editing settings, reading conversation layouts, or viewing diagram artifacts, text could occasionally vanish, styles could go missing, or edits could get blocked—this batch of display and editing bugs is now fixed.

Within the same Markdown paragraph, if a backslash before an emoji appears further down after bold or italic text, the one or two characters immediately following that formatted text are no longer hidden.

When editing certain valid hook commands in Claude settings files, the Edit tool no longer refuses the change.

Mermaid diagrams in HTML artifacts now preserve their original line breaks and stereotypes (annotations in class diagrams indicating a class's role) instead of dropping them.

items.original:
Fixed markdown hiding a character or two after bold or italic text when a backslash came before an emoji later in the paragraph
Fixed Edit refusing some valid hook commands in Claude settings files
Fixed line breaks and class stereotypes missing from Mermaid diagrams in HTML artifacts

title.zh-TW: 閘道擋掉小模型時 WebFetch 會改依 /effort 設定
title.en: WebFetch now honors /effort when a gateway blocks the small model

body.zh-TW: 用 WebFetch 整理網頁摘要，如果連線閘道拒絕使用快速小模型，過去就會直接忽略你設好的 `/effort` 思考等級。這個問題已經修好，遇到這情況時也會照 `/effort` 設定處理。
body.en: When summarizing web pages with WebFetch, if the gateway refused the small fast model, your `/effort` thinking level was previously ignored. This is fixed, and WebFetch now follows your `/effort` setting in that situation as well.

items.original: Fixed WebFetch page summaries ignoring the `/effort` level when a gateway refuses the small fast model

title.zh-TW: Google Cloud 版 claude -p 支援快速模式計費
title.en: Fast mode billing supported for claude -p on Google Cloud

body.zh-TW: 在 Google Cloud Agent Platform 跑 `claude -p` 且模型來自 `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` 或設定檔，過去 `--settings '{"fastMode":true}'` 會被忽略。現在快速模式會生效，並照快速模式費率計費。
body.en: When running `claude -p` on Google Cloud Agent Platform with the model coming from `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or a settings file, `--settings '{"fastMode":true}'` was previously ignored. Fast mode now takes effect and bills at the fast mode rate.

items.original: Fixed `claude -p` on Google Cloud's Agent Platform ignoring `--settings '{"fastMode":true}'` when the model comes from `ANTHROPIC_MODEL` or a settings file; such runs now bill at the fast mode price

title.zh-TW: forceLoginOrgUUID 遇暫時斷線不再拒開
title.en: forceLoginOrgUUID no longer blocks startup on temporary disconnects

body.zh-TW: 設定了 `forceLoginOrgUUID` 強制登入特定組織，過去只要碰到一次暫時性的伺服器錯誤或斷線，啟動就會直接被拒絕。這個問題已經修好，不會再因為單次暫時異常就進不去。
body.en: When `forceLoginOrgUUID` was set to enforce logging into a specific organization, a single temporary server error or dropped connection previously caused startup to be refused. This is fixed, so a one-off transient issue no longer locks you out.

items.original: Fixed startup under `forceLoginOrgUUID` being refused after one temporary server error or dropped connection

title.zh-TW: 暫停帳號跑 /design-login 等指令改顯示申訴連結
title.en: Commands like /design-login now show an appeal link for on-hold accounts

body.zh-TW: 帳號遭到暫停時，執行 `/install-github-app` 或 `/design-login` 過去只會跳出籠統的失敗訊息，讓人不知該去哪處理。這個問題已經修好，現在會顯示帳號暫停通知與申訴連結。
body.en: When an account was on hold, running `/install-github-app` or `/design-login` previously showed only a generic failure message with no clue where to go next. This is fixed, and it now displays the on-hold notice and an appeal link.

items.original: Fixed `/install-github-app` and `/design-login` showing a generic failure for an account on hold instead of the on-hold notice and appeal link

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器交接與重啟時不再漏掉工作狀態
title.en: Self-hosted runners no longer lose work state on handoffs and restarts

body.zh-TW:
長任務跑一半遇到機器重啟、中途換手或啟動卡頓，最怕前面跑出的進度與快取跟著白費，這幾種情況下的接續問題都修好了。

失敗回報遺失或工作階段退回同一台執行器時，它不會再一路忽略直到結束。在關閉遙測的工作階段裡，新執行器接手權限提示後，工具呼叫也不再憑空消失。

重啟無法備妥的儲存庫清單變動時，提示詞快取與先前的思考會保留下來。設有 `--push-outcome-on-release` 的大型儲存庫恢復時，不會再漏掉先前已推送的成果。

當 Claude Code 每次啟動都卡住且 `--startup-timeout-min` 設在 2 到約 6 之間時，工作階段也不會再誤顯成正在運作。
body.en:
When a long task hits a machine restart, mid-run handoff, or startup hang, losing prior progress and cache is the worst-case scenario—handoff and continuity bugs across these cases are now fixed.

When a failure report is lost or a session is returned to the same runner, the runner no longer ignores it until exit. In sessions with telemetry off, tool calls no longer vanish without a result after a new runner takes over a permission prompt.

Prompt cache and earlier thinking are now preserved when the list of repositories a restart cannot prepare changes. Resumed large repositories with `--push-outcome-on-release` set no longer drop previously pushed work.

Sessions are no longer falsely shown as working when Claude Code hangs on every start and `--startup-timeout-min` is set between 2 and about 6.

items.original:
Fixed self-hosted runners ignoring a session until they exited, after its failure report was lost or the session was given back to the same runner
Fixed self-hosted sessions losing the prompt cache and earlier thinking when the list of repositories a restart couldn't prepare changed
Self-hosted runner: Fixed tool calls behind a permission prompt vanishing with no result when a new runner took over the prompt, in sessions with telemetry off
Fixed resumed self-hosted runner sessions starting without their pushed work in large repositories when `--push-outcome-on-release` is set
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions being shown as working when Claude Code hangs at every start and `--startup-timeout-min` is from 2 to about 6

title.zh-TW: Linux 自架執行器跑 pkill -f 不再誤殺自己
title.en: pkill -f no longer kills itself on Linux self-hosted runners

body.zh-TW: 想在終端機裡依關鍵字清掉背景行程，卻不小心連自己所在的整個作業環境一起關掉，這種驚險狀況總算排除了。過去在 Linux 自架執行器的工作階段裡執行 `pkill -f`，會誤把自己的殼層以狀態碼 144 結束，甚至連執行器一起停掉；現在使用支援 `--ignore-ancestors` 參數的 `pkill` 時，不會再誤殺自己。
body.en: Trying to clean up background processes by keyword in the terminal only to accidentally shut down your own working environment is a nerve-wracking hazard that is finally gone. Previously, running `pkill -f` in a Linux self-hosted runner session could kill its own shell with exit code 144 or even take down the runner; when using a `pkill` that supports `--ignore-ancestors`, it no longer kills itself.

items.original: Fixed `pkill -f` in self-hosted runner sessions on Linux ending its own shell with exit code 144, or the runner (needs a `pkill` with `--ignore-ancestors`)

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器排程任務在關閉遙測時也能發通知
title.en: Scheduled tasks on self-hosted runners can now notify owners with telemetry off

body.zh-TW: 設定好定時自動跑完工作卻沒收到任何提醒，回頭才發現是因為關掉資料回傳或換了供應商所致。過去在自架執行器上跑排程任務，只要關閉遙測或改用第三方供應商，任務就會找不到可用來通知擁有者的工具，現在這些環境下都有通知工具可用。
body.en: Setting up a scheduled job only to receive no reminder afterward—only to find out it was because telemetry was off or a third-party provider was used—is now fixed. Previously, scheduled tasks on self-hosted runners had no tool available to notify their owner when telemetry was disabled or a third-party provider was used; a notification tool is now available in these environments.

items.original: Fixed scheduled tasks on self-hosted runners having no tool to notify their owner when telemetry is off or a third-party provider is used

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器 spawn-runner 掛鉤改可並行啟動
title.en: Self-hosted runner spawn-runner hooks now start in parallel

body.zh-TW:
明明機器還有空位能接新任務，卻因為上一個啟動腳本跑得慢而整排卡死，這是不少維運人員遇過的瓶頸。過去一個較慢的 `spawn-runner` 掛鉤會把整台自架執行器的協調器拖住，現在只要還有空位，協調器就會每 4 到 6 秒輪詢一次搶接工作階段。

新的 `spawn-runner` 掛鉤也不用等前一個結束就能先起動，每台協調器預設最多同時跑 4 個，可透過 `--hook-concurrency` 調整。若你的掛鉤不能並行，把它設成 1 就行。⟦彷彿機場多條安檢通道不再等前一位旅客收好筆電才放行下一位，只要前面還有空位就持續叫人並同時查驗。⟧
body.en:
Having free slots on a machine to take new tasks only to get stalled behind a slow startup script is a bottleneck many operators have hit. Previously, a single slow `spawn-runner` hook could hold up the entire self-hosted runner orchestrator; now, as long as slots remain free, the orchestrator polls every 4 to 6 seconds to claim sessions.

New `spawn-runner` hooks can also launch without waiting for earlier ones to finish, with a default limit of 4 concurrent hooks per orchestrator, adjustable via `--hook-concurrency`. If your hook cannot run alongside another, just set it to 1. ⟦Airport security lanes no longer wait for the traveler ahead to pack up their laptop before waving the next person through, calling people forward and screening them in parallel whenever a spot opens.⟧

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed one slow `spawn-runner` hook keeping the orchestrator from claiming sessions for its free slots; it now polls every 4 to 6 seconds while a slot is free
Self-hosted runner: Changed `spawn-runner` hooks to start while earlier ones still run, up to `--hook-concurrency` per orchestrator (4 by default); set it to 1 if yours can't run beside another

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器啟動檢查與 403 日誌提示更明確
title.en: Clearer startup checks and 403 log messages for self-hosted runners

body.zh-TW:
機器半夜突然跑不動，打開紀錄檔卻只看到一頭霧水的錯誤訊息，排查起來最花時間。

遇到像 IP 允許清單擋下的 403 錯誤時，多數日誌行改以伺服器回傳的原因開頭，不再誤記成密鑰或 token（授權令牌）錯誤，有設關鍵字告警的人記得更新比對文字。

儲存庫設定的警告模式不再遇到第一項問題就停止；每個工作階段最多回報 50 項問題，提早停止也會說明。磁碟已滿時啟動的執行器不再搶接工作階段又弄失敗，除工單啟動外會先等空間，滿一分鐘仍無任務才以狀態碼 1 退出。

缺少 Git 憑證導致啟動失敗時，錯誤會改為說明要找誰協助及儲存庫錯誤時的處置。在 Amazon Bedrock 或 Google Cloud Agent Platform 因帳號拒絕原預設模型而改用備用預設模型啟動時，也會主動告知。
body.en:
When a machine stops running in the middle of the night, opening the log file only to find a confusing error message takes the most time to troubleshoot.

When hitting a 403 error such as one blocked by an IP allowlist, most log lines now start with the reason returned by the server instead of mislogging it as a secret or token (authorization credential) error, so anyone with keyword alerts should update their matching text.

The warn mode for repository settings no longer stops at the first finding; it reports up to 50 findings per session and says so if it stops early. Runners started on a full disk no longer grab sessions and fail them—unless started from a work order, they wait for space first and exit with status code 1 only after a full minute with no task.

When missing Git credentials cause startup to fail, the error now explains whom to ask for help and what to do if the repository is wrong. Sessions on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud Agent Platform also notify you when they start on a fallback default model because your account refused the original default.

items.original:
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a 403, such as an IP allowlist's, logged as a bad secret or token: most such lines now lead with the server's reason, so update log alerts that match the old words
Fixed self-hosted runners' warn mode for repository settings stopping at the first finding of most kinds: it now goes on, up to 50 for a session, and says if it stops early
Self-hosted runner: Fixed runners that start on a full disk taking sessions and failing them; they now wait for room and exit 1 after a minute with no session, unless started from a work order
Self-hosted runner: Fixed a failed start suggesting a retry when the runner's machine had no git credentials; the error now says whom to ask and what to do if the repository is wrong
Improved self-hosted runner sessions on Amazon Bedrock or Google Cloud's Agent Platform to say so when they start on another default model because your account refused the first

title.zh-TW: 被跳過排程任務提示改叫你用 --resume 啟動
title.en: Skipped scheduled task notice now tells you to start with --resume

body.zh-TW: 排程任務被跳過後，舊通知常讓人誤以為在跑著的工作階段裡打 `/resume` 就能補救，結果任務還是沒跑。這個問題已經修好，現在通知會明確寫出要用 `--resume` 啟動 Claude Code。
body.en: After a scheduled task is skipped, the old notice often misled people into thinking typing `/resume` inside a running session would recover it, only for the task to still not run. This is fixed, and the notice now clearly states to start Claude Code with `--resume`.

items.original: Fixed the notice about a skipped scheduled task that names no organization: it now says to start Claude Code with `--resume`, because `/resume` inside a running session doesn't run the task

title.zh-TW: claude plugin validate 不再誤報掛鉤無效
title.en: claude plugin validate no longer falsely flags hooks as invalid

body.zh-TW: 檢查帶有 `AbovePrompt` 或 `AbovePromptList` 掛鉤的外掛模組，`claude plugin validate` 過去會誤報這些掛鉤在 VS Code 裡永遠不會執行。這個問題已經修好，驗證時不會再跳出這項誤報警告。
body.en: When checking plugin modules with `AbovePrompt` or `AbovePromptList` hooks, `claude plugin validate` used to falsely warn that those hooks never run in VS Code. This issue is fixed, and validation no longer raises this false warning.

items.original: Fixed `claude plugin validate` wrongly warning that a mod's `AbovePrompt` or `AbovePromptList` hook never runs in VS Code

title.zh-TW: /design-sync 不再誤刪剛上傳就被改名的檔案
title.en: /design-sync no longer mistakenly deletes files renamed right after upload

body.zh-TW: 執行 `/design-sync` 同步設計檔，若 Claude Design 端把剛上傳的檔案換了名字存放，過去同步工具會把它刪掉。這個問題已經修好，剛上傳的檔案不會再被誤刪。
body.en: When running `/design-sync` to sync design files, if Claude Design stored a newly uploaded file under a different name, the sync tool used to delete it. This issue is fixed, and newly uploaded files are no longer mistakenly deleted.

items.original: Fixed `/design-sync` deleting a file it had just uploaded when Claude Design stored that file under a changed name

title.zh-TW: 生成上限設定過高時恢復自動重試
title.en: Automatic retry restored when generation limit is set too high

body.zh-TW: 給串接模型的開發者：送出請求時，若單次生成的上限比模型或閘道能接的還高，現在不用自己重送。2.1.329 版曾移除這項自動重試機制，這一版已恢復。
body.en: For developers integrating with models: when sending a request, if the single-generation limit is higher than what the model or gateway accepts, you no longer need to resend it yourself. Version 2.1.329 removed this automatic retry mechanism, and this release restores it.

items.original: Reverted 2.1.329's removal of the automatic retry when `max_tokens` exceeds a model's or gateway's limit

title.zh-TW: 檔案差異比對速度變快
title.en: Faster file diffing

body.zh-TW: 查看檔案前後改動了哪些內容時，現在不用等那麼久。
body.en: Checking what changed in a file no longer takes as long.

items.original: Improved the speed of file diffs

title.zh-TW: macOS 沙盒拒絕清單過長時會指明清單與縮短法
title.en: macOS sandbox deny-list errors now name long lists and how to shorten them

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS 上替沙盒設了太多條拒絕規則而超過上限，過去只會報錯卻不知道哪份清單太長。現在錯誤訊息會直接點名是哪幾份清單過長，並說明怎麼把它們縮短。
body.en: When setting too many sandbox deny rules on macOS exceeded the limit, it used to only report an error without telling you which list was too long. The error message now names the overly long lists directly and explains how to shorten them.

items.original: Improved the error on macOS when sandbox deny lists are too long: it now names the long lists and how to shorten them

title.zh-TW: 重複排程任務與 /loop 上限延長到 30 天
title.en: Recurring scheduled tasks and /loop limit extended to 30 days

body.zh-TW:
要讓 Claude 在背景定期幫你巡檢專案或定時檢查狀態，過去只要開著超過 7 天就會停下來。現在只要工作階段持續開著，重複排程任務與 `/loop` 最多可以連跑 30 天，而且會預先說明任務什麼時候結束。

如果你在這一版更新前就已經建好排程任務，它們還是維持原本的 7 天期限。⟦好比把自動澆花器的最長設定從一週延長成一個月，到期日也會先寫在螢幕上，只是舊的那批盆栽照舊七天就收。⟧
body.en:
When letting Claude periodically inspect your project or check status in the background, it used to stop after running for more than 7 days. Now, as long as the session stays open, recurring scheduled tasks and `/loop` can run continuously for up to 30 days, and they tell you in advance when the task will end.

If you created scheduled tasks before this update, they still keep their original 7-day limit. ⟦An automatic plant waterer gets its maximum schedule extended from a week to a month, with the end date shown on the screen in advance, while the older potted plants still wrap up after seven days as before.⟧

items.original: Changed recurring scheduled tasks and `/loop` to run up to 30 days instead of 7 while their session keeps running, and say when they end; tasks made before this release still end at 7 days

title.zh-TW: 更多高風險 rm 刪除指令須經批准
title.en: More high-risk rm delete commands now require approval

body.zh-TW:
不小心讓 AI 執行刪除指令清到整個專案或家目錄，向來是最嚇人的意外。現在針對根目錄、家目錄、最上層資料夾或目前工作資料夾下手的更多種 `rm` 指令，執行前都必須先經過你的批准。

要是在沒人能即時回覆確認的無人環境跑這類指令，Claude Code 會直接拒絕執行。⟦如同大樓總電源旁的開關加上了雙人鑰匙鎖，沒人在現場點頭簽字時誰都按不下去。⟧
body.en:
Accidentally letting an AI run a delete command that wipes out an entire project or home directory has always been one of the scariest mishaps. Now, more `rm` commands targeting the root directory, home directory, a top-level folder, or the current working folder require your approval before running.

If such a command runs in an unattended environment where nobody can reply to confirm, Claude Code refuses to execute it outright. ⟦A dual-key lock now sits on the switch next to a building's main power supply, so nobody can press it when no one is on site to approve and sign off.⟧

items.original: Changed more `rm` commands aimed at the root, home, a top-level folder or the working folder to ask for approval; where nobody can answer, they're refused

title.zh-TW: deniedMcpServers 改只隱藏指定名稱連結器
title.en: deniedMcpServers now hides only the named connector

body.zh-TW:
公司或個人想在設定裡透過 `deniedMcpServers` 封鎖某個 claude.ai 連結器，過去只要用名稱封鎖，同一個伺服器網址底下的其他連結器也會一起被藏起來。

現在改成用名稱設定只會隱藏你點名的那一個連結器，同網址的其他連結器依然看得到。如果真的想把該網址底下全部連結器一次擋掉，請改在設定裡直接拒絕那個完整網址。⟦就像大樓門禁把某位訪客列入黑名單，原本連同他任職公司的其他同事都一併擋在門外，現在只攔下他本人；想整間公司都不接待，就直接封鎖該公司的統一編號。⟧
body.en:
When a company or individual wanted to block a claude.ai connector in settings via `deniedMcpServers`, blocking by name used to hide other connectors under the same server URL as well.

Now, configuring by name hides only the specific connector you named, while other connectors at the same URL remain visible. If you truly want to block all connectors under that URL at once, deny the full URL directly in settings instead. ⟦Building security used to block every coworker from a visitor's company whenever that visitor was blacklisted, but now it turns away only that person; to refuse the entire company, you block its business registration number directly.⟧

items.original: Changed `deniedMcpServers` name entries to hide only the named claude.ai connector, not others at its URL; to block them all, deny its exact URL

title.zh-TW: claude --teleport 部分環境改列指令
title.en: claude --teleport prints commands in some setups

body.zh-TW:
在特定設定下執行 `claude --teleport` 時，不會再直接幫你切換分支，而是把切換用的 Git 語法印出來讓你自己執行。

若是搭配 `-p` 參數執行，在完成切換分支之前，指令會直接回傳狀態碼 1 結束。⟦比方說租車公司把換車道的手冊印給你自行操作，在非人工確認模式下，沒把車換到指定車道前是不會放行出發的。⟧
body.en:
When you run `claude --teleport` in certain setups, it no longer switches branches for you and instead prints the Git commands so you can run them yourself.

If you run it with the `-p` flag, the command exits with status code 1 until the branch switch is complete. ⟦A rental car agency hands you printed lane-change instructions to handle on your own, and without manual confirmation, it won't let you pull out until you are in the designated lane.⟧

items.original: Changed `claude --teleport` in some setups to print the git commands for switching branch instead of running them; with `-p` it exits 1 until you switch

title.zh-TW: 含 sonnet 或 haiku 的未辨識模型改用短提示
title.en: Unrecognized models with sonnet or haiku use shorter prompts

body.zh-TW:
在自架閘道或第三方平台填入自訂模型名稱，過去名稱裡只要帶有「sonnet」或「haiku」，就算 Claude Code 認不得那個完整名字，還是會套用長版系統提示。

現在這類未辨識名稱會跟其他未知模型一樣，改用較精簡的系統提示。如果你希望所有模型一律拿完整版系統提示，把環境變數設成 `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` 就行。⟦跟餐廳櫃檯點了一道沒聽過的客製飲料，以前只要名字裡沾到「拿鐵」兩個字就照搬全套精緻擺盤，現在一律先給標準簡約杯；想要全套擺盤得自己額外交代。⟧
body.en:
When you enter a custom model name on a self-hosted gateway or third-party platform, any name containing "sonnet" or "haiku" used to receive the long system prompt even if Claude Code did not recognize the full name.

Now those unrecognized names get the more concise system prompt, just like any other unknown model. If you want every model to receive the full system prompt, set the environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0`. ⟦At a café counter, ordering an unfamiliar custom drink with "latte" in its name used to get you the full elaborate presentation, whereas now it comes in a standard simple cup unless you specifically ask for the full setup.⟧

items.original: Changed unrecognized model names containing "sonnet" or "haiku" to use the shorter system prompt, like other unrecognized names; `CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT=0` gives every model the full one

title.zh-TW: 非分岔技能不再改動子代理與壓縮模型
title.en: Non-forking skills keep subagent and compaction models unchanged

body.zh-TW:
自己寫技能檔時若在裡面指定了 `model` 設定，以前呼叫該技能後，連帶開出的子代理、分岔對話、對話壓縮與 `/recap` 都會跟著換成那個模型。

現在除設有 `context: fork` 的技能外，其餘帶有 `model` 設定的技能執行時，子代理、分岔、壓縮與 `/recap` 一律維持工作階段原本的模型，不會被外帶跑偏。⟦好比請外語家教來上一堂課，以前連帶家裡的管家、帳房與秘書都被要求改講外語，現在除了明確獨立分班的課程外，其餘幫手都照舊用你原本習慣的語言。⟧
body.en:
When you specify a `model` setting inside a custom skill file, invoking that skill previously switched any spawned subagents, forked conversations, compaction, and `/recap` to that model as well.

Now, except for skills configured with `context: fork`, running a skill with a `model` setting keeps subagents, forks, compaction, and `/recap` on the session's original model so they don't drift away. ⟦Hiring a foreign-language tutor for a lesson used to force the household butler, accountant, and secretary to switch languages too, while now all those helpers stick to your usual language except in separately isolated classes.⟧

items.original: Changed skills that Claude runs with a `model` setting, other than `context: fork` skills, to leave subagents, forks, compaction and `/recap` on the session's model

title.zh-TW: 子代理的模型備援與 Bedrock 區域會往下延續
title.en: Subagent model fallbacks and Bedrock regions carry over

body.zh-TW: 原本指定的子代理模型暫時用不了而切到備援模型，以前它再開出來幫忙的下層代理可能又跳回別的設定。現在子代理的備援模型會一路往下延續：它隨後啟動的無指定模型代理與分岔對話都會跟著跑在這個備援模型上，而這些代理再開出的其他代理也會沿用它的 Bedrock 區域。
body.en: When a subagent's designated model is temporarily unavailable and switches to a fallback model, any downstream agents it spawned previously could revert to different settings. Now a subagent's fallback model carries forward: any model-less agents and forked conversations it subsequently starts will run on that fallback model, and any further agents they launch will inherit its Bedrock region.

items.original: Changed a subagent's model fallback to carry over: agents with no model and forks it then starts run on the fallback, and the agents they start use its Bedrock region

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器 Bash 改按需記差異，可設全紀錄
title.en: Self-hosted runner Bash records diffs on demand, with full-log option

body.zh-TW:
跑完終端機命令後如果後續流程用不到改動明細，沒必要每次都多算一遍，不過翻看文字紀錄時也可能因此少了那段內容。在自架執行器上跑 Bash 指令，只要後面沒有任何功能需要檔案差異，現在會直接跳過計算。

要是組織稽核需要留齊每一筆檔案差異，可以在組織管理設定中將 `bashEditDiffEnabled` 設為 `true`。

開啟後每道指令都會照舊附上完整差異。⟦跟超商結帳一樣，以前每筆都會印出長長的明細，現在沒人要對帳就省下來不印，只有規定要留底報帳時才每筆照印。⟧
body.en:
After a terminal command finishes, there is no need to compute change details if nothing downstream uses them, though text transcripts may miss that section as a result. On self-hosted runners, Bash commands now skip computing the file diff whenever no subsequent feature needs it.

If your organization's audit requires keeping every file diff, you can set `bashEditDiffEnabled` to `true` in managed settings.

Once enabled, every command includes the full diff as before. ⟦Convenience store registers used to print a long itemized receipt for every purchase, whereas now they skip printing when nobody needs to reconcile it and only print every receipt when reimbursement rules require a record.⟧

items.original: Self-hosted runner: Changed Bash commands to skip the file diff when nothing needs it, so transcripts can lack it; set `bashEditDiffEnabled` to true in managed settings to get every diff

title.zh-TW: 自架執行器檢出掛鉤回傳 108 時直接停止啟動
title.en: Self-hosted runners halt startup when checkout hook exits 108

body.zh-TW: 程式碼拉取腳本已經明確回報無法繼續，協調器卻還傻傻把任務換到下一台機器重跑一遍，只會白白浪費時間。自架執行器準備工作階段時，只要檢出儲存庫的掛鉤回傳狀態碼 108，工作階段啟動流程就會立刻中止，不再輪流試其他執行器。
body.en: When a code-pulling script has already reported that it cannot continue, having the coordinator blindly retry the task on the next machine only wastes time. While a self-hosted runner prepares a session, if the repository checkout hook exits with status code 108, session startup now stops immediately without trying other runners.

items.original: Changed self-hosted runners to stop a session's start at once, without trying other runners, when a checkout hook exits with status 108

title.zh-TW: 提示掛鉤的 model 欄位支援 haiku 等簡稱
title.en: Prompt hooks accept model aliases like haiku

body.zh-TW: 在設定檔寫提示型掛鉤，`model` 欄位現在接受 `haiku` 或 `sonnet` 這類模型簡稱。
body.en: When configuring prompt hooks, the `model` field now accepts model aliases such as `haiku` or `sonnet`.

items.original: Changed prompt hooks to accept model aliases such as `haiku` or `sonnet` in their `model` field

title.zh-TW: /design-sync 備援限用專案 Storybook
title.en: /design-sync fallback uses only project Storybook

body.zh-TW: 跑 `/design-sync` 並建置參考範本的 Storybook 時，現在只會讀取專案裡已經裝好的版本。這項備援建置流程不會再使用專案以外的版本。
body.en: When running `/design-sync` and building the reference Storybook, it now only reads the version already installed in the project. This fallback build no longer uses versions outside the project.

items.original: Changed `/design-sync`'s fallback build of the reference Storybook to use only a Storybook installed in the project

title.zh-TW: 閘道登入時，子代理進度摘要改用短筆記更省 token
title.en: Subagent progress summaries use fewer tokens via short notes on gateways

body.zh-TW: 在命令列裡開了好幾個背景幫手分頭處理工作，每次回報進度都要把整串歷史對話重讀一遍，帳單上的用量跟著飆高。現在透過 Claude 應用程式閘道登入終端機工作階段時，整理子代理進度摘要改為只看簡短筆記，消耗的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）變少許多。
body.en: Running several background helpers from the command line to tackle tasks in parallel used to mean rereading the entire conversation history for every progress update, driving up usage on your bill. Now, when you sign in to a terminal session through a Claude apps gateway, subagent progress summaries are compiled from short notes only, using far fewer tokens (the text units AI processes and bills by).

items.original: Changed subagent progress summaries in terminal sessions signed in to a Claude apps gateway to be written from short notes instead of the whole conversation, using far fewer tokens

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版新增 /fork 可從最後回覆分岔對話
title.en: VS Code adds /fork to branch after the last reply

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 請 Claude 討論架構談到一半，想保留這段共識、另外開一條支線試試別的改法，卻又不想重頭貼背景資料？這正是打 `/fork` 的時機。在對話裡輸入 `/fork`，就會接在最後一則回覆後面分出一條獨立的新對話。⟦就像把簡報另存新檔再改第二版，原檔好好留在資料夾裡，新版怎麼改都不怕弄亂前面進度。⟧
body.en: Halfway through discussing architecture with Claude in VS Code, want to keep that shared context and open a separate branch to try another approach without repasting background info? That is the exact moment to run `/fork`. Typing `/fork` in a conversation branches off a new, independent conversation right after the last reply. ⟦Saving a presentation as a new copy before editing a second version keeps the original file untouched in its folder, so any changes in the new version won't disrupt earlier progress.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added `/fork` to fork a conversation after its last reply (anthropics/claude-code#69272)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 版新增 /workflows 查看執行中代理地圖
title.en: VS Code adds /workflows to view the running agent map

body.zh-TW: 同時交給好幾個代理在背景跑不同流程，想一眼看清現在有哪些流程在跑？在 VS Code 輸入 `/workflows`，就會直接打開代理地圖，列出正在運作的工作流程。⟦像打開捷運路網圖，以前要一一點進每個對話串翻紀錄，現在一張圖就看到哪幾條線正在營運。⟧
body.en: Handing several agents different workflows to run in the background and want to see at a glance what is running right now? Type `/workflows` in VS Code to open the agent map directly and list the workflows currently running. ⟦Opening a subway map works the same way: instead of clicking into every conversation thread to dig through logs, one map shows which lines are currently in service.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added `/workflows`, which opens the agent map with running workflows

title.zh-TW: VS Code 可設定關閉 Esc 中斷 Claude
title.en: VS Code adds setting to stop Esc from interrupting Claude

body.zh-TW: 習慣在編輯器連按 `Esc` 關掉彈窗或取消選取，結果不小心把正在跑的 Claude 也一起按停嗎？現在可關閉 VS Code 的 `claudeCode.escapeStopsClaude` 設定，讓 `Escape` 不會停止 Claude。
body.en: Used to tapping `Esc` in the editor to dismiss popups or clear a selection, only to accidentally stop a running Claude? You can now turn off VS Code's `claudeCode.escapeStopsClaude` setting so `Escape` does not stop Claude.

items.original: [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.escapeStopsClaude` setting; turn it off so Escape does not stop Claude (anthropics/claude-code#91536)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 可設定取消頂端釘選讓提問隨捲動移走
title.en: VS Code adds setting to unpin prompts so they scroll away

body.zh-TW:
讀一段很長的 Claude 回覆，自己原本發問的那一塊一直釘在畫面最上面，反而擋掉不少閱讀空間。現在可以透過 VS Code 的 `claudeCode.pinPrompt` 設定，讓你的提問訊息隨捲動一起移走。

適合想把整個版面都留給長文閱讀的螢幕。
body.en:
When reading a long Claude reply, having your original prompt pinned to the top of the screen takes up valuable reading space. You can now use VS Code's `claudeCode.pinPrompt` setting to let your prompt message scroll away with the page.

Great for screens where you want the entire layout dedicated to reading long text.

items.original: [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.pinPrompt` setting to let your message scroll away instead of staying pinned

title.zh-TW: VS Code 新增上下文容量提示顯示門檻設定
title.en: VS Code adds threshold setting for context usage indicator

body.zh-TW:
對話還沒寫幾句，VS Code 的上下文容量指示器就早早出現讓人分心嗎？現在可以透過 `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` 設定，自己決定上下文用到多少時才顯示指示器。

打開 VS Code 的 `settings.json`，為 `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` 填入你想要的顯示門檻即可。⟦就像手機電量還有九成時不急著跳低電量紅字，你可以自己設定剩多少才亮燈提醒，省得一開機就看著進度條焦慮。⟧
body.en:
Find it distracting when VS Code's context usage indicator pops up after just a few lines of conversation? You can now use the `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` setting to choose how much context must be used before the indicator appears.

Open VS Code's `settings.json` and set `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` to your preferred display threshold. ⟦Your phone does not rush to flash red low-battery text at 90%—you can set how much power is left before the alert lights up, sparing you from staring anxiously at a progress bar right after startup.⟧

items.original: [VSCode] Added the `claudeCode.contextUsageThreshold` setting for when the context indicator shows (anthropics/claude-code#93036)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 側邊欄開啟指令新增 prompt 參數
title.en: VS Code Open in Side Bar command adds prompt argument

body.zh-TW:
想把常用提問綁進快捷鍵或自己的擴充套件裡，按一下就叫出側邊欄並帶入提問？VS Code 的「Open in Side Bar」指令現在多了一個 `prompt` 參數。

透過快捷鍵或擴充套件呼叫這個指令時傳入 `prompt`，就能打開側邊欄並帶入指定提問。
body.en:
Want to bind a frequent prompt to a keyboard shortcut or your own extension so one press opens the side bar with the prompt filled in? VS Code's "Open in Side Bar" command now has a `prompt` argument.

Pass `prompt` when calling this command from a keybinding or extension to open the side bar with your specified prompt.

items.original: [VSCode] Added a `prompt` argument to the "Open in Side Bar" command for keybindings and extensions

title.zh-TW: VS Code 工作階段群組選單可上下移動排序
title.en: VS Code session group menu adds Move up and Move down

body.zh-TW: 同時開著好幾個工作階段群組，想把最常看的那一組調到上面一點比較好找？現在在工作階段群組的選單裡新增了 Move up 與 Move down 兩個選項，點一下就能調整群組順序。
body.en: Have several session groups open at once and want to move your most-checked one higher up so it is easier to find? The session group menu now includes Move up and Move down options, letting you reorder groups with a click.

items.original: [VSCode] Added Move up and Move down to a session group's menu (anthropics/claude-code#98654)

title.zh-TW: VS Code 建議修改按鈕與分頁焦點不再跑錯位
title.en: VS Code proposed change buttons and tab focus stay in place

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 一邊寫程式一邊審查 Claude 提出的改動，按鈕與鍵盤焦點不會再四處亂跳。

連著終端機工作階段送出每句提問時，VS Code 不會再反覆跳開並把焦點搶進終端機；載入較慢的 Claude 分頁也不會再突然把你正在別份檔案打字的鍵盤焦點搶走。

把建議修改的差異視窗拖到新視窗後，Accept 與 Reject 按鈕終於能正常運作。「Accept Proposed Changes」與「Reject Proposed Changes」也只會出現在建議差異畫面上，不再蓋到聊天、終端機分頁或其他檔案上方。
body.en:
When coding in VS Code while reviewing changes proposed by Claude, buttons and keyboard focus no longer jump around.

Sending prompts in a connected terminal session no longer makes VS Code repeatedly switch away and steal focus into the terminal; a slow-loading Claude tab also no longer steals keyboard focus while you are typing in another file.

After dragging a proposed diff window into a new window, the Accept and Reject buttons finally work properly. "Accept Proposed Changes" and "Reject Proposed Changes" also now appear only on the proposed diff view, instead of covering the chat, terminal tab, or other files.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed VS Code opening and focusing its terminal on every prompt of a connected terminal session
[VSCode] Fixed the Accept and Reject buttons doing nothing on a proposed diff moved to a new window
[VSCode] Fixed Accept and Reject Proposed Changes showing over the chat, the terminal tab and other files; they now show only on the proposed diff
[VSCode] Fixed a slow-starting Claude tab taking the keyboard away from the file you had gone on typing in

title.zh-TW: VS Code 複製指令與快捷鍵按鍵失靈修復
title.en: VS Code fixes command copying and broken key shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
寫程式到一半想貼上一段指令、按住按鍵或順手用鍵盤移動游標，卻突然卡住或誤送出半截訊息，這幾個編輯器操作上的小毛病都修好了。

從程式碼區塊複製指令再貼到終端機時，尾巴不會再多帶一個換行符號害指令直接跑起來。按住 `Enter` 不放時，也不會再把打到一半的訊息或斜線指令提早送出去。

在問題卡按下 `Enter` 會正確選取當下聚焦的選項，不會誤送之前的答案。選過「Other」之後方向鍵也能繼續用，重新打開已回答的問題卡時也會停在你上次選的那一項。

在 macOS 上，重新命名框與對話框的 `Cmd+A`、`C`、`V`、`X` 與 `Z` 恢復正常。訊息框裡的 `Ctrl+F` 與 `Ctrl+P` 也能順利移動游標。
body.en:
These editor interaction glitches—getting stuck or accidentally sending half-written messages when pasting a command, holding a key, or moving the cursor with the keyboard mid-coding—are now fixed.

Copying a command from a code block and pasting it into the terminal no longer includes a trailing newline that immediately runs the command. Holding down `Enter` also no longer sends a half-written message or a typed slash command prematurely.

Pressing `Enter` on a question card now selects the currently focused option instead of sending an earlier answer. Arrow keys continue working after picking "Other", and reopening an answered question card lands on your previous pick.

On macOS, `Cmd+A`, `C`, `V`, `X`, and `Z` in the rename box and dialogs work again. `Ctrl+F` and `Ctrl+P` in the message box also move the cursor smoothly.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed copying a code block adding a trailing newline that ran the command on paste (anthropics/claude-code#96976)
[VSCode] Fixed Enter on a question card sending your earlier answer instead of picking the focused one, and arrow keys not working after an "Other" answer; answered questions reopen on your pick
[VSCode] Fixed a held-down Enter key sending a half-written message or running a typed slash command
[VSCode] Fixed Cmd+A, C, V, X and Z not working in the rename box and dialogs on macOS
[VSCode] Fixed Ctrl+F and Ctrl+P not moving the caret in the message box on macOS

title.zh-TW: VS Code 誤觸復原與拖曳關窗等問題修復
title.en: VS Code fixes accidental rewind and drag-to-close dialog bugs

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 畫面按鍵或滑鼠操作手快一點，不再莫名刪掉東西或把對話框弄不見。

長按 `Enter` 選 `/rewind` 不再未經確認就還原檔案。連點兩下 Remove 或 Delete，也不會跳過確認就刪掉記憶、MCP 伺服器或外掛市集。

反白選取對話框裡的文字不小心拖過視窗邊緣時，對話框不會再直接關閉並弄丟打好的內容；在計畫預覽裡快速連點兩下單字後，Add Comment 按鈕也不會再跟著消失。
body.en:
Moving quickly with keys or the mouse in VS Code no longer unexpectedly deletes items or makes dialogs vanish.

Holding `Enter` on `/rewind` no longer restores files without confirmation. Double-clicking Remove or Delete also no longer skips confirmation to delete a memory, MCP server, or plugin marketplace.

Accidentally dragging a text selection past the edge of a dialog no longer closes the dialog and loses typed text; the Add Comment button in the plan preview also no longer disappears after a fast double click on a word.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed holding Enter on `/rewind` restoring files, and a double click on Remove or Delete removing a memory, MCP server or plugin marketplace, without confirmation
[VSCode] Fixed dialogs closing, and losing typed text, when a text selection was dragged past their edge
[VSCode] Fixed the plan preview's Add Comment button vanishing after a fast double click on a word

title.zh-TW: VS Code 特殊符號路徑與選取行數不再算錯
title.en: VS Code fixes special-character paths and selection line counts

body.zh-TW:
把資料夾或程式段落指定給 Claude 看，傳過去的變動狀態與行數範圍現在對得上。

在 macOS 與 Linux 上，只要檔案路徑裡含有 `#`、`?` 或 `%20`（例如 `C#` 資料夾），未儲存的修改與新增問題不會再被漏掉。

整行選取文字時，選取標籤、`@` 提及與傳給 Claude 的內容都不會再多算一行，檔案連結也不會再漏掉範圍的最後一行。
body.en:
When pointing Claude to a folder or code snippet, the change status and line ranges passed along now match up.

On macOS and Linux, unsaved changes and new problems are no longer missed when a file path contains `#`, `?`, or `%20` (such as a `C#` folder).

When selecting whole lines of text, the selection chip, `@`-mentions, and what is sent to Claude no longer count one line too many, and file links no longer leave out the last line of a range.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed unsaved changes and new problems being missed on macOS and Linux for files whose path contains `#`, `?` or `%20`, such as a `C#` folder
[VSCode] Fixed whole-line selections counting one line too many in the selection chip, in @-mentions and in what Claude is told, and file links leaving out the last line of a range

title.zh-TW: VS Code 分岔對話不再重跑排程與舊提問
title.en: VS Code forked conversations no longer re-run schedules or old prompts

body.zh-TW:
在 VS Code 分出新對話線或清空畫面重新開始，舊設定與排程不再偷跑或沒提醒。

在面板裡分岔出去的對話，重新載入視窗後不會再自己重新執行先前還沒回覆的舊提問，也不會把原本對話的 `/loop` 排程再多跑一遍。

執行 `/clear` 清空後，如果當下工作階段仍在運作卻還沒套用新信任資料夾的 `CLAUDE.md` 與設定，現在會明確給出提示。
body.en:
When you branch off a new conversation or clear the screen to start over in VS Code, old settings and schedules no longer run unexpectedly or go without notice.

Conversations forked in the panel no longer re-run an old, unanswered prompt by themselves after a window reload, nor do they run the original conversation's `/loop` schedules a second time.

After running `/clear`, if the current session is still running without applying `CLAUDE.md` and settings from a newly trusted folder, a clear notice is now shown.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a conversation forked in the panel re-running an old, unanswered prompt by itself after a window reload
[VSCode] Fixed a forked conversation running the original conversation's `/loop` schedules a second time
[VSCode] Fixed /clear giving no sign that the session still runs without a newly trusted folder's CLAUDE.md and settings

title.zh-TW: VS Code 顧問訊息與側邊欄狀態等排版修復
title.en: VS Code fixes for advisor messages, sidebar status, and layout

body.zh-TW:
VS Code 的側邊欄與聊天視窗裡，幾處容易看不見狀態、排版被切掉或提示太籠統的地方都修好了。

顧問呼叫不會再顯示成「Unsupported content type」，工作階段清單也會正常標出側邊欄聊天工作階段的狀態。

編輯筆記本儲存格列過長的字不會再被切斷，窄面板裡的權限規則不再擠成一團，問題卡上的標記變清楚，拒絕信任提示後選單也不會再把聊天畫面推歪。

登入遭到暫停的帳號時，畫面現在會顯示暫停通知與申訴連結，不再只給一個籠統的失敗訊息。
body.en:
Several issues in VS Code's sidebar and chat window—where status was hidden, layouts were cut off, or notices were too vague—have been fixed.

Advisor calls no longer show as "Unsupported content type", and the session list now properly displays the status for the sidebar chat's session.

Long lines in the Edit Notebook Cell row are no longer cut off, permission rules no longer crowd together in a narrow panel, marks on question cards are clearer, and menus no longer shift the chat view out of place after a declined trust prompt.

When signing in to an account on hold, the screen now shows the on-hold notice and appeal link instead of just a generic failure message.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed advisor calls showing as "Unsupported content type" (anthropics/claude-code#73499, anthropics/claude-code#64158, anthropics/claude-code#90471, anthropics/claude-code#73637)
[VSCode] Fixed the session list showing no status for the sidebar chat's session (anthropics/claude-code#93898)
[VSCode] Fixed long lines cut off in the Edit Notebook Cell row, permission rules squeezed in a narrow panel, hard-to-see question card marks, and menus moving the chat after a declined trust prompt
[VSCode] Fixed signing in to an account on hold showing a generic failure instead of the on-hold notice and appeal link

title.zh-TW: 搜尋與紀錄裡的對話連結可直接開啟
title.en: Open conversation links directly from search and transcripts

body.zh-TW:
在終端機翻找舊紀錄，常會看到指向其他對話的討論串連結。現在從搜尋結果或對話紀錄跟著這些連結點進去，就能直接在終端機開啟已儲存的對話，也能打開裡面的巢狀代理（由主任務在底層另外分派出去執行的輔助程式）。

⟦紙本通訊錄找到人名後，以前還得另開頁面照著號碼重撥一次，現在手指點一下聯絡人就能直接接通對話。⟧
body.en:
When digging through old transcripts in the terminal, you often see thread links pointing to other conversations. Now you can follow those links from search results or transcripts to open saved conversations directly in the terminal, along with the nested agents (helper programs dispatched underneath by the main task) inside them.

⟦After finding a name in a paper address book, you used to have to open another page and redial the number; now tapping the contact connects the conversation right away.⟧

items.original: Follow thread links from search results and transcripts to open saved conversations and nested agents in the terminal. (#62332)

title.zh-TW: 終端機新增補齊參數與切換快捷鍵
title.en: New terminal shortcuts for argument completion and switching

body.zh-TW:
平時在終端機打指令、切換任務或挑選項，現在都能靠鍵盤直接推進。

輸入支援的斜線指令時，按下 `Tab` 鍵就能自動補齊後面的參數。例如打 `/mcp lo` 後按 `Tab`，會直接補成 `/mcp login`。

進入代理指揮中心查看任務，用 `Shift+Up` 和 `Shift+Down` 就能在不同的任務群組之間跳轉。

遇到選項高度超過終端機作答區的長清單，可用 `PageUp` 和 `PageDown` 捲動閱讀內容並送出回答選項。
body.en:
Typing commands, switching tasks, or picking options in the terminal can now all be driven directly from the keyboard.

When typing a supported slash command, press `Tab` to autocomplete its arguments. For example, typing `/mcp lo` and pressing `Tab` completes it to `/mcp login`.

When viewing tasks in the agent command center, use `Shift+Up` and `Shift+Down` to jump between different task groups.

For long lists whose choices are taller than the terminal's answer area, use `PageUp` and `PageDown` to scroll through the options and submit your answer.

items.original:
Press `Tab` to complete arguments for supported slash commands. For example, `/mcp lo` completes to `/mcp login`. (#62343)
Jump between task groups in the agent command center with `Shift+Up` and `Shift+Down`. (#62200)
Use `PageUp` and `PageDown` to read and submit answer choices that are taller than the terminal’s answer area. (#62209)

title.zh-TW: 有快取的選用 MCP 改為呼叫時啟動
title.en: Cached optional MCP servers now start on first call

body.zh-TW:
工作流程中常會掛載多個 stdio 類型的選用 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。

只要這些伺服器已經有工具清單的快取（把查過的資料暫存起來直接用），現在預設會等到第一次實際呼叫工具時才啟動。

⟦家裡的家電已經在牆上貼好說明書，以前一進門就把每台機器通電預熱，現在等到真的要按下按鈕時才啟動。⟧
body.en:
Workflows often attach multiple optional stdio MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers.

As long as those servers already have a cached tool list, they now wait until the first actual tool call to start by default.

⟦Home appliances already have manuals taped to the wall: instead of powering on and preheating every machine the moment you walk in, you wait until you actually need to press a button.⟧

items.original: Optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists now start on their first tool call by default. (#62366)

title.zh-TW: 個別應用程式工具可指定審核者
title.en: Set approval reviewers for individual app tools

body.zh-TW:
帳號裡接了多個外部服務，不同項目往往需要交給不同人把關。現在可以在 `config.toml` 裡，為個別已連結的應用程式工具單獨設定核准審核者。

⟦使用社區運動中心的不同器材時，以前全由同一位櫃台人員簽核，現在重訓室與泳池能各自指定專人把關放行。⟧
body.en:
When multiple external services are connected to your account, different items often need different people to review them. You can now set an approval reviewer in `config.toml` for each individual connected app tool.

⟦When using different equipment at a community sports center, a single front-desk attendant used to sign off on everything, whereas now the weight room and the pool can each have their own dedicated reviewer.⟧

items.original: Set an approval reviewer for individual connected app tools in `config.toml`. (#62360)

title.zh-TW: 可選用 Amazon Bedrock Runtime
title.en: Support for selecting Amazon Bedrock Runtime

body.zh-TW: 透過 app-server 運作的用戶端，在初始設定或登入帳號時都能直接選擇 Amazon Bedrock Runtime。
body.en: Clients running through app-server can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime directly during initial setup or sign-in.

items.original: App-server clients can select Amazon Bedrock Runtime during setup or sign-in. (#62222)

title.zh-TW: 接續與跨系統遠端工作階段保留路徑權限
title.en: Resumed and cross-OS remote sessions preserve paths and permissions

body.zh-TW:
重新接手先前的任務，或是跨作業系統連線執行遠端操作，最怕工作路徑與權限設定跑掉。

執行 `codex exec resume` 接續任務時，會自動還原先前儲存的沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的隔離環境）權限、工作目錄與工作區根目錄。只要沒有另外明確指定覆寫，這些設定都會照舊套用。

如果用戶端和伺服器跑在不同的作業系統上，遠端工作階段也會完整保留工作目錄、工作區根目錄與可寫入路徑。

⟦帶著畫箱到不同城市寫生時，以前每換一個地點就得重調顏料與筆刷位置，現在打開蓋子就能接回原本順手的擺法。⟧
body.en:
When picking up a previous task or connecting across operating systems for remote work, the last thing you want is for working paths and permission settings to drift.

When running `codex exec resume` to continue a task, previously saved sandbox (an isolated environment that restricts program access) permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots are automatically restored. Unless explicitly overridden, those settings apply as before.

If the client and server run on different operating systems, remote sessions also preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths.

⟦Picture carrying a paintbox to sketch in different cities: you used to have to rearrange your paints and brushes at every stop, but now opening the lid brings back your familiar layout.⟧

items.original:
`codex exec resume` restores saved sandbox permissions, the working directory, and workspace roots unless explicitly overridden. (#62194)
Remote sessions preserve working directories, workspace roots, and writable paths when the client and server run on different operating systems. (#62375, #62376, #62377)

title.zh-TW: 即時回報錯誤並指出觸及的 API 花費上限
title.en: Report errors immediately and identify API spend limits reached

body.zh-TW:
等待模型逐字回應的過程中，一旦背後發生問題，早點看到明確提示才不用乾等。現在回應串流（模型邊生成邊傳回資料的過程）裡的服務商錯誤一傳回，Codex 就會立刻回報。若觸及 API 花費上限，也會指出達到的是哪一項上限。

⟦刷卡扣款失敗時，以前得等月底對帳單寄來才發現問題，現在交易當下立刻跳出提醒。若是額度滿了，也會寫明是哪一張卡。⟧
body.en:
While waiting for a model's word-by-word reply, seeing a clear error right away saves you from waiting in vain when something goes wrong. Codex now reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream (data sent back incrementally as the model generates it). If an API spend limit is reached, it also identifies which limit was hit.

⟦Think of a failed card charge: instead of waiting for the monthly statement to spot the problem, an alert pops up the moment the transaction happens, and if a limit is full, it tells you which card hit it.⟧

items.original: Codex reports provider errors as soon as they arrive in a response stream and identifies which API spend limit was reached. (#62329, #62356)

title.zh-TW: 打斷主回合時保留子代理的排隊回覆
title.en: Preserve queued child-agent replies when interrupting a parent turn

body.zh-TW:
主對話進行到一半被你按停時，底下分派出去的子代理可能還有幾則回覆正在排隊。現在中斷這個主對話回合後，子代理已經排進佇列的回覆不會消失，會直接留到下一個回合。

⟦樂團排練時指揮舉手喊停這一段，以前各聲部準備要接唱的樂句會直接作廢，現在會先留在譜架上等下一拍接續。⟧
body.en:
When you stop a main conversation mid-way, child agents dispatched underneath may still have replies waiting in line. Now, interrupting that parent turn keeps those queued child-agent replies instead of dropping them, carrying them over to the next turn.

⟦During an orchestra rehearsal, when the conductor raises a hand to stop a section, the phrases each voice part was ready to sing next used to be discarded, but now they stay on the music stand for the next beat.⟧

items.original: Interrupting a parent turn preserves queued replies from child agents for the next turn. (#62348)

title.zh-TW: 晚完成的雲端回覆會原地更新不亂序
title.en: Late cloud replies update in place to keep order

body.zh-TW:
打開舊對話並載入歷史紀錄後，先前送往雲端的任務可能剛好在這之後才跑完。現在這類晚一點完成的雲端回覆，會直接在原本的位置就地更新，讓終端機裡的對話紀錄維持正確順序。

⟦整理相簿時有幾張照片還在沖洗，以前晚拿到的只能硬貼到最後一頁，現在相簿會先留好原本那格等它補進來。⟧
body.en:
After you open an old conversation and load its history, tasks sent to the cloud earlier may finish right afterward. Those late-arriving cloud replies now update in place at their original position, keeping the terminal transcript in the right order.

⟦Imagine organizing a photo album while a few prints are still being developed: late arrivals used to get stuck onto the last page, whereas now the album reserves their original slots until they come in.⟧

items.original: Cloud replies that finish after history loads now update in place, keeping the terminal transcript in order. (#62403)

title.zh-TW: openai-docs 補齊 GPT-6.2 遷移指引
title.en: openai-docs adds GPT-6.2 migration guidance

body.zh-TW: 準備把現有串接切換到新模型之前，常得先確認呼叫格式與設定細節。Codex 內建的 `openai-docs` 技能現在已收錄遷移至 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 的說明，涵蓋端點（呼叫模型服務的連線位址）選擇與工具呼叫要求。
body.en: Before switching an existing integration to a new model, you often need to check request formats and configuration details first. Codex's bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migrating to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint (the connection address for calling a model service) choices and tool-calling requirements.

items.original: The bundled `openai-docs` skill now covers migration to GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, including endpoint choices and tool-calling requirements. (#62447)

title.zh-TW: Code Mode 改統一走 gRPC 並棄用舊設定
title.en: Code Mode Standardizes on gRPC and Deprecates Old Setting

body.zh-TW:
