在設定檔裡調整 Code Mode 連線方式的日子告一段落了。現在 Code Mode 的所有主機連線都一律改用 gRPC（一種常見的資料傳輸連線協定），原本的 `code_mode_host_grpc` 設定也隨之標記為棄用。

⟦老舊大樓原本還留著切換舊式電話線的撥鈕，現在所有分機全部改接同一種數位線路，牆上的切換開關也就跟著退役。⟧
body.en:
The days of adjusting how Code Mode connects in the configuration file are over. Code Mode now uses gRPC (a common data-transfer protocol) for all host connections, and the original `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is marked as deprecated.

⟦An old building once kept a toggle for legacy phone lines, and now that every extension has moved to a single digital line, the wall switch has been retired as well.⟧

items.original: Code Mode now uses gRPC for all host connections. The `code_mode_host_grpc` setting is deprecated. (#62476)

title.zh-TW: Python 排版與 SDK 型別會驗證套件雜湊
title.en: Python Formatting and SDK Types Verify Package Hashes

body.zh-TW: 這項變動主要影響參與專案開發的貢獻者。現在執行 Python 程式碼排版與產生 SDK 型別定義時，流程會比對相依套件的雜湊值（用來確認檔案內容是否一致的數位指紋）與程式碼庫的鎖定檔。
body.en: This change mainly affects contributors working on the project. When running Python code formatting and generating SDK type definitions, the workflow now checks dependency hashes (digital fingerprints used to confirm whether file contents match) against the repository lockfile.

items.original: Python formatting and SDK type generation now verify dependency hashes against the repository lockfile. (#62346)

title.zh-TW: 模型目錄新增 GPT-6.2 Sol 與 Astra
title.en: Model Catalogs Add GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra

body.zh-TW: 開新對話前打開選單，裡頭現在多了兩位新成員。模型目錄已加入 GPT-6.2 Sol 與 Astra，並直接將 Sol 設為目錄的預設選項。⟦好比文具店把兩款新筆放上陳列架，以前架上只有舊款式，現在不只多了新選擇，其中一款還直接擺在最順手的預設位置。⟧
body.en: Open the menu before starting a new conversation, and you will find two new additions. GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra have been added to the model catalogs, with Sol set as the default catalog selection. ⟦Picture a stationery shop putting two new pens on display—previously only older styles sat on the rack, and now there are not only new choices, but one sits right in the handiest default spot.⟧

items.original: Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default catalog selection. (#62106)

title.zh-TW: TUI 工作區預設開啟並排顯示預覽
title.en: TUI Workspace Enabled by Default with Side-by-Side Previews

body.zh-TW:
一邊請 AI 改資料、一邊還得另外開視窗翻文件，視線常在好幾個地方跳來跳去。現在 TUI（終端機裡的文字操作介面）的工作區會預設開啟，不用另外切換就能直接看到並排畫面。

主對話旁邊會直接列出可搜尋的文件預覽與圖片預覽。如果有子代理（幫主對話分頭處理工作的助手）在執行，它的完整對話紀錄也會一併擺在旁邊方便對照。⟦就像整理報告時把資料夾攤在書桌兩側，以前要逐份翻找核對，現在主稿旁直接擺好參考文件、圖片和分頭調查的筆記。⟧
body.en:
Having to open a separate window to flip through documents while asking AI to edit data often leaves your eyes jumping between several places. Now the TUI (a text-based interface in the terminal) workspace is enabled by default, so you can see a side-by-side layout without switching views.

Searchable document previews and image previews appear right next to the main conversation. If a subagent (an assistant that handles parallel work for the main conversation) is running, its full transcript is placed alongside it for easy comparison. ⟦Think of spreading folders across both sides of your desk while organizing a report: instead of flipping through files one by one, your reference docs, images, and side-investigation notes sit right next to your main draft.⟧

items.original: Enabled the TUI workspace by default, with searchable document previews, image previews, and subagent transcripts alongside the main conversation. (#61352, #61888, #61889, #61919, #62157)

title.zh-TW: 非 Vim 輸入區新增可自訂復原與重做鍵
title.en: Non-Vim Composer Adds Configurable Undo and Redo Shortcuts

body.zh-TW:
整理報告貼了一大段參考資料又附了檔案，卻手滑把整塊指令全刪掉。現在只要不是在 Vim（一種純鍵盤操作的編輯模式）下，提示詞輸入區都能設定復原與重做快捷鍵。

操作時不只純文字會恢復，先前夾帶的附件和大段貼上的內容也會完整回到輸入框裡。⟦跟在剪貼簿做拼貼一樣，不小心把剪好的圖文整塊掃掉，拉回一步就能把整張照片和長剪報原封不動放回桌面。⟧
body.en:
You paste a large block of reference material and attach a file while organizing a report, only to slip and delete the entire prompt. Now, as long as you are not in Vim (a keyboard-only editing mode), you can configure undo and redo shortcuts in the prompt composer.

When you trigger them, not only is plain text restored, but previously attached files and large pasted blocks also return intact to the input box. ⟦Just like making a collage on a clipboard, if you accidentally sweep away a whole chunk of cut-out text and images, stepping back puts the entire photo and long clipping right back on the table.⟧

items.original: Added configurable undo and redo shortcuts to the non-Vim prompt composer, including restoration of attachments and large pastes. (#61954)

title.zh-TW: codex exec 新增 --remote 參數
title.en: codex exec Adds --remote Flag

body.zh-TW:
遠端機器上已經跑著一個 Codex 服務，想在腳本裡直接交辦任務。只要執行下面這行指令，就能連上既有的應用程式伺服器，啟動或接續非互動式工作階段（送出指令後直接跑完、不需來回對話）：

```bash
codex exec --remote <ADDR> # 將 <ADDR> 換成目標伺服器位址
```

⟦如同工廠裡早就開機運轉的產線，直接把物料送上既有產線就能開工或續跑。⟧
body.en:
A Codex service is already running on a remote machine, and you want to dispatch tasks to it from a script. By running the command below, you can connect to an existing app server and start or resume noninteractive sessions (runs that finish after you send a command, without back-and-forth):

```bash
codex exec --remote <ADDR> # Replace <ADDR> with the target server address
```

⟦A factory production line is already up and running—you simply feed materials onto the existing line to start or continue work.⟧

items.original: Added `codex exec --remote <ADDR>` to start or resume noninteractive sessions on an existing app server. (#61707)

title.zh-TW: 終端機新增 /rc 與 /remote 管理遠端控制
title.en: Terminal Adds /rc and /remote to Manage Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 人離開電腦桌，想改用另一台裝置遙控本機跑著的對話，該怎麼快速配對？在終端機介面輸入 `/rc` 或 `/remote`，就能管理本機的遠端控制功能，並直接顯示裝置配對碼。⟦像在客廳連接智慧電視一樣，直接在螢幕叫出配對碼。⟧
body.en: When you step away from your desk and want to use another device to remotely control a conversation running locally, how do you pair quickly? In the terminal interface, enter `/rc` or `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes directly. ⟦It is like connecting a smart TV in the living room by bringing up the pairing code right on the screen.⟧

items.original: Added `/rc` and `/remote` to manage local remote control and display device pairing codes from the TUI. (#62121)

title.zh-TW: /statusline 可自訂與選用 MCP 狀態列
title.en: /statusline Supports Custom and Selectable MCP Status Lines

body.zh-TW:
盯著終端機底部看久了，難免想把常用的外部工具資訊也釘在那一排。只要啟用 `tui_extensions_statusline`，就能用 `/statusline` 管理底部的資訊欄。

透過這個指令，你可以自由挑選現成樣式，或自己編寫要顯示的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）狀態列。⟦拿汽車儀表板來比方，以前出廠給哪幾顆燈號就只能看哪幾顆，現在能自己挑選或組裝想看的小工具欄位擺上去。⟧
body.en:
After staring at the bottom of the terminal for a while, it is natural to want information from your frequently used external tools pinned right there. Once `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled, you can use `/statusline` to manage the bottom status bar.

Through this command, you can pick from ready-made styles or author your own MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) status line to display. ⟦Compare it to a car dashboard: before, you could only watch the factory indicator lights, whereas now you can pick or assemble the widget fields you want to display.⟧

items.original: Added custom MCP status line selection and authoring through `/statusline` when `tui_extensions_statusline` is enabled. (#61979, #61988, #62037)

title.zh-TW: 切換或插話調整時不再覆蓋既有進度與權限
title.en: Switching or Steering No Longer Overwrites Progress and Permissions

body.zh-TW:
在多個任務之間切換、或在對話途中調整方向，原本的設定與寫到一半的內容現在都能穩穩留住。

切換或接續工作階段時，打到一半的草稿、排隊等送出的後續訊息，以及被打斷的輸入都會跟著原本的對話串留存。

把工作目錄換到別的資料夾時，原本設定好的權限設定檔會原封不動保留下來。

上一輪如果延遲送出完成通知，不會再誤把新一輪正在等待確認的權限核准直接取消。

在進行中的這一輪中途插話調整方向時，彙總的變更差異裡依然會保留更早之前的修改。

以前切個對話或改個目錄就得擔心草稿、權限與修改紀錄不見，現在這些進行中的狀態都能完整延續。
body.en:
Switching between tasks or adjusting direction mid-conversation now keeps your existing settings and half-written work intact.

When switching or resuming sessions, in-progress drafts, queued follow-up messages, and interrupted input stay with their original threads.

When changing your working directory to another folder, previously configured permission profiles remain untouched.

A late completion notification from a previous turn will no longer mistakenly cancel a pending permission approval for a newer turn.

When steering an active turn mid-way, aggregate diffs still preserve earlier edits.

Previously, switching conversations or changing directories meant worrying about losing drafts, permissions, and edit history; now these active states carry over intact.

items.original:
Preserved drafts, queued follow-ups, and interrupted input with their original threads when switching or resuming sessions. (#61216)
Kept permission profiles intact when changing working directories. (#61195)
Prevented late completion events from cancelling approvals for a newer turn. (#61801)
Preserved earlier edits in aggregate diffs when steering an active turn. (#61820)

title.zh-TW: 修正終端機捲動輸入與重繪異常
title.en: Fixed Terminal Scrolling Input and Redraw Issues

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡滑動畫面查看內容，以前可能會碰到捲動時突然多出奇怪字元、輸入區游標亂跳，或沿用舊的終端機尺寸重繪畫面。這些問題已經修好，現在捲動、游標位置與終端機尺寸重繪都會正常運作。
body.en: When scrolling through content in the terminal, you might previously have run into stray characters appearing during scrolling, the composer caret jumping, or the screen redrawing with stale terminal dimensions. These issues are now fixed, so scrolling, caret placement, and terminal-dimension redraws all work properly.

items.original: Fixed scrolling that inserted stray characters, composer caret jumps, and redraws using stale terminal dimensions. (#62139, #62174, #62175)

title.zh-TW: 修正只發 ID token 的企業版 MCP 登入問題
title.en: Fixed Enterprise MCP Sign-In When Only ID Tokens Are Issued

body.zh-TW: 透過公司帳號驗證身分，有些服務只會核發 ID token（用來確認身分的授權令牌）。由於沒有附上用來續期的 refresh token，以前這種設定會讓企業版 MCP 登入失敗。這個問題已經修好，現在只拿到 ID token 也能正常登入企業版 MCP。
body.en: When verifying identity through a company account, some services only issue an ID token (an authorization credential used to verify identity). Because no refresh token was included for renewal, this setup previously caused enterprise MCP sign-in to fail. That issue is now fixed, so enterprise MCP sign-in works normally even when only an ID token is received.

items.original: Fixed enterprise MCP sign-in for identity providers that issue ID tokens without refresh tokens. (#62129)

title.zh-TW: 給自行編譯者：建置工具與 XML 套件更新
title.en: For Source Builders: Build Tooling and XML Package Updates

body.zh-TW:
這組底層調整主要針對從原始碼自行編譯、或負責打包發布的開發者。

原始碼建置流程與發布工具已經升級到 Rust 1.99.1。

處理 XML（一種常見的標籤式資料格式）的相依套件同步更新，並移除了已經過時的安全公告例外設定。
body.en:
This set of underlying updates is primarily for developers who build from source or handle packaging and releases.

Source build workflows and release tooling have been upgraded to Rust 1.99.1.

Dependencies for handling XML (a common tag-based data format) have been updated as well, and obsolete security advisory exceptions have been removed.

items.original:
Updated source builds and release tooling to Rust 1.99.1. (#61205)
Updated XML dependencies and removed obsolete security advisory exceptions. (#62068)

title.zh-TW: TUI 即時語音支援 WebRTC 協商
title.en: TUI Realtime Voice Supports WebRTC Negotiation

body.zh-TW:
改報告或查資料雙手正忙，想直接開口通話而不想切出視窗，現在待在 TUI（終端機文字操作介面）裡也能辦到。

新版為 TUI 裡的即時語音通話加入了 WebRTC（網頁即時通訊協定）協商功能，負責處理通話建立前的連線溝通。⟦好比兩個人約好在吵雜車站會合，以前只能靠文字傳訊慢慢喬，現在先對好語音頻道就能直接開口對話。⟧
body.en:
When your hands are busy editing a report or looking up information and you want to speak directly without switching windows, you can now stay right inside the TUI (terminal text interface).

This release adds WebRTC (a real-time web communication protocol) negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI, handling connection setup before a call starts. ⟦Think of two people meeting at a noisy train station: before, they had to coordinate slowly by text, whereas now they can agree on a voice channel first and speak directly.⟧

items.original: Added WebRTC negotiation for realtime voice calls in the TUI. (#61172)

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 匯出器自動更新驗證標頭
title.en: OpenTelemetry Exporters Automatically Refresh Authentication Headers

body.zh-TW: 給有串接 OpenTelemetry（開放式遙測資料標準）的開發者與管理者。新版為 OpenTelemetry HTTP 匯出器加入了自動更新驗證標頭的功能，不再一直沿用同一組舊的驗證資訊。⟦跟進出園區的通行 QR Code 一樣，以前得自己定期重開頁面領新條碼，現在手上的這張會自動換成最新版本。⟧
body.en: For developers and administrators who integrate OpenTelemetry (an observability data standard). This release adds automatic authentication header refreshes for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters instead of reusing the same old authentication details. ⟦Picture a campus entry QR code: previously you had to reopen the page periodically to get a new code, whereas now the one you hold updates to the latest version automatically.⟧

items.original: Added automatically refreshed authentication headers for OpenTelemetry HTTP exporters. (#61028)

title.zh-TW: 不同環境可共用同名的 MCP 伺服器
title.en: Different Environments Can Share Identically Named MCP Servers

body.zh-TW:
你在測試環境和正式環境各自接了外部服務，卻因為兩邊的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器取了相同名字而打架嗎？

新版加入了實驗性支援，允許你在不同環境裡使用同名的 MCP 伺服器。⟦比方說家裡跟公司各有一間都叫「文件庫」的儲藏室，以前同名字會搞混，現在只要在不同場所就能各自掛上同樣的門牌。⟧
body.en:
Have you connected external services in both your test and production environments, only to have their MCP (a protocol for connecting AI to external tools) servers clash because they share the same name?

This release adds experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across different environments. ⟦Suppose both your home and your office have a storage room called "Documents": before, identical names caused confusion, whereas now they can share the same nameplate as long as they are in different places.⟧

items.original: Added experimental support for using identically named MCP servers across environments. (#60905)

title.zh-TW: 過大 WebSocket 請求改走 HTTP 備援
title.en: Oversized WebSocket Requests Fall Back to HTTP

body.zh-TW:
透過 WebSocket（維持長連線的通訊協定）送出的請求一旦太大，過去還會先做多餘的重試。

現在遇到過大的 WebSocket 請求，會直接改走 HTTP 備援通道，省去不必要的重試步驟。⟦就像寄送超重包裹，以前小貨車明明裝不下還得反覆試塞，現在當場直接轉交大貨車送走。⟧
body.en:
Previously, requests sent over WebSocket (a persistent-connection communication protocol) that were too large would still go through unnecessary retries first.

Now, oversized WebSocket requests fall back directly to HTTP, skipping unnecessary retry steps. ⟦Like shipping an overweight parcel, a small van used to keep trying to squeeze it in even when it clearly would not fit, whereas now the shipment goes straight to a larger truck on the spot.⟧

items.original: Oversized WebSocket requests now fall back to HTTP without unnecessary retries. (#60840, #60841)

title.zh-TW: 修好 MCP 登入登出或取消時的憑證衝突
title.en: Fixed MCP Credential Races During Login, Logout, or Cancellation

body.zh-TW: 幫外部工具授權帳號到一半想喊停，或是進行登入、登出，過去的 MCP 授權憑證容易發生衝突。這個問題已經修好，現在進行 OAuth（常見的帳號授權登入方式）取消、登入或登出，憑證不會再互搶。
body.en: Previously, MCP authorization credentials could conflict if you stopped partway through authorizing an external tool account, or while logging in or out. This issue is fixed, so credentials no longer race during OAuth (a standard account authorization method) cancellation, login, or logout.

items.original: Fixed MCP OAuth credential races during cancellation, login, and logout. (#60849, #60981)

title.zh-TW: 雲端對話自動重連並保留恢復中的回合
title.en: Cloud Conversations Auto-Reconnect and Preserve Active Recovery Turns

body.zh-TW:
正盯著雲端對話等它把斷線前的進度接回來，最怕重連完那一輪操作卻沒留下來。

新版改善了雲端對話的自動重新連線表現，而且用戶端重新連上後，正在恢復中的回合會繼續保留。⟦像在線上看影片一樣，以前網路斷掉重連會漏掉緩衝到一半的片段，現在畫面接回來後，那一小段進度依然留著。⟧
body.en:
When watching a Cloud conversation wait to resume progress after a disconnect, the last thing you want is for that turn to disappear once it reconnects.

This release improves automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and keeps active recovery turns intact after clients reconnect. ⟦When streaming a video online, a disconnect used to drop the half-buffered segment upon reconnecting, whereas now that bit of progress stays intact once playback resumes.⟧

items.original: Improved automatic reconnection for Cloud conversations and preserved active recovery turns when clients reconnect. (#60969, #61014)

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 檔案替換與沙盒權限問題
title.en: Fixed Windows File Replacement and Sandbox Permission Issues

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 上執行檔案替換，過去可能遇到異常而失敗，這個問題已經修好。

沙盒（限制程式存取範圍的安全隔離區）原本的權限設定，過去在 Windows 上可能會遺失，現在會完整保留。

執行期註冊資訊需要復原時，過去在 Windows 上會遇到的異常也已經修好。
body.en:
File replacement on Windows could previously fail due to an error, and this issue is now fixed.

Existing permissions for the sandbox (a security isolation zone that limits program access) could previously be lost on Windows, and they are now preserved.

Errors that previously occurred on Windows when runtime registration information needed recovery are also fixed.

items.original: Fixed Windows file replacement, sandbox permission preservation, and runtime registration recovery. (#60872, #60943, #60944)

title.zh-TW: 修正權限更新與子討論串遺失沙盒限制
title.en: Fixed Permission Updates and Child Threads Losing Sandbox Restrictions

body.zh-TW: 工作到一半臨時調整授權設定，或是從既有對話分岔出新任務繼續跑，原本套用的安全隔離過去可能會跟著失效。這個問題已經修好，現在更新權限或建立子討論串，既有的沙盒限制都會保留下來。
body.en: Previously, adjusting authorization settings mid-task or branching a new task from an existing conversation could cause the applied security isolation to stop taking effect. This issue is fixed, so existing sandbox restrictions are now preserved when updating permissions or creating child threads.

items.original: Fixed permission updates and child threads losing existing sandbox restrictions. (#60936, #61134)

title.zh-TW: 移除重複搜尋結果並修好含空白關鍵字摘要
title.en: Removed Duplicate Search Results and Fixed Snippets for Queries with Whitespace

body.zh-TW:
搜尋檔案的清單裡，過去同一個項目可能重複出現。新版已經移除重複的檔案搜尋結果，每個符合的檔案只會列出一筆。

用帶有空白字元的關鍵字搜尋討論串，過去跳出的搜尋結果摘要會顯示異常，這個問題也已經修好。
body.en:
Previously, the same item could appear more than once in file search results. This release removes duplicate file search results so each matching file is listed only once.

Searching threads with queries that contain whitespace previously caused malformed search result snippets, and this issue is now fixed.

items.original: Removed duplicate file search results and fixed thread search snippets for queries containing whitespace. (#60845, #60846)

title.zh-TW: 沙盒說明文件補上權限設定檔與檔案規則
title.en: Sandbox Documentation Updated with Permission Profiles and Filesystem Rules

body.zh-TW: 替工作環境規劃隔離邊界，卻不確定不同授權等級怎麼分、路徑存取又該怎麼限制，現在有清楚的官方指南可查。新版更新了沙盒說明文件，補齊權限設定檔與檔案系統規則的介紹。
body.en: If you are setting up isolation boundaries for your workspace and are unsure how authorization levels are divided or how path access should be restricted, there is now a clear official guide to check. This release updates the sandbox documentation with explanations of permission profiles and filesystem rules.

items.original: Updated sandbox documentation to explain permission profiles and filesystem rules. (#61133)

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕輸入框支援滑鼠點選與反白
title.en: Mouse Cursor Placement and Selection in Full-Screen Input

body.zh-TW:
寫了一長串提問想改中間幾個字，不用再按著方向鍵慢慢挪動游標。在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式的輸入框裡，點一下就能把游標移到指定位置。你也能拖曳、連點兩下，或連點兩下再拖曳來按單字反白文字，放開滑鼠時不會蓋掉原本的剪貼簿內容。選好文字後可直接打字或貼上取代，也支援 `Backspace`、`Delete`、`Ctrl+C` 複製與 `Ctrl+X` 剪下。

如果開啟了 Vim 模式，在 Insert 模式以外用滑鼠選取文字，會進入逐字元選取的 Visual 模式，讓 Vim 的操作與移動指令直接作用在選取範圍上。而在 Normal 模式下點到行尾之後的位置時，游標會落在該行最後一個字元。⟦過去改這幾行字得像用老式打字機一樣一格格挪，現在則能直接拿滑鼠在畫面上點選、拉出反白，整段搬動或替換都不卡手。⟧
body.en:
When you have typed a long prompt and want to change a few words in the middle, you no longer have to hold down arrow keys to nudge the cursor over. Inside the prompt box in `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, a single click moves the cursor right where you want it. You can also drag, double-click, or double-click and drag by word to highlight text without overwriting your clipboard on release. Once selected, you can type or paste to replace it, or use `Backspace`, `Delete`, `Ctrl+C` to copy, and `Ctrl+X` to cut.

When Vim mode is on, selecting text with the mouse outside Insert mode enters characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act directly on the selection. Clicking past the end of a line in Normal mode places the cursor on the last character of that line. ⟦Editing those few lines used to feel like nudging an old typewriter carriage one space at a time, whereas now you can click and drag right on the screen to highlight and move or swap whole chunks effortlessly.⟧

items.original: Added mouse cursor placement and text selection inside the prompt box in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode: click to move the cursor, or drag and double-click (and double-click-drag by word) to highlight text for typing or paste replacement, `Backspace`/`Delete`, `Ctrl+C` copy, and `Ctrl+X` cut without overwriting your clipboard on release. When Vim mode is on, mouse selections outside Insert mode enter characterwise Visual mode so Vim operators and motions act on the selection, and Normal-mode clicks past the end of a line land on the last character.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令改為主動回報免重複輪詢
title.en: Active Wakeups Replace Polling for Background Commands

body.zh-TW: 交辦長時間執行的背景終端機指令後，過去代理程式得另外開輪詢計時器來回檢查進度。現在追蹤背景指令時能直接排定喚醒通知，指令還在跑的話，CLI 就會自動通知代理程式，省下額外的查詢輪次。⟦不再像等快遞時一直開門探頭，快遞員會在還在路上時主動傳訊息通知，省下一次次白跑。⟧
body.en: After handing off a long-running background shell command, the agent used to spin up separate polling timers to check on progress back and forth. Now, tracking a background command can schedule a wakeup notification directly, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent if the command is still running and saves extra check-in turns. ⟦Instead of opening the door every few minutes to check for a delivery, the courier texts you while still on the way, saving you all those wasted trips.⟧

items.original: Improved background shell command tracking by letting `run_command` set a `NotificationTimeoutSeconds` wakeup, so the CLI automatically notifies the agent when a long-running command is still running instead of spending extra turns on separate polling timers.

title.zh-TW: Orchestrator 支援同設定直跑與新標示
title.en: Direct Single-Agent Runs and New Labels in Orchestrator

body.zh-TW:
在 `/model` 的 `Orchestrator` 這一列挑模型，現在操作更清楚，也不用多繞一圈。目前選中的思考強度 `Effort` 選項會加上方括號，例如 `[high]`，`Tab` 鍵提示也從 `tab Effort` 改成 `tab Next Field`。

只要 `Planner` 和 `Executor` 選用相同模型與 `Effort`，就會直接以單一代理程式在該模型執行。這時終端機底部的狀態列會顯示該模型，`/btw` 會沿用它，`/context` 也會改用它的 context window（模型單次能處理的內容容量上限）。若是同模型家族但選了不同的 `Effort`，則繼續跑先規劃再執行的兩階段模式。⟦跟寫作時一樣，若構思大綱和潤稿都用同一套標準，不如直接一氣呵成；只有兩階段想用不同力道時，才值得分兩輪處理。⟧
body.en:
Picking a model on the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` is now clearer and avoids unnecessary detours. The currently selected thinking `Effort` option is wrapped in brackets, such as `[high]`, and the `Tab` hint changes from `tab Effort` to `tab Next Field`.

Whenever `Planner` and `Executor` use the same model and `Effort`, it runs directly as a single agent on that model. At that point, the status line at the bottom of the terminal shows that model, `/btw` inherits it, and `/context` switches to its context window (the maximum amount of content a model can process at once). If you choose different `Effort` levels within the same model family, it continues running the two-phase plan-and-execute mode. ⟦Think of writing a piece: if you apply the same standard to both outlining and polishing, it makes more sense to write it straight through, and only split into two passes when each stage calls for a different level of effort.⟧

items.original:
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` so that picking the same model and thinking `Effort` for both `Planner` and `Executor` runs single-agent directly on that model — showing it in the status line, inheriting it in `/btw`, and using its context window in `/context` — while distinct `Effort` levels of the same model family continue to run two-phase plan-and-execute.
Improved the `Orchestrator` row in `/model` by bracketing the focused thinking `Effort` choice (such as `[high]`) and labeling `Tab` as `tab Next Field` instead of `tab Effort`.

title.zh-TW: /usage 滿一天改用天數顯示額度倒數
title.en: /usage Shows Quota Countdowns in Days Over 24 Hours

body.zh-TW: 想確認還要等多久才會重算額度，過去遇到大於一整天的數字，得自己把小時換算成天數。現在輸入 `/usage` 查看，只要額度更新倒數滿 24 小時以上，就會改用天、小時與分鐘顯示。舉例來說，畫面上會寫成 `in 3d 3h 59m`，不再是原本的 `in 75h 59m`。
body.en: When checking how long until your quota resets, any number over a full day used to require converting hours into days in your head. Now, running `/usage` displays quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes. For example, the screen shows `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`.

items.original: Improved `/usage` to format quota refresh countdowns of 24 hours or longer in days, hours, and minutes (such as `in 3d 3h 59m` instead of `in 75h 59m`).

title.zh-TW: /mcp 與 /plugin 的遠端登入不再過期斷線
title.en: Remote Logins in /mcp and /plugin No Longer Expire Mid-Session

body.zh-TW:
連上遠端工具卻用一陣子就突然斷線，往往是初次登入的憑證過期了。現在透過 `/mcp` 與 `/plugin` 替 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器做 OAuth 登入，會多做一層確認。

只要伺服器有指定權限範圍 `scopes`，且驗證伺服器宣告支援 `offline_access`，CLI 就會一併請求 `offline_access`。這樣像 Vercel 這類遠端伺服器就會核發更新用的 token（驗證用的授權令牌），不至於在原本的存取憑證過期後直接斷線。⟦就像拿著只管一陣子的訪客證進門，時間一到就得重新核對證件；預先申請可換發的憑證後，快過期就能自動換新證，不必中途被請出場。⟧
body.en:
Connecting to a remote tool only to get disconnected after a while often happens because the initial login credential expires. Now, signing in with OAuth for an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a standard for connecting AI to external tools) server via `/mcp` and `/plugin` adds an extra check.

Whenever the server specifies `scopes` and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, the CLI requests `offline_access` as well. That way, remote servers like Vercel issue refresh tokens (credentials used for authentication) so you do not get disconnected as soon as the initial access credential expires. ⟦Picture entering a building with a temporary visitor pass that forces another ID check once it expires; requesting a renewable pass upfront lets it swap for a fresh one before time runs out, so you are not escorted out mid-visit.⟧

items.original: Improved MCP server OAuth sign-in in `/mcp` and `/plugin` to request `offline_access` when the server specifies scopes and its authorization server advertises `offline_access`, so remote MCP servers such as Vercel's issue refresh tokens instead of disconnecting when the initial access token expires.

title.zh-TW: 修正斜線指令選單按 Tab 補全失效
title.en: Fixed Tab Completion in the Slash-Command Menu

body.zh-TW: 打 `/` 叫出指令補全選單後，過去只要多個指令開頭相同、用 `↑` 或 `↓` 切換過項目，或剛輸入 `plugin:`，按 `Tab` 都會完全沒反應。這個問題已經修好，現在只要沒有更長的共同前綴可以延伸，按 `Tab` 就會補全目前反白的指令並關閉選單。
body.en: After typing `/` to open the command completion menu, pressing `Tab` used to do nothing whenever multiple commands shared a prefix, after navigating items with `↑` or `↓`, or right after typing `plugin:`. That is fixed now: whenever no longer common prefix can be extended, pressing `Tab` completes the highlighted command and closes the menu.

items.original: Fixed pressing `Tab` in the `/` slash-command autocomplete menu doing nothing when multiple commands shared what you typed, after navigating with `↑` or `↓`, or right after a `plugin:` prefix; `Tab` now completes the highlighted command and closes the menu whenever no longer common prefix can be extended.

title.zh-TW: 修正全螢幕模式面板與選單捲動錯位
title.en: Fixed Panel and Menu Scrolling in Full-Screen Mode

body.zh-TW:
在 `full screen (altscreen)` 顯示模式下，過去想捲動開啟的面板或選單時，捲動的卻是背後的對話內容。這個問題已經修好，現在把滑鼠滾輪移到底部面板，或 `/`、`@` 與參數下拉選單上捲動，只會捲動面板本身。

在 `/help`、`/permissions`、`/skills`、`/context`、`/usage` 這類會自行分頁的面板操作時也一樣。按 `PgUp`、`PgDn`、`Shift+↑` 或 `Shift+↓`，只會切換面板頁數，不會捲到背後對話。
body.en:
In `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode, trying to scroll an open panel or menu used to scroll the conversation behind it instead. That is fixed now: scrolling the mouse wheel over an open bottom panel or a `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown only scrolls the panel itself.

The same goes for panels that page themselves, such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`. Pressing `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` only flips pages within the panel without scrolling the conversation behind it.

items.original: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling over an open bottom panel or `/`, `@`, or argument dropdown — and `PgUp`, `PgDn`, `Shift+↑`, or `Shift+↓` in panels that page themselves (such as `/help`, `/permissions`, `/skills`, `/context`, and `/usage`) — scrolling the conversation behind the panel instead of the panel itself in the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy update 狀態訊息階梯縮排
title.en: Fixed Staircase Indentation in agy update Status Output

body.zh-TW: 在終端機開啟 raw output 模式跑更新指令，印出來的每行訊息都會一路往右偏。這個問題已經修好，現在執行 `agy update` 時，每行狀態訊息都會對齊輸出，而透過管線傳輸或導向存進檔案時，仍維持原本的純換行格式。
body.en: When running the update command in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, each printed status line used to drift further to the right. That is fixed now: running `agy update` aligns every status line cleanly, while piped or file-redirected output keeps the original newline-only format.

items.original: Fixed `agy update` printing status lines with staircase indentation when run in a terminal with raw output mode enabled, while keeping newline-only output when piped or redirected to a file.

title.zh-TW: 長對話遇憑證過期或模型滿載可續跑
title.en: Long Sessions Resume Through Token Expiry and Capacity Limits

body.zh-TW:
讓代理程式連續跑比較久的任務，最怕快完成時遇到中途連線狀況而整段白費。

當 Google OAuth 的存取 token 跨過一小時效期，過去會直接跳出 `UNAUTHENTICATED` 與 `401` 錯誤而中斷。現在 CLI 會在過期前預先更新 token，串流開始前若遇到 `401` 也會自動重試。

若是分多段串流的長篇模型回應，續傳遇到暫時性 `503` 或 `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` 容量不足錯誤，過去會丟失進度而重來或失敗。現在 CLI 會自動重試，直接從原本中斷的地方接續完成。
body.en:
When letting an agent run a longer task continuously, the worst feeling is hitting a mid-run connection issue right before the finish line and losing the whole stretch.

When a Google OAuth access token crosses its one-hour expiry, it used to fail right away with `UNAUTHENTICATED` and `401` errors. Now the CLI refreshes the token before it expires, and automatically retries if it hits a `401` before streaming starts.

For long, multi-part streaming model responses, hitting a temporary `503` or `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED` capacity error during continuation used to discard progress and restart or fail. Now the CLI retries automatically and picks up right where it left off.

items.original:
Fixed long-running agent turns failing with an `UNAUTHENTICATED` (`401`) error when a Google OAuth access token crossed its one-hour expiry; the CLI now refreshes tokens ahead of expiry and retries a pre-stream `401` automatically.
Fixed long, multi-part streaming model responses discarding their progress and restarting or failing the turn when a continuation request hit a temporary model capacity (`503` / `MODEL_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED`) error; the CLI now retries and resumes from where the response left off.

title.zh-TW: 修正企業預付餘額歸零時的錯誤提示
title.en: Fixed Error Message When Enterprise Prepaid Balance Hits Zero

body.zh-TW:
Gemini Enterprise 預付錢包歸零後，過去會反覆重試並誤報額度用完的 `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`。現在 CLI 會立刻停止，改顯示下列提示：

```
Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.
```

遠端控制網頁上也會顯示 `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` 的提醒。
body.en:
When a Gemini Enterprise prepaid wallet hit zero, the CLI used to retry repeatedly and mistakenly report `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`. Now the CLI stops immediately and displays the following message instead:

```
Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.
```

The Remote Control web view also shows an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice.

items.original: Fixed turns on Gemini Enterprise accounts with an empty prepaid wallet retrying repeatedly and reporting `You have exhausted your quota on this model.`; the CLI now stops right away and tells you `Your organization's prepaid balance is insufficient. Contact your administrator to add funds.` (with an `Organization prepaid wallet is empty` notice in the Remote Control browser view).

title.zh-TW: 修正企業版存取外部檔案繞過敏感檔保護
title.en: Fix sensitive file protections bypassed by enterprise external access

body.zh-TW: 你使用 Gemini Enterprise 或企業模型閘道的工作階段，且允許取用工作區以外的路徑，過去卻會直接跳過確認與封鎖關卡。受影響的敏感檔案包括 `.git`、`.env`、`config.json`、`hooks.json` 與 `mcp_config.json`。這個問題已經修好，現在內建的核准與拒絕保護機制不會再被繞過。
body.en: When you used Gemini Enterprise or enterprise model-gateway sessions with access to paths outside the workspace allowed, confirmation and block checks used to be skipped. Affected sensitive files include `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`. This issue is fixed, and built-in approval and deny protections are no longer bypassed.

items.original: Fixed Gemini Enterprise and enterprise model-gateway sessions with non-workspace file access allowed bypassing built-in approval and deny protections on sensitive files such as `.git`, `.env`, `config.json`, `hooks.json`, and `mcp_config.json`.

title.zh-TW: 修正 Windows 跨磁碟執行外掛漏帶 token
title.en: Fix missing token when running plugins across Windows drives

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上關掉終端機沙盒，又把工作區和使用者設定檔分開放在不同槽，過去啟動 CLI 工具時會少帶驗證資訊。這個問題已經修好，現在外掛工具能順利取得原本設定的驗證 token 執行。
body.en: When the terminal sandbox was off on Windows and your workspace and user profile were on different drives, launching CLI tools used to miss authentication details. This issue is fixed, so plugin tools now run with their configured authentication token.

items.original: Fixed plugin CLI tools on Windows running without their configured authentication token when the terminal sandbox is off and your workspace is on a different drive letter than your user profile.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制網頁回應期間鎖定模型選單
title.en: Fix model picker locked during responses in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 這一輪還在跑的時候，你想在瀏覽器裡先換個選項來發問，卻發現訊息框裡的切換鈕完全按不動。這個問題已經修好，現在遠端控制網頁在回應進行到一半時也能切換模型，用來處理 `/btw` 順帶提問或接在這一輪之後送出的訊息。
body.en: While a turn was still running, trying to switch options in the browser to ask a question meant the toggle in the message box would not respond at all. This issue is fixed, so the Remote Control browser view now lets you switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions or messages sent after the current turn.

items.original: Fixed the model picker in the message box of the Remote Control browser view being locked while a turn is running; you can now switch models mid-turn for `/btw` side questions and messages sent after the current turn.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端控制網頁含 \label 數學式無法顯示
title.en: Fix LaTeX math with \label failing to render in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器打開 AI 算出的 LaTeX 公式，過去只要裡面帶有標籤，畫面上就會跳出 `Failed to render LaTeX` 錯誤。這個問題已經修好，現在遠端控制網頁也能正常顯示含有 `\label{...}` 標籤的數學區塊。
body.en: When opening LaTeX formulas generated by AI in the browser, any formula containing a label used to trigger a `Failed to render LaTeX` error on screen. This issue is fixed, and the Remote Control browser view now properly renders math blocks containing `\label{...}` tags.

items.original: Fixed LaTeX math blocks containing `\label{...}` failing to render with `Failed to render LaTeX` in the Remote Control browser view.

title.zh-TW: 指令列支援 -r 與 --resume 接續對話
title.en: CLI supports -r and --resume to resume conversations

body.zh-TW: 昨天請 AI 改報告到一半關掉終端機，今天想靠對話 ID 接回同一段討論，不用再打完整的參數名稱。這版為 `--conversation` 加上兩個別名，直接輸入 `agy -r <id>` 或 `agy --resume <id>` 就能接續指定對話。
body.en: If you closed your terminal yesterday while asking AI to revise a report and want to pick up the same conversation by its ID today, you no longer need to type the full flag name. This release adds two aliases for `--conversation`, so you can run `agy -r <id>` or `agy --resume <id>` to resume a specific conversation.

items.original: Added `-r` and `--resume` command-line flag aliases for `--conversation` so you can resume a specific conversation by ID with `agy -r <id>` or `agy --resume <id>`.

title.zh-TW: 多步驟任務現在會顯示即時步驟清單
title.en: Multi-step tasks now show a live step checklist

body.zh-TW:
請代理人一口氣處理好幾個動作，盯著空白畫面常會不確定它做到哪裡。在多步驟的互動回合中，輸入框上方的狀態列底下現在會展開即時清單。

只要代理人透過 `update_steps` 追蹤進度，狀態列就會顯示 `N/M steps`，若有跳過或失敗的項目也會一併計數。清單最多展開 7 個步驟，項目更多時會用 `⋮ N earlier` 與 `⋮ N more` 標示前後還有幾項，等全部步驟都完成就會自動收起。⟦跟去大賣場拿著紙條採買一樣，以前得靠腦袋記住買到第幾樣，現在手邊攤開的清單隨買隨劃掉，東西拿齊了還會自己收進口袋。⟧
body.en:
When you ask the agent to handle several actions in one go, staring at a blank screen often leaves you guessing how far it has gotten. During multi-step interactive turns, a live checklist now opens under the status line above the prompt.

Whenever the agent tracks progress with `update_steps`, the status line displays `N/M steps`, along with counts for any skipped or failed items. The checklist shows up to 7 steps, using `⋮ N earlier` and `⋮ N more` when there are more items before or after, and hides automatically once all steps finish. ⟦Like shopping at a big-box store with a paper list, you no longer have to remember which item you are on—the open list lets you cross things off as you grab them and slips itself into your pocket once you have everything.⟧

items.original: Added a live step checklist under the status line above the prompt during multi-step interactive turns: when the agent tracks its steps with `update_steps`, the status line shows `N/M steps` (plus any skipped or failed count) and an open checklist of up to seven steps (`⋮ N earlier` and `⋮ N more` on longer lists) that hides automatically once all steps finish.

title.zh-TW: 支援 ~/.agents/skills 技能探索
title.en: Skill discovery now supports ~/.agents/skills

body.zh-TW:
平時換用不同 AI 工具整理資料，最麻煩的是同一套做法得在各家資料夾各複製一份。現在也支援探索放在 `~/.agents/skills` 的跨工具 Agent Skills（寫好流程給 AI 照做的擴充包）。

這些技能會直接出現在 `/skills` 清單與輸入 `/` 的自動補全裡，代理人執行回合時也能直接取用。如果剛好和 `~/.gemini` 裡的技能撞名，仍會優先採用 `~/.gemini` 的版本。⟦以前廚師每換一間廚房，都得把慣用的烹飪刀具重新擺一份；現在放到玄關的共用收納架，進哪間廚房都能順手拿來用，但屋主原本灶台上的那組還是優先。⟧
body.en:
When switching between different AI tools to organize information, the biggest hassle is keeping a separate copy of the same workflow in each tool's folder. Discovery now also supports cross-tool Agent Skills (extension packs with written workflows for AI to follow) placed in `~/.agents/skills`.

These skills appear directly in the `/skills` list and `/` autocomplete, and the agent can use them during its turns. If a name collides with a skill in `~/.gemini`, the `~/.gemini` version still takes precedence. ⟦Think of a chef who used to set up a fresh set of knives in every kitchen they entered; now the knives sit on a shared entryway rack ready for any kitchen, though the homeowner's own set on the counter still comes first.⟧

items.original: Added discovery of user-global skills in `~/.agents/skills`, so cross-tool Agent Skills appear in `/skills`, `/` autocomplete, and agent turns, with skills in `~/.gemini` taking precedence on name collisions.

title.zh-TW: 執行計時拆開計算並即時更新額度
title.en: Separate elapsed timers and live quota updates

body.zh-TW:
等代理人處理較長的任務，看著畫面上跳動的秒數或想確認剩餘額度，最怕數字還停在舊狀態。

現在輸入框上方的狀態列會把思考與跑工具分開計時，例如分別顯示 `Thinking... 12s` 和 `Running command... 18s`。每當切換階段或換下一個工具，計時就會歸零重算。對話紀錄裡的 `Thought for <duration>` 標題也只算思考時間，不再把跑工具與串流回覆的時間混進去。

遇到持續一分鐘以上的長回合，模型額度會在代理人串流回覆的過程中定期刷新。回合還沒結束前，輸入 `/usage`、`/quota` 或自訂的 `statusLine`（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）指令就能看到最新額度。⟦就像廚房為洗菜和燉湯分開按碼表，牆上的瓦斯餘量表也會邊煮邊更新，不必等整鍋端上桌才發現快見底。⟧
body.en:
While waiting on a longer task, watching the ticking seconds or checking your remaining quota is frustrating if the numbers are stuck on stale state.

The status line above the prompt now times thinking and tool runs separately, showing labels such as `Thinking... 12s` and `Running command... 18s`. Whenever the agent switches phases or moves to the next tool, the timer resets to zero. `Thought for <duration>` headers in the transcript also count only thinking time, without mixing in tool runs and response streaming.

For long turns lasting a minute or more, your model quota refreshes periodically while the agent streams its reply. Before the turn even finishes, running `/usage`, `/quota`, or custom `statusLine` (the bar displayed at the very bottom of the terminal) commands shows your latest quota. ⟦Picture a kitchen running separate stopwatches for washing vegetables and simmering soup, while the gas gauge on the wall updates as you cook so you don't wait until the pot hits the table to find out you're running low.⟧

items.original:
Improved elapsed timers while the agent is working: the status line above the prompt now times thinking (`Thinking... 12s`) and each running tool (`Running command... 18s`) separately, resetting between phases and tools, and `Thought for <duration>` headers in the transcript now count only thinking time instead of including tool runs and response streaming.
Improved model quota tracking during turns lasting a minute or longer by refreshing your quota periodically while the agent streams, so `/usage`, `/quota`, and custom `statusLine` commands stay current before the turn finishes.

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕模式把輸入列固定在終端機底部
title.en: Full-screen mode anchors the prompt bar at the bottom

body.zh-TW: 開啟 `full screen (altscreen)` 模式開新對話、瀏覽短對話，或剛按 `Ctrl+L` 清空畫面，輸入列以前會先出現在終端機上方。隨著訊息進來，輸入列才跟著往下滑。現在這幾種情況下，輸入列都會直接固定在終端機底部。
body.en: When you use `full screen (altscreen)` mode to start a new conversation, view a short one, or clear the screen with `Ctrl+L`, the prompt bar used to appear near the top of the terminal first. As messages arrived, it would then slide down. In all of these cases, the prompt bar now stays anchored at the bottom of the terminal.

items.original: Improved the `full screen (altscreen)` rendering mode to keep the prompt bar anchored at the bottom of the terminal on new, short, or `Ctrl+L`-cleared conversations instead of starting near the top and sliding down as messages arrive.

title.zh-TW: Auto 模式放寬工作區外安全寫檔限制
title.en: Auto mode relaxes safe file-write limits outside the workspace

body.zh-TW:
交給預設 `Agent Mode` 的 Auto 模式處理跨資料夾任務，以前只要寫入或改動工作區外檔案，每次都得先問過你。現在有兩種情況會直接放行。如果檔案位在 Git、Jujutsu 或 Mercurial 等版本控制存放庫（保留歷次修改紀錄的資料夾）內，就會直接處理。如果是只新增內容，例如建立新檔、在尾端附加或插入文字而不替換舊行，一樣不用先問。

不過在存放庫外覆寫或替換舊行，或碰到隱藏路徑、作業系統與開機資料夾，仍會先問。版本控制與 `hook`（特定事件發生時觸發的小程式）的設定資料如 `.git`、`hooks.json` 同樣要先核准，`ask` 與 `deny` 規則和組織政策也照舊生效。⟦在有複寫留底的帳本上補寫新收支，以前會計每次下筆都得先問過你；現在單純補記他能直接寫上去，但想塗改沒有留底的舊帳或翻動封條文件，照樣得先經你點頭。⟧
body.en:
When the Auto mode of the default `Agent Mode` handles tasks across folders, it used to ask for your approval before every write or edit outside the workspace. Two cases now proceed without asking. If the file lives inside a version-controlled repository (a folder that keeps a history of past changes) such as Git, Jujutsu, or Mercurial, it goes right ahead. If the change only adds new content—such as creating a new file, appending at the end, or inserting text without replacing existing lines—it skips the prompt as well.

However, overwriting or replacing existing lines outside a repository, or touching hidden paths, OS folders, or startup folders, still asks first. Configuration data for version control and `hook` (a small program triggered by specific events) setups like `.git` and `hooks.json` also require approval, and `ask` and `deny` rules plus organization policies remain in effect. ⟦An accountant adding new entries to a carbon-copy ledger used to ask you before every stroke; now plain additions go straight onto the page, while altering unbacked old entries or opening sealed documents still needs your nod.⟧

items.original: Changed Auto mode (the default `Agent Mode`) to allow creating or editing files outside the workspace without asking when the file is inside a version-controlled repository (such as Git, Jujutsu, or Mercurial) or when the change only adds new content (creating a new file, appending, or inserting text without replacing existing lines); previously Auto mode asked before every outside-workspace file write or edit. Overwriting or replacing lines outside a repository, hidden paths, VCS and hook metadata such as `.git` and `hooks.json`, and system and startup folders still ask for approval, and your `ask` and `deny` permission rules and organization policies still apply.

title.zh-TW: 停用外掛設定改為保留內建外掛運作
title.en: Disabling plugins now keeps built-in plugins active

body.zh-TW: 對採用管理員控管設定或 Gemini Enterprise 外掛控管的組織來說，過去開啟 `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` 會把內建外掛一併關掉。這版調整後，這項設定會繼續封鎖已安裝、工作區與市集裡的外掛及外掛指令，但會保留內建外掛正常運作。⟦如果把門口的總電閘分成兩路，以前一拉下來連牆上的緊急指示燈也跟著全暗；現在只會切斷自己外接的延長線與插座，出廠內建的基礎照明照樣亮著。⟧
body.en: For organizations using managed admin settings or Gemini Enterprise plugin controls, enabling `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` used to shut off built-in plugins as well. With this update, the setting still blocks installed, workspace, and marketplace plugins and plugin commands, while keeping built-in plugins running normally. ⟦Imagine splitting the main breaker at the door into two circuits: flipping it down used to black out even the emergency wall lights, whereas now it only cuts your own extension cords and outlets while the factory-built lighting stays on.⟧

items.original: Changed `pluginControls.pluginsDisabled` in managed admin settings and Gemini Enterprise plugin controls to keep built-in plugins enabled while still blocking installed, workspace, and marketplace plugins and plugin commands; previously it disabled built-in plugins as well.

title.zh-TW: 修正指令失敗與逾時狀態燈誤亮綠燈
title.en: Fixed green status dots on failed and timed-out commands

body.zh-TW: 打開 `low`、`high` 詳細度、`/thinking` 或按 `Ctrl+O` 展開的對話紀錄，以前常會被綠色圓點誤導，以為步驟都順利跑完。其實裡面可能有執行失敗或逾時的終端機指令，現在這兩種情況都會改亮紅燈，手動取消的指令則維持灰色。
body.en: When opening `low` or `high` verbosity, `/thinking`, or transcripts expanded with `Ctrl+O`, a green dot could mislead you into thinking every step succeeded. In reality, a shell command inside might have failed or timed out; both cases now show a red dot instead, while manually canceled commands stay gray.

items.original: Fixed failed and timed-out shell commands showing a green status dot instead of a red one in `low` and `high` verbosity, `/thinking`, and expanded (`Ctrl+O`) transcript views, while keeping canceled commands gray.

title.zh-TW: 修正自填回答時游標消失與輸入法錯位
title.en: Fixed missing cursor and IME drift on custom answers

body.zh-TW: 代理人或子代理發問而你選擇自行打字回答，過去終端機游標會躲到畫面最底下，中、日、韓文等輸入法的組字文字還會跑到別的位置。這個問題已經修好，現在硬體游標會跟著實際編輯位置移動。
body.en: When an agent or subagent asked a question and you chose to type a custom answer, the terminal cursor used to hide at the very bottom of the screen and IME composition text for Chinese, Japanese, or Korean would appear in the wrong spot. This is now fixed, so the hardware cursor follows your actual editing position.

items.original: Fixed typing a custom write-in answer to an agent or subagent question hiding the terminal cursor at the bottom of the screen and misplacing IME composition text (such as Korean, Japanese, or Chinese); the hardware cursor now tracks your editing position.

title.zh-TW: 修正 macOS 經 SSH 跑 agy 重複要求登入
title.en: Fixed repeated sign-in prompts for agy over SSH on macOS

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 遠端連進 macOS 執行 `agy`，過去會繞過你原本在 macOS Keychain（本機保管登入憑證的鑰匙圈）裡的登入狀態，每次都要求重新登入。這個問題已經修好，只要登入 Keychain 處於解鎖狀態，`agy` 現在會直接沿用；若處於鎖定狀態，就會改用檔案形式儲存 `token`（登入用的驗證令牌）作為備援。
body.en: Running `agy` over SSH on macOS used to bypass your existing sign-in state in macOS Keychain (the local store for sign-in credentials) and prompt you to sign in every time. This is now fixed: as long as your login Keychain is not locked, `agy` reuses it directly, and if it is locked, it falls back to storing your `token` (an authentication pass used for sign-in) in a file.

items.original: Fixed running `agy` over SSH on macOS always bypassing your existing macOS Keychain sign-in and asking you to sign in again; when your login Keychain is unlocked, `agy` now reuses it and falls back to file-based token storage when locked.

title.zh-TW: 修正 agy acp 轉送子代理請示卡住 60 秒
title.en: Fix agy acp stalling 60 seconds on subagent prompts

body.zh-TW: 在 `default` 或 `accept-edits` 模式下用 `agy acp` 連接編輯器，過去子代理或工作流程代理需要工具核准或向你發問，畫面會卡住 60 秒沒反應。現在已經修好，子代理的權限請求、表單提示與提問都會轉送到編輯器，你的回覆也會送回給子代理。
body.en: When using `agy acp` to connect to an editor in `default` or `accept-edits` mode, the screen previously stalled for 60 seconds without responding whenever a subagent or workflow agent needed tool approval or asked you a question. This is now fixed: subagent permission requests, form prompts, and questions forward to the editor, and your answers route back to the subagent.

items.original: Fixed `agy acp` stalling for 60 seconds when a subagent or workflow agent requested tool approval or asked a question in `default` or `accept-edits` mode; subagent permission requests, form prompts, and questions now forward to the editor and route your answers back to the subagent.

title.zh-TW: 修正 /swarm 喚醒通知歸屬錯誤
title.en: Fix /swarm wakeup notification attribution

body.zh-TW: 使用 `/swarm` 多代理協作，過去留言板的喚醒通知會被記在最後開啟這個群組的成員名下，而非 `"system"`。這樣一來，針對特定成員的計時器可能提前被取消，工作者的對話壓縮時也容易擠掉協調者的指示。現在通知來源已改回 `"system"`，不會再發生這兩種連鎖影響。
body.en: When collaborating with `/swarm`, board wakeup notifications were previously attributed to whichever member last opened the group instead of `"system"`. As a result, member-scoped timers could be canceled early, and coordinator instructions could be crowded out when a worker's conversation compacted. The notification source is now back to `"system"`, preventing both knock-on effects.

items.original: Fixed `/swarm` board wakeup notifications being attributed to whichever swarm member last opened the swarm instead of `"system"`, which could cancel member-scoped timers early and crowd out coordinator instructions when a worker's conversation compacted.

title.zh-TW: 修正語音聽寫無法轉文字與錄音卡住
title.en: Fix voice dictation transcription and recording stalls

body.zh-TW:
想在遠端控制網頁版或長對話裡直接開口輸入文字，過去語音聽寫有幾種情況會失靈。

在遠端控制網頁版，語音聽寫原本會直接錄成音訊附件，不會把說話內容轉寫進訊息框，留言框裡的麥克風按鈕還會不見。有時瀏覽器的內容安全政策（限制網頁能存取哪些功能的保護規則）也會擋住麥克風開始收音。現在這些情況已經修好，麥克風能正常收音並把語音轉成文字。

在讀過大檔案或長指令輸出的長對話裡啟動聽寫，以前容易失敗或逾時。在遠端控制網頁版若音訊片段沒有照順序送達，按下停止錄音也會卡住，現在這兩種情況都已解決。
body.en:
When trying to speak text directly in the Remote Control browser view or in long conversations, voice dictation previously failed in a few situations.

In the Remote Control browser view, voice dictation used to record an audio attachment instead of transcribing speech into the message box, and the microphone button in comment boxes would disappear. Sometimes the browser's content security policy (rules that restrict which features a page can access) also blocked the microphone from starting capture. These issues are now fixed, so the microphone captures audio properly and converts speech to text.

Starting dictation in long conversations with large file reads or long command outputs also used to fail or time out. In the Remote Control browser view, pressing stop on a recording could also stall if audio chunks arrived out of order; both cases are now resolved.

items.original:
Fixed voice dictation in the Remote Control browser view recording an audio file attachment instead of transcribing speech into the message box (and hiding the microphone button in comment boxes), or failing to start microphone capture under the browser's content security policy.
Fixed voice dictation failing or timing out when starting in long conversations with large file reads or command outputs, and stalling when stopping a recording in the Remote Control browser view after out-of-order audio chunks.

title.zh-TW: 修正遠端網頁版大型影音檔開啟失敗
title.en: Fix large media files failing to open in Remote Control

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器看遠端對話裡的錄音或影片，以前檔案稍微大一點就會直接被擋下來。只要超過 20 MB 就無法在遠端控制網頁版開啟、播放或下載，畫面還會跳出 `File exceeds the 20MB display limit`。現在已經修好，最高到 200 MB 的音訊與影片檔都能正常開啟、播放與下載。
body.en: When viewing audio or video in remote conversations from a browser, slightly larger files used to be blocked outright. Anything over 20 MB could not be opened, played, or downloaded in the Remote Control browser view, and `File exceeds the 20MB display limit` appeared on screen. This is now fixed, and audio and video files up to 200 MB can be opened, played, and downloaded normally.

items.original: Fixed opening, playing, or downloading audio and video files larger than 20 MB (up to 200 MB) in remote conversations in the Remote Control browser view failing with `File exceeds the 20MB display limit`.

title.zh-TW: 修正手機遠端網頁返回首頁列表跳回頂端
title.en: Fix mobile Remote Control resetting home list to top

body.zh-TW: 在行動裝置上滑了半天好不容易找到想看的項目，點進去看一眼再按上一頁，畫面卻又得重頭往下找起。過去在手機的遠端控制網頁版裡，從對話退回首頁時，專案與對話列表會直接重設回最頂端。現在已經修好，回到首頁會保留你原本的捲動位置。
body.en: On mobile, after scrolling to find an item, tapping into it, and going back, you had to search down from the top all over again. Previously, navigating back from a conversation to the home screen in the mobile Remote Control browser view reset the projects and conversations list to the very top. This is now fixed, and returning to the home screen preserves your scroll position.

items.original: Fixed navigating back from a conversation to the mobile home screen in the Remote Control browser view resetting the projects and conversations list to the top instead of restoring your scroll position.

title.zh-TW: /context 顯示自動壓縮門檻
title.en: /context shows auto-compaction threshold

body.zh-TW:
對話越聊越長、快接近模型上限，你可能想知道究竟何時會觸發整理。`/context` 的容量標題底下新增了一列自動壓縮門檻。

環境變數（程式啟動時讀取的設定）`AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` 也改為支援所有符合條件的模型。想自己抓時機壓縮對話，只要設好這個變數，就能指定在多少 `token`（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）時啟動，上限為該模型的脈絡視窗大小。

數值可用 `700000` 這類具體數量、`800K` 或 `0.5M` 這類縮寫，或 `80%` 這類百分比。設好後，在 `/context` 和 `/model` 都能看見目前生效的設定。⟦就像替倉庫設好八分滿警報，以前快堆滿才慌張騰空間，現在你能自訂幾成滿就提前整理，看板上也看得到目前門檻。⟧
body.en:
As a conversation grows longer and nears the model limit, you might wonder when cleanup will trigger. `/context` now adds an auto-compaction threshold row under the capacity header.

The `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` environment variable (a setting read when a program starts) now also supports all eligible models. To time conversation compaction yourself, set this variable to specify how many `token` (the text units AI processes and bills by) trigger it, up to the model's context window size.

You can pass an exact count like `700000`, a shorthand like `800K` or `0.5M`, or a percentage like `80%`. Once set, you can see the active override in both `/context` and `/model`. ⟦Picture setting an eighty-percent-full alarm for a warehouse: instead of scrambling to clear space only when it is nearly packed, you can choose how full it gets before tidying up early, and the dashboard shows your current threshold.⟧

items.original: Added an auto-compaction threshold row under the capacity header in `/context`, and updated `AGY_CLI_AUTO_COMPACT_OVERRIDE` to support all eligible models: pass a token count (`700000`), a `K` or `M` shorthand (`800K`, `0.5M`), or a percentage (`80%`) up to the model's context window to set when conversations compact, and see the active override in `/context` and `/model`.

title.zh-TW: Orchestrator 思考力度與 /btw 修好
title.en: Orchestrator thinking effort and /btw fixed

body.zh-TW:
開啟 `Orchestrator` 讓規劃與執行分開跑時，未設定的角色與新選取的模型家族，以前預設採用該家族最高思考等級。現在 `/model` 中 `Orchestrator` 列的 `Planner` 與 `Executor`，預設 `Effort` 改成 `high`。沒有 `high` 則仍採用該家族最高等級。

存在 `settings.json` 的 `"orchestrator"` 選項不會改變。

在其中用 `/btw` 問旁支問題時，過去會失去規劃再執行的分工，現在會沿用設好的 `Planner`、`Executor` 模型與 `Effort`。⟦請建築師和工班施工，過去一開案就全速燒腦到極限，問個小問題也找不到原班人馬；現在預設先開高檔位，臨時插話問事照樣由原本分工接手。⟧
body.en:
When `Orchestrator` is enabled to run planning and execution separately, unset roles and newly selected model families previously defaulted to the family's highest thinking level. Now the default `Effort` for `Planner` and `Executor` in the `Orchestrator` row of `/model` is `high`. If `high` is unavailable, it still falls back to that family's highest level.

Your `"orchestrator"` choices saved in `settings.json` remain unchanged.

When asking side questions with `/btw` in these conversations, it previously dropped the plan-and-execute split, and now inherits your configured `Planner` and `Executor` models and `Effort`. ⟦Hiring an architect and a construction crew used to mean running at max brainpower from day one and losing the original team whenever you asked a quick side question; now it starts in a high gear by default, and any quick interruption is still handled by that same split team.⟧

items.original:
Changed the default thinking `Effort` for the `Orchestrator` row's `Planner` and `Executor` roles in `/model` to `high` when available (falling back to the model family's highest offered level otherwise); previously unset roles and newly selected model families defaulted to the family's highest level, such as `xhigh` or `max`. Your saved `"orchestrator"` choices in `settings.json` are unchanged.
Fixed `/btw` side questions in conversations using `Orchestrator` dropping plan-and-execute instead of inheriting your configured `Planner` and `Executor` models and thinking `Effort`.

title.zh-TW: 本機對話紀錄改為預設全部保留
title.en: Local conversations kept by default

body.zh-TW: 以前每次啟動命令列工具，它只會留著最近 `500` 筆本機對話，更早之前的紀錄一啟動就會被刪掉。現在預設會把所有存下來的對話全部保留在 `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations`，不再自動清理舊對話。
body.en: Previously, each time you launched the CLI, it only kept the `500` most recent local conversations and deleted older records on startup. Now all saved conversations are kept in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations` by default, with no automatic pruning of older ones.

items.original: Changed local conversation storage to keep all saved conversations in `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations` by default; previously the CLI pruned older saved conversations beyond the `500` most recent at startup.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁改版專案選擇器與環境切換
title.en: Remote Control project picker and environment switching

body.zh-TW:
打開遠端控制網頁的首頁或新對話窗格找專案，再也不用點進只有三個項目的 `Recent` 分組和層層子選單了。專案選擇器現在改成依最近使用排序的單層可捲動清單，上下滑動就能挑。

如果目前有可用的遠端環境，`This Computer`／`Remote` 選擇器會排在專案選擇器前面。它能依環境篩選專案，並各自記住你在各環境最後用過的專案。想在遠端開啟本機的 GitHub 專案，也能從 `Clone from This Computer` 直接開啟。

⟦整理手機通訊錄時，以前把常用聯絡人塞進三個固定格子再一層層點開，現在直接按最近聯絡順序攤平列出，切換工作或私人帳號還會記住你上回找誰。⟧
body.en:
Opening the home screen or new-conversation panes in the Remote Control browser view to find a project no longer requires clicking through a three-item `Recent` group and nested submenus. The project picker is now a flat, scrollable list sorted by recency that you can simply scroll through.

When remote environments are available, the `This Computer` / `Remote` picker appears ahead of the project picker. It filters projects by environment and remembers the last project you used in each one. You can also open local GitHub projects remotely right from `Clone from This Computer`.

⟦Think of organizing your phone contacts: instead of stuffing frequent contacts into three fixed slots behind nested menus, they are now laid out flat by most recent call, and switching between work and personal accounts still remembers who you last looked up.⟧

items.original: Improved the project picker on the home screen and new-conversation panes of the Remote Control browser view: it now shows a flat, scrollable list of projects sorted by recency instead of a three-item `Recent` group and nested submenus, and when remote environments are available, places the `This Computer` / `Remote` picker ahead of the project picker to filter projects by environment, remember your last-used project in each one, and open local GitHub projects remotely from `Clone from This Computer`.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁排隊訊息卡顯示正在等的任務
title.en: Remote Control queued-messages card shows waiting tasks

body.zh-TW:
用瀏覽器介面發新訊息給代理，主回覆寫完但背景還有工作沒結束，以前畫面上只會寫著 `Sends after agent finishes working`。現在排隊訊息卡的標題改顯示 `Waiting on ...`，並列出活躍中的子代理數量，以及最多兩個非 `daemon`（長期在背景常駐執行的小程式）背景任務或計時器的標題。

至於開發伺服器這類背景常駐任務不會卡住排隊佇列，你隨時按下 `Send Now` 也照樣能立刻送出訊息。

⟦排隊等銀行櫃檯叫號時，以前告示只寫「服務中請稍候」，現在會直接顯示前面有幾位行員在忙、正在等哪兩份文件；旁邊一直運轉的冷氣機不算在內，急件一樣能立刻送出。⟧
body.en:
When you send a new message to the agent from the browser view after the main reply finishes while background work is still running, the screen previously only showed `Sends after agent finishes working`. Now the queued-messages card header shows `Waiting on ...`, listing the active subagent count and the titles of up to two non-`daemon` (a small program that runs persistently in the background) background tasks or timers.

Meanwhile, persistent background tasks such as dev servers do not hold up the queue, and pressing `Send Now` still sends your message right away.

⟦Waiting in line at a bank counter used to show a sign that only said "Please wait," whereas now it shows how many tellers are busy ahead of you and which two documents are still pending; the air conditioner humming nearby does not count, and urgent requests still go through immediately.⟧

items.original: Improved the queued-messages card in the Remote Control browser view when the agent's main turn has finished but background work is still holding the queue: instead of `Sends after agent finishes working`, the header now shows `Waiting on ...` with the active subagent count and up to two non-daemon background task or timer titles, while daemon tasks such as dev servers don't hold the queue and `Send Now` still sends right away.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制權限視窗用粗體標示放行目標
title.en: Remote Control permission prompts bold target scope

body.zh-TW:
授權代理操作檔案或執行指令前，最怕整排選項文字一樣細、看不清到底放行了哪裡。遠端控制網頁的權限確認提示現在會把「`always allow`（永遠允許）」選項標籤裡的目標資料夾路徑、指令樣式或網域名稱加粗。

你在視窗裡修改目標內容時，粗體標示也會跟著即時更新，這條規則放行的範圍一眼就能看清。
body.en:
Before granting the agent permission to touch files or run commands, uniform text across options makes it easy to miss what you are actually allowing. Permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view now bold the target folder path, command pattern, or domain inside `"always allow"` option labels.

As you edit the target in the prompt, the bolding updates live so the scope a rule grants stands out at a glance.

items.original: Improved permission prompts in the Remote Control browser view by bolding the target folder path, command pattern, or domain in "always allow" option labels — updating live when you edit the target — so the scope a rule grants stands out at a glance.

title.zh-TW: tokyo night 配色提高文字對比度
title.en: Higher text contrast in tokyo night

body.zh-TW: 選用 `tokyo night` 配色主題時，展開的思考過程、工具輸出和調暗的提示文字以前容易跟代理回覆混在一起。現在調整了文字對比度，這些區塊能清楚和代理的正式回覆區分開來，同時保持好讀。
body.en: When using the `tokyo night` color scheme, expanded thoughts, tool output, and dimmed hints previously blended too easily into agent responses. Adjusted text contrast now keeps those sections clearly distinct from the agent's main replies while remaining easy to read.

items.original: Improved text contrast in the `tokyo night` color scheme so expanded thoughts, tool output, and dimmed hints stand apart from agent responses while staying easy to read.

title.zh-TW: /config 終端機警告誤報與說明截斷修好
title.en: /config terminal warnings and truncated descriptions fixed

body.zh-TW:
在 Windows 的終端機打開 `/config` 查看 `Rendering Mode`，以前常看到誤報警告或被切掉的說明文字。

Windows PowerShell 或 Command Prompt 主控台沒有設 `TERM` 時，過去會誤報 `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen`。這個誤報已經修好。

`Rendering Mode` 像 `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t` 這類警告，以前會用暗字和設定說明黏在一起。找不到終端機名稱時還會寫成 `terminal "unknown"`，超過三行的多行設定說明也會被截斷，這些顯示問題現在都修好了。
body.en:
Opening `/config` in a Windows terminal to check `Rendering Mode` previously often showed false warnings or cut-off descriptions.

When `TERM` was unset in Windows PowerShell or Command Prompt consoles, it used to falsely warn `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen`. That false warning is now fixed.

`Rendering Mode` warnings such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t` also used to run right into the setting description in dim text. It would also say `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name was unavailable, and cut off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines; all of these display issues are now fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `/config` showing a false `⚠ terminal does not support alt screen` warning under `Rendering Mode` in Windows PowerShell and Command Prompt consoles when `TERM` is unset.
Fixed `/config` running `Rendering Mode` warnings (such as `⚠ alt screen unavailable — run ssh -t`) into the setting description in dim text, saying `terminal "unknown"` when the terminal name is unavailable, and cutting off multi-line setting descriptions past three lines.

title.zh-TW: agy acp 編輯器載入與回合狀態修好
title.en: agy acp editor loading and turn state fixed

body.zh-TW:
透過 `agy acp` 把寫程式工具接上代理後，過去常碰到對話紀錄讀不完、夾帶附件讓指令失靈，或是工作還沒跑完就提前結束。

載入長對話會等歷史重播完才回覆，不再滿 2 秒就截斷。接上執行中工作階段會保留權限與提問提示，找不到工作階段 ID 改回 `-32002` 錯誤碼，不再回 `-32603`。

先附加檔案、選取區、圖片或連結再打 `/plan`、`/compact` 等斜線指令或 skill，不會再被跳過。`0` 位元組空檔會保留，網址與帶行號資源連結不再被當成本機路徑。

主回覆寫完時若還有子代理或非 `daemon` 任務在跑，回合會跨過背景喚醒等它們完成並回報合計 `token` 用量。開發伺服器這類常駐任務仍立刻結束回合。

中斷或取消回合時，進行中的工具呼叫不再卡在編輯器裡。沒產出指令或差異的失敗工具呼叫，現在也會附上錯誤訊息。
body.en:
When connecting an editor to the agent through `agy acp`, conversations often failed to finish loading history, attachments broke commands, or turns ended before work was done.

Loading long conversations now waits for history replay to finish instead of cutting off after 2 seconds. Attaching to a running session preserves active permission and question prompts, and a missing session ID now returns error code `-32002` instead of `-32603`.

Leading slash commands or skills such as `/plan` or `/compact` are no longer skipped when files, selections, images, or links are attached ahead of them. Empty `0`-byte files are preserved, and web URLs or line-range resource links are no longer treated as local paths.

If subagents or non-`daemon` tasks are still running when the main reply finishes, the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until they finish and reports the combined `token` usage. Persistent tasks such as dev servers still end the turn right away.

When interrupting or canceling a turn, in-progress tool calls no longer stay stuck open in the editor. Failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output now include error messages as well.

items.original:
Fixed `agy acp` replying to `session/load` before finishing history replay (or cutting off replay after 2 seconds on long conversations), dropping active permission or question prompts when attaching to a running session, and returning JSON-RPC error `-32603` instead of `-32002` when a session ID does not exist.
Fixed `agy acp` skipping leading slash commands or skills (such as `/plan` or `/compact`) when the editor attached files, selections, images, or links ahead of the prompt text, dropping empty (`0`-byte) attached files, and treating web URLs or line-range resource links as local file paths.
Fixed `agy acp` ending a `session/prompt` turn as soon as the agent's initial reply finished while non-daemon background tasks or subagents were still running; the turn now stays open across background wake-ups until that work finishes and reports the combined token usage, while daemon tasks such as dev servers still let the turn end right away.
Fixed `agy acp` leaving in-progress tool calls stuck open in the editor when a turn is interrupted or canceled with `session/cancel`, and omitting error messages on failed tool calls that produced no command or diff output.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制分割終端機分頁不再重載跑掉
title.en: Remote Control split terminal tabs no longer reload

body.zh-TW: 在瀏覽器開著遠端操控介面、從側邊欄把指令視窗拆成兩格並排，以前畫面會突然整片刷新，害你原本滑到的位置跟游標焦點都不見，現在不會再發生了。現在新增分割窗格時，會保留最舊的那一格作為整組的主窗格與分頁標題。如果有終端機已經結束、同一時間又有另一個終端機開啟，畫面也會自動從已結束的分頁移開。
body.en: When splitting a terminal pane side by side from the side panel in the Remote Control browser view, the screen previously reloaded and lost your scroll position and focus, which no longer happens. Adding new split panes now keeps the oldest pane as the group's lead pane and tab title. When a terminal exits at the same time another terminal opens, the view also automatically moves off the exited tab.

items.original: Fixed splitting a terminal tab in the side panel of the Remote Control browser view reloading the terminal and losing its scroll position and focus, kept the oldest pane as the group's lead pane and tab title when new split panes are added, and moved off an exited terminal tab when another terminal opened at the same time.

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制長對話載入舊訊息按鈕不再亂捲
title.en: Remote Control Long-Chat Load Older Messages Button No Longer Jumps

body.zh-TW: 遠端控制網頁長對話頂端那顆可用鍵盤和螢幕閱讀器聚焦的 `Load older messages` 按鈕，以前常讓操作卡住。過去它在手機上會被標題列切到邊緣，聚焦或點擊後畫面還會捲回對話最底部。這些問題都已經修好，現在按 `Esc` 會收起這顆按鈕，不再誤關外層的手機抽屜。
body.en: The keyboard- and screen-reader-focusable `Load older messages` button at the top of long conversations in the Remote Control web view used to disrupt interaction. On mobile, it used to clip against the title bar, and focusing or clicking it would scroll the view back to the bottom of the conversation. These issues are now fixed, and pressing `Esc` dismisses the button instead of accidentally closing the outer mobile drawer.

items.original: Fixed the keyboard- and screen-reader-focusable `Load older messages` pill at the top of long conversations in the Remote Control browser view clipping against the mobile title bar, scrolling back to the bottom of the chat when focused or clicked, and letting `Esc` close an enclosing mobile drawer instead of dismissing the pill.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式輸出也會帶出 MCP 工具的圖片
title.en: Headless output now includes images from MCP tools

body.zh-TW:
把 Grok 接進自動化腳本裡，靠 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）查來的圖片結果，以前往往沒辦法跟著資料一起送出來。

現在用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗與操作畫面的執行方式）執行，無論是即時串流，或是常用來交換資料的 JSON 格式輸出，都會把這些圖片一併包進去。

⟦以前看即時文字轉播只有字沒有圖，現在記者現場拍的照片也會跟著訊息即時進來，事後整理的紀錄檔一樣留得住。⟧
body.en:
When plugging Grok into automation scripts, image results fetched through MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) often could not be sent out along with the data.

Now, when running in headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface), both live streams and JSON output commonly used for data exchange include those images.

⟦A live text broadcast used to carry only words without pictures, whereas now photos taken on-site by reporters arrive alongside the updates and stay preserved in the compiled archive afterward.⟧

items.original: MCP tool results that contain images now include those images in headless streaming and JSON output

title.zh-TW: file:// 本地檔案連結會像純路徑一樣開啟
title.en: Local file:// links now open like bare paths

body.zh-TW:
在畫面上看到電腦裡的檔案位置，順手點一下就能開檔最省事。過去遇到 `file://` 開頭的可點擊連結，開啟行為跟單純寫出路徑並不一樣。

現在只要點擊指向本地檔案的 `file://` 連結，就會用跟純檔案路徑相同的方式把檔案打開。
body.en:
Seeing a file location on your computer screen and clicking it directly to open the file is the most convenient approach. Previously, clickable links starting with `file://` behaved differently when opened compared to simply writing out a bare path.

Now, clicking a `file://` link that points to a local file opens it the exact same way a bare file path does.

items.original: Clickable `file://` links to local files now open the file the same way bare paths do

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式提問卡片不再把第一個選項捲出畫面
title.en: Question cards in minimal mode no longer scroll the first option off-screen

body.zh-TW:
開著精簡模式工作，遇到需要你做決定的彈窗，以前最上面的選擇常會自己滑出視野外。

現在這類提問卡片會把第一個選項保留在畫面裡，不會再被捲出可視範圍。
body.en:
When working in minimal mode, pop-ups that ask you to make a decision used to let the top choice slip out of view.

Now, these question cards keep the first option visible on screen instead of scrolling it out of the viewable area.

items.original: Question cards in minimal mode now keep the first option visible instead of scrolling it off-screen

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段失敗時各路徑改給一致提示
title.en: Session resume errors now show consistent instructions across routes

body.zh-TW:
想接續先前的工作階段卻失敗，不同入口以前給出的錯誤提示各不相同，有的還會叫你改開終端機互動選單。

現在不論從哪一條路徑發生恢復失敗，Grok 都會給出同一套實用的操作說明，不再建議那個選單。

⟦登山時各個岔路的指標以前常各寫各的，有的甚至叫你回山腳找管理員；現在每個路口都換上同一套清楚的路線牌，照著走就行。⟧
body.en:
When trying to resume a previous session fails, different entry points used to show different error prompts, with some telling you to open the interactive terminal picker instead.

Now, no matter which route a resume failure happens on, Grok gives the same helpful instructions and no longer suggests that picker.

⟦Think of trail signs at mountain forks that used to say different things, with some even sending hikers back to the base to find a ranger; now every junction has the same clear signpost to follow.⟧

items.original: Session resume errors now give the same helpful instruction on every route instead of suggesting the TUI picker

title.zh-TW: grok inspect 會列出無頭模式載入的掛鉤
title.en: grok inspect lists hooks loaded in headless mode

body.zh-TW:
打算讓 Grok 在背景自動跑任務，動手前你通常會想先摸清楚哪些掛鉤（特定事件發生時會被觸發的小程式）會跟著啟動。

現在執行 `grok inspect`，就能看見無頭模式實際會載入的掛鉤清單。如果有些掛鉤還需要取得資料夾信任，旁邊也會附上註記說明。

⟦排練舞台劇前先核對道具清單，過去常到開演才發現哪個機關沒通電；現在上台前就能看清會啟動哪些機關，還需要解鎖授權的也會先標出來。⟧
body.en:
Before having Grok run tasks automatically in the background, you usually want to see which hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) will start alongside it.

Running `grok inspect` now displays the list of hooks that headless mode will actually load. If any hooks still need folder trust, a note is included right beside them.

⟦Picture checking a prop list before a stage rehearsal, where you used to find out only at curtain rise that a mechanism had no power; now you see which mechanisms will activate before going on stage, with anything still needing authorization marked in advance.⟧

items.original: `grok inspect` now shows the hooks a headless run would actually load, with a note for those that still need folder trust

title.zh-TW: 遠端 tmux 或雙層 grok wrap 都能貼上圖片
title.en: Image paste works in remote tmux or nested grok wrap

body.zh-TW:
連到遠方主機開著 tmux（在終端機裡分割並保留多個工作畫面的工具）工作，或是多包了一層啟動 Grok，以前想把圖檔直接放進對話框都會失靈。

現在使用 `grok wrap` 貼上圖片的功能，在這兩種環境下都能正常運作。

⟦隔著玻璃窗遞送設計圖，以前只要多經過一層轉接窗口，手裡的圖就會被擋在外面；現在不管隔了幾道窗，圖片照樣能順利遞進去。⟧
body.en:
When connected to a remote host running tmux (a tool for splitting and keeping multiple workspaces in a terminal), or launching Grok inside an extra wrapper layer, pasting an image file directly into the chat box used to fail.

Now, pasting images with `grok wrap` works properly in both environments.

⟦When passing blueprints through a glass window, adding an extra transfer pane used to block the drawing from getting inside; now the image goes right through no matter how many panes are in between.⟧

items.original: Image paste with `grok wrap` now works when Grok runs inside a remote tmux or through a second wrap

title.zh-TW: 只追蹤目前 Git 分支時不再監看所有資料夾
title.en: Tracking only the current Git branch stops watching all folders

body.zh-TW:
手邊的專案目錄一多，你明明只想讓 `grok` 專心顧好正在開發的 Git 分支（版本控制裡用來區分不同進度的開發線），過去它卻會連帶把每個角落都看一遍。

現在僅僅追蹤當前分支時，`grok` 就不再去監看所有資料夾。

⟦社區保全原本只要確認大門鑰匙有沒有換，卻派人盯緊每一棟樓的每一扇窗；現在只顧著真正要看的那道門，不會再白白耗費力氣。⟧
body.en:
When you have many project directories and only want `grok` to focus on the Git branch (a separate line of development in version control) you are working on, it used to watch every corner as well.

Now, when tracking only the current branch, `grok` no longer watches every directory.

⟦Security guards in a neighborhood used to station someone at every window of every building just to check if the front gate key had changed; now they watch only the gate that actually matters without wasting effort.⟧

items.original: `grok` no longer watches every directory when only tracking the current git branch

title.zh-TW: 支援檔案覆蓋系統提示並放寬 -p 順序
title.en: Support file-based system prompt overrides and flexible -p order

body.zh-TW:
想每次叫 Grok 照固定格式整理筆記，現在不用在指令裡重打長長一段規則。加上 `--system-prompt-file <path>` 參數，就能直接從指定的檔案載入並覆蓋系統提示（給 AI 的預先指示）。

使用 `-p` 帶出提問時，現在把其他選項參數寫在 `-p` 後面也行，後面接上的多個單字還會自動串成同一句提示詞。如果只單獨打 `-p`，它則會改從標準輸入（從管線或上一步接進來的資料）讀取內容。⟦就像以前寄包裹得現場重填寄件人規定、順序還不能對調，現在直接夾上印好的規則單就行，補充說明放前放後都能一起收進單子裡。⟧
body.en:
If you want Grok to organize notes in a fixed format every time, you no longer need to retype a long block of rules in your command. Add the `--system-prompt-file <path>` flag to load and override the system prompt (advance instructions for the AI) directly from a specified file.

When using `-p` to pass a prompt, you can now place other option flags after `-p`, and any extra words following it are automatically joined into a single prompt. If you type `-p` by itself, it reads from stdin (data passed in from a pipeline or previous step) instead. ⟦Previously, shipping a package meant rewriting the sender's rules on the spot in a strict order, whereas now you can just clip on a printed rule sheet and any extra notes placed before or after still get included on the form.⟧

items.original:
`--system-prompt-file <path>` lets you load a system prompt override from a file
`-p` now accepts flags after it and joins any extra words into the prompt; bare `-p` reads from stdin

title.zh-TW: 多開工作階段時可直接切換與分支對話
title.en: Switch and fork conversations directly across multiple open sessions

body.zh-TW:
手邊一次開了多個工作階段（開啟中的對話）處理不同事情，以前剛開好的空白對話常常切換不過去。按下 `Ctrl+[` 和 `Ctrl+]`，就能切進所有已開啟的工作階段，就算裡面還沒輸入任何內容也一樣。

如果想針對另一個 Grok 視窗正開著的工作階段按 `Ctrl+F` 或輸入 `/fork`，現在不再直接跳出回合失敗的錯誤。畫面會改顯示提示，詢問你是否要直接將它分支成新對話。⟦跟在書桌上擺好幾疊草稿一樣，以前空白紙張總被跳過、別桌正在看的資料也不能直接影印一份，現在每一疊都翻得到，想複製開新頁也不會被擋下。⟧
body.en:
When you have multiple sessions (active conversations) open at once for different tasks, newly opened blank ones used to be unreachable when switching. Pressing `Ctrl+[` and `Ctrl+]` now cycles through all open sessions, even if nothing has been typed in them yet.

If you press `Ctrl+F` or type `/fork` on a session that another Grok window currently has open, it no longer immediately throws a turn-failed error. Instead, a notice appears asking whether you want to fork it into a new conversation. ⟦Picture having several stacks of drafts on a desk: blank sheets used to be skipped and papers someone else was reading at another table could not be photocopied, whereas now you can flip to every stack and copy one onto a fresh page without getting blocked.⟧

items.original:
`Ctrl+F` or `/fork` now offers to fork a session that another Grok window has open, shown as a notice instead of a turn-failed error
`Ctrl+[` and `Ctrl+]` now switch between all open sessions, including fresh ones that have no typed content yet

title.zh-TW: 歡迎畫面可直接用方向鍵操作選單
title.en: Navigate the welcome screen menu directly with arrow keys

body.zh-TW: 剛打開工具準備從起始畫面挑功能，游標還停在輸入提示列就能直接按方向鍵移動。不需要先把游標切離輸入位置，一進歡迎畫面就能照著選單項目往下選。
body.en: When you first open the tool to pick an option from the start screen, you can press the arrow keys to move while the cursor is still on the input prompt. You do not need to move the cursor away from the input area first—as soon as the welcome screen appears, you can step down through the menu items.

items.original: Arrow keys on the welcome screen now move through the menu directly from the prompt

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式 JSON 出錯仍保留已印回覆
title.en: Preserve printed reply text on headless JSON errors

body.zh-TW: 自動化腳本常會啟用無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗或視覺介面的執行模式），並指定以 JSON 這種結構化格式輸出結果。要是執行到一半發生錯誤，失敗前已經印出來的回覆文字現在會保留下來。⟦把這過程想成印表機出紙，以前印到一半卡紙就把整份抽走重來，現在已經印出來的那幾行都會留在出紙盤上。⟧
body.en: Automation scripts often enable headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface) and specify output in a structured format like JSON. If an error occurs midway through execution, any reply text already printed before the failure is now preserved. ⟦Think of this like a printer feeding paper: jamming halfway through used to mean pulling the whole sheet out and starting over, whereas now the lines already printed stay in the output tray.⟧

items.original: Headless JSON errors now preserve any reply text already printed before failure

title.zh-TW: Hooks 清單收合列直接顯示逾時與指令
title.en: Show timeouts and commands on collapsed Hooks list rows

body.zh-TW: 想快速確認目前設定了哪些自動化規則，打開 Hooks 清單（掛鉤，特定事件發生時會觸發的小程式）就能瀏覽。現在各列維持收合狀態時，畫面上還是會直接顯示每個掛鉤的逾時時間和執行指令，不必逐一展開來看。⟦翻找資料夾時，以前得把每個袋子拆開才看得到裡面裝什麼跟放多久，現在袋口標籤直接寫清楚了。⟧
body.en: To quickly check which automation rules are currently configured, you can open the Hooks list (small programs triggered by specific events) to browse them. Even while rows remain collapsed, the screen now directly displays each hook's timeout and command so you do not have to expand them one by one. ⟦When digging through folders, you used to have to open every pouch to see what was inside and how long it could stay, whereas now the label on the flap spells it out clearly.⟧

items.original: Hooks list now shows the timeout and command of each hook on collapsed rows
