title.zh-TW: Konsole 滑鼠滾輪改為每格捲動三行
title.en: Scroll three lines per mouse wheel notch in Konsole

body.zh-TW: 在 Konsole（一款終端機軟體）裡檢視長篇輸出並上下捲動畫面，現在滑鼠滾輪的節奏不會跟這個終端機本身不一樣了。只要滾輪轉動一格，畫面就會固定捲動三行，跟 Konsole 自己的行為完全一致。
body.en: When viewing long output and scrolling up or down in Konsole (a terminal emulator), the mouse wheel pace no longer differs from the terminal itself. Each notch of the wheel now scrolls a fixed three lines, matching Konsole's own behavior.

items.original: Mouse wheel in Konsole now scrolls three lines per notch, as in Konsole itself

title.zh-TW: 直接呼叫 MCP 工具過長結果會截斷並存檔
title.en: Truncate and save oversized direct MCP tool results to files

body.zh-TW: 直接呼叫 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具取回資料，有時會遇到回傳結果特別長的狀況。現在只要結果過長，就會先截斷並將這些結果寫進檔案裡。⟦店員印出超長明細時，以前整張紙條會拖得老長，現在小紙條只保留截斷後的前段，長內容另外裝進資料袋裡。⟧
body.en: When calling an MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) tool directly to fetch data, the returned result can sometimes be extra long. Now, whenever a result is too long, it gets truncated first and written out to a file. ⟦Imagine a clerk printing an extra-long receipt: the paper strip used to trail on forever, whereas now the slip only keeps the truncated front section and the full contents go into a separate folder.⟧

items.original: Direct MCP tool calls now truncate oversized results and spill them to files

title.zh-TW: /mcps 會顯示雲端連接器區且能重選權限
title.en: /mcps shows hosted connectors section and lets you re-select permissions

body.zh-TW: 還沒接上任何雲端服務，打開 `/mcps`（設定讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定介面）現在就看得到雲端連接器區塊。想替已經連上的雲端連接器重新驗證並挑一組新權限，只要先按 `i` 再按 `y` 就能重跑授權。⟦就像還沒裝任何外掛前，手機設定裡就先把空位留給你看；之後想改開放的權限，也不必刪掉重綁，直接重選就好。⟧
body.en: Even before you connect any cloud services, opening `/mcps` (the interface for configuring the protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) now shows the hosted connectors section. To re-authenticate a connected hosted connector and pick a fresh set of permissions, just press `i` and then `y` to run authorization again. ⟦Picture your phone settings leaving a placeholder slot visible before you install any plugins, and letting you change granted permissions later by re-selecting them directly instead of deleting and re-linking.⟧

items.original: `/mcps` now shows the hosted connectors section even before any have been added, and lets you re-authenticate a hosted connector with `i` then `y` to choose fresh permissions

title.zh-TW: 沙盒設定失敗改明確回報且支援 ~ 路徑
title.en: Sandbox setup failures are reported clearly and support ~ paths

body.zh-TW:
設定沙盒（隔離程式執行範圍的安全區）如果出錯，過去會安靜失敗，讓人無從查起。現在這些失敗都會直接顯示在歡迎畫面、標準錯誤輸出 `stderr`，還有 `/doctor` 檢查結果裡。

寫在允許路徑設定裡的 `~` 符號，現在會自動展開成你的家目錄路徑。要是在 `sandbox.toml` 寫了工具不認得的設定鍵，也會直接當成錯誤回報。⟦開長途時引擎燈以前壞了都不會亮，等於蒙眼開上路；現在只要零件異常或填錯規格，儀表板立刻亮燈提醒你哪裡有問題。⟧
body.en:
When configuring a sandbox (a safe zone that isolates where programs run) went wrong, it used to fail silently and leave you with no way to investigate. Now these failures appear directly on the welcome screen, in `stderr`, and in `/doctor` check results.

A `~` symbol written in allow path settings now automatically expands to your home directory path. If you write an unrecognized setting key in `sandbox.toml`, it is also reported directly as an error. ⟦On a long drive, a broken check-engine light used to leave you driving blind, whereas now the dashboard lights up right away to tell you where the problem is whenever a part acts up or a spec is entered wrong.⟧

items.original: Sandbox profile failures are reported on stderr, the welcome screen, and `/doctor` instead of failing silently; allow paths containing ~ expand to your home directory, and unknown keys in sandbox.toml are reported as errors

title.zh-TW: Grok Build 儲存與清除設定更乾淨
title.en: Grok Build saves and clears settings more cleanly

body.zh-TW: 在設定畫面改好選項並儲存，現在只會把你改過的欄位寫進 `config.toml`。要是把某個設定清空，`config.toml` 裡對應的設定鍵也會跟著刪掉。⟦跟批改考卷一樣，老師只用紅筆修改寫錯的那兩題，不會把整張考卷重新抄一遍；確定不要的條目就用立可白擦乾淨，不留空白格。⟧
body.en: After changing options on the settings screen and saving, only the fields you modified are now written to `config.toml`. If you clear a setting, its corresponding key in `config.toml` is deleted as well. ⟦Like a teacher grading an exam, the red pen only corrects the two wrong answers instead of rewriting the whole sheet, and unwanted entries are whited out cleanly without leaving blank boxes.⟧

items.original: Settings saves write only the keys you changed, and clearing a setting removes its key from config.toml

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式 --continue 的清單缺漏提示更明確
title.en: Headless --continue gives clearer messages for incomplete lists

body.zh-TW: 在無頭模式（沒有終端機視窗或視覺介面的執行模式）跑 `--continue`，過去本機工作階段清單確定缺漏時，畫面總會叫你重試。現在它會給出更清楚的錯誤說明，不再一律建議你重複嘗試。⟦包裹確認已經遺失時，過去查詢頁面還是照樣叫你稍後再試；現在客服會老實說明哪裡缺了資料，不再讓你一直重按查詢。⟧
body.en: When running `--continue` in headless mode (running without a terminal window or visual interface), the screen used to always tell you to retry when the local session list was confirmed incomplete. Now it gives a clearer error explanation instead of always suggesting you try again. ⟦When a package was confirmed lost, the tracking page used to still tell you to try again later, whereas customer support now honestly explains what information is missing instead of making you keep hitting search.⟧

items.original: Headless `--continue` gives a clearer message when the local session list is permanently incomplete instead of always suggesting a retry

title.zh-TW: worktree 分岔保留原本的工作階段標題
title.en: Worktree forks preserve the original session title

body.zh-TW: 你拉一條 `worktree`（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）出來做實驗時，來源工作階段可能剛好被改了名稱。現在就算來源工作階段在建立途中被改了名稱，新分岔出來的副本仍會保留原本的標題。⟦拿雙胞胎登記名字來比方，哥哥在報戶口中途臨時改了小名，弟弟的證件上還是會印著原本取好的名字。⟧
body.en: When you spin up a `worktree` (a Git feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project) to run an experiment, the source session might happen to be renamed. Now even if the source session is renamed while being created, the newly forked copy still keeps the original title. ⟦Think of registering twins: even if the older brother switches to a new nickname halfway through the paperwork, the younger brother's documents still print the name chosen originally.⟧

items.original: Worktree forks preserve the original session title even when the source is renamed during creation

title.zh-TW: 目標模式連 3 輪無進展會說明暫停原因
title.en: Goal mode explains why it paused after 3 rounds without progress

body.zh-TW: 把任務交給 Goal 自動執行，有時它會因為連續 3 個回合推不動而自己停下來。現在目標模式暫停後，畫面上會直接說明它自己停下來的原因。⟦以前洗衣機轉到一半突然停機，面板只亮一個靜止符號；現在停下來會順便顯示「排水孔卡住」，不必自己拆開猜。⟧
body.en: When you hand a task to Goal for automatic execution, it can sometimes stop on its own after 3 consecutive rounds without progress. Now when Goal mode pauses, the screen directly explains why it stopped itself. ⟦A washing machine used to stop mid-cycle with only a pause symbol on the panel, but now it also displays "drain clogged" when it stops so you do not have to take it apart to guess.⟧

items.original: Goal paused after 3 rounds without progress explains why it stopped itself

title.zh-TW: 模型被移除時工作階段自動改用其他模型
title.en: Sessions switch to another model when theirs is removed

body.zh-TW: 挑好一個 AI 聊到一半，手邊的可用清單偶爾會突然把你正在用的選項拿掉。遇到這種情況，這個工作階段（正在進行的一輪對話任務）現在會自動切換成其他模型。⟦本來約好使用的會議室臨時撤銷，大樓櫃檯直接幫這場會議換進另一間還能用的房間。⟧
body.en: Midway through chatting with a chosen AI, the available list can occasionally drop the option you are using. When this happens, the session (an ongoing round of conversation) now automatically switches to another model. ⟦Suppose a booked meeting room is suddenly canceled, and the building front desk moves the meeting straight into another available room.⟧

items.original: Sessions switch models when their model is removed from the available list

title.zh-TW: 登入與帳號識別後自動套用權限並收起條款提示
title.en: Permissions apply and terms notice hides after sign-in and account match

body.zh-TW:
遇到登入反應比較慢的情況，帳號、方案等級與存取權限就算在啟動完成後才送達，現在依然會完整套用。

等辨識出對應的帳號後，原本顯示在畫面上的服務條款提示也會自動消失。⟦去醫院掛號如果資料慢一步才連線成功，櫃檯人員現在收到健保卡資訊就會直接更新你的看診資格，不會因為開診時沒讀到就作廢。⟧
body.en:
When sign-in responds slowly, your account, plan tier, and access permissions are now still fully applied even if they arrive after startup finishes.

Once the matching account is identified, the terms of service notice shown on screen also disappears automatically. ⟦At a hospital check-in, if the connection is slow and your records arrive a step late, the front desk staff now update your visit eligibility as soon as your health card info comes through instead of voiding it because it was not read at opening time.⟧

items.original:
Terms notice disappears automatically once the matching account is known
Account, tier and access gate from a slow sign-in are applied even if they arrive after startup

title.zh-TW: 舊對話與 /compact 結果先於新提示顯示
title.en: Older history and /compact outcome appear before new prompts

body.zh-TW:
恢復較長的工作階段，先把提問放進排隊佇列裡，畫面上現在會先把較早之前的歷史紀錄顯示出來，接著才送出排隊中的提示。

執行 `/compact` 壓縮對話期間如果已經接著打下一句提示，壓縮完成的那一行結果現在也會排在你新打的提示前面，不會倒過來插在後面。⟦寫筆記時還沒翻回上一頁確認內容，新寫的備忘卻先插到前面會讓人看混；現在先把前文或總結墊在前面，後寫的話才接在底下。⟧
body.en:
When resuming a longer session with prompts already placed in the queue, the screen now displays the older history first before sending the queued prompts.

If you already typed the next prompt while running `/compact` to compress the conversation, the outcome line from the compaction now also appears ahead of your newly typed prompt instead of getting inserted after it. ⟦Imagine taking notes where a new memo gets inserted ahead of the previous page before you have checked it, which confuses the reader; now the earlier context or summary is placed first, and what you wrote later follows underneath.⟧

items.original:
Resumed long sessions show older history before queued prompts are sent
Outcome line for `/compact` appears before any prompt typed during the compaction

title.zh-TW: 子代理回覆顯示與訊息送出規則修正
title.en: Subagent reply display and message sending rules fixed

body.zh-TW:
在主畫面與子代理（協助分擔任務的分身代理）來回傳訊，回覆位置、標記寫法與斜線文字的處理方式都做了調整。

在子代理卡片上選 No 並附上文字回覆後，子代理的回應現在會顯示在主聊天室裡。

排隊等待送給子代理的訊息，過去會帶著排隊標籤和前後引號，現在這些多餘標示都拿掉了，標記文字改成顯示 read-only。

在子代理檢視畫面輸入長得像斜線指令的備註文字，以前會被拒絕送出，現在會當成一般純文字照常傳送。
body.en:
When exchanging messages between the main screen and a subagent (a helper agent that shares the workload), the reply location, marker wording, and handling of slash text have all been adjusted.

After selecting No with a text reply on a subagent card, the subagent's response now appears in the main chat.

Messages queued for a subagent used to carry a queued label and surrounding quotes, which have now been removed, and the marker text now reads read-only.

Entering note text that looks like a slash command in a subagent view used to be refused, but it is now sent as ordinary plain text as usual.

items.original:
Answering No with text on a subagent card shows the subagent reply in the main chat
Queued subagent messages no longer show the queued label or surrounding quotes; the marker reads read-only
Subagent views send slash-like notes as text instead of refusing them

title.zh-TW: 已停止的背景任務與 Shell 狀態顯示更準確
title.en: More accurate status for stopped background tasks and Shells

body.zh-TW:
因為離開工作階段而中斷的背景任務，現在在狀態上都會明確標記為 cancelled。

對於已經停止運作的 Shell，任務窗格以前還會繼續顯示一個憑空生出的執行時間。這個錯誤已經修好，Shell 結束後不會再出現假時長。
body.en:
Background tasks interrupted by leaving a session are now explicitly marked as cancelled in their status.

For a Shell that has already stopped running, the tasks pane previously continued to show an invented duration. This bug is fixed, so a fake duration no longer appears after a Shell ends.

items.original:
Background tasks interrupted by quitting a session show as cancelled
Tasks pane no longer shows an invented duration for a shell that is no longer running

title.zh-TW: 終端機輸入末行游標與 Tab 選中項不再消失
title.en: Terminal input last-row caret and Tab selection no longer disappear

body.zh-TW:
在提示輸入列一直打字直到填滿最後一行，輸入游標以前會突然不見，打字時找不到落點。這個問題已經修好，填滿最後一行時游標依然會正常顯示。

把終端機視窗縮得很矮時，按 Tab 叫出的補全清單以前會把目前選中的那一項遮住。現在即使在很矮的終端機視窗裡，選中的項目也不會再被藏起來。
body.en:
When typing in the prompt input line until the last row is full, the input caret previously vanished suddenly, leaving no visible spot while typing. This issue is fixed, so the caret still displays normally when the last row is filled.

When the terminal window is shrunk very short, the completion list opened with Tab previously covered the currently selected item. Now, even in a very short terminal window, the selected item is no longer hidden.

items.original:
Caret no longer disappears when typing fills the last row of the prompt
Tab completion list on very short terminals no longer hides the selected entry

title.zh-TW: 修正 LaTeX 數學公式括號與直線符號顯示錯誤
title.en: Fix LaTeX math bracket and vertical bar rendering errors

body.zh-TW: 在對話裡讀寫數學算式，過去碰到部分特殊排版語法常會渲染失敗。現在這類 LaTeX 數學公式已經修好，成對的直線符號、`\middle` 分隔指令以及角括號都會正常顯示。
body.en: When reading or writing math expressions in a conversation, certain special formatting syntax previously often failed to render. These LaTeX math formulas are now fixed, so paired vertical bars, the `\middle` delimiter command, and angle brackets all display properly.

items.original: LaTeX math renders paired bars, `\middle`, and angle brackets correctly

title.zh-TW: 移除本機提問卡片上多餘的自由輸入框
title.en: Remove extra free-text input on local question cards

body.zh-TW: 互動過程跳出問題要你回覆，畫面裡以前會附帶一格根本派不上用場的打字欄。現在這張本機提問卡片已經拿掉這個多餘的自由輸入框，畫面上不會再看到它。
body.en: When a question popped up for your reply during an interaction, the screen previously included a typing field that served no purpose. This local question card has now removed that extra free-text input, so it no longer appears on screen.

items.original: Local question cards no longer show an unused free-text input

title.zh-TW: Dashboard 彈窗鎖定焦點且擋下 Ctrl+\
title.en: Dashboard modals lock focus and block Ctrl+\

body.zh-TW: 打開 Dashboard 的彈跳視窗或挑選器後，鍵盤焦點現在會一直留在視窗內，直到視窗關閉為止。在關閉前如果按下 `Ctrl+\`，彈窗和挑選器也會直接攔截這個按鍵，不會傳到外層畫面。
body.en: After opening a Dashboard modal or picker, keyboard focus now stays inside the window until it is closed. If `Ctrl+\` is pressed before closing, the modal and picker also intercept that key directly so it does not pass through to the outer screen.

items.original: Dashboard modals and pickers keep keyboard focus and swallow Ctrl+\ until closed

title.zh-TW: 修正 Apple Terminal 的 Dashboard 列反白
title.en: Fix Dashboard row highlights in Apple Terminal

body.zh-TW: 在 Apple Terminal 裡開啟 Dashboard 瀏覽清單，每一列的反白高亮以前無法正常顯示出來。這個問題已經修好，現在在 Apple Terminal 裡看 Dashboard，列反白都能正常繪製。
body.en: When opening Dashboard to browse lists in Apple Terminal, the highlight for each row previously failed to display properly. This issue is fixed, so row highlights render normally when viewing Dashboard in Apple Terminal.

items.original: Dashboard row highlights render correctly in Apple Terminal

title.zh-TW: Muse Code 能從圖片生出 3D 模型檔
title.en: Muse Code can generate 3D model files from images

body.zh-TW: 手上有張產品草圖或物品照片，想轉成 3D 檔案放進簡報或網站卻不會建模嗎？只要你的帳號方案包含 3D 生成功能，現在直接拿一張圖片請 Muse Code 幫忙做 3D 模型，它就會幫你生出 `GLB`、`FBX` 或 `USDZ` 格式的檔案。⟦就像把物品正面照片交給翻模師傅，不用自己學雕刻工具，師傅就能直接按照片做出立體模型交給你。⟧
body.en: Have a product sketch or photo of an object you want as a 3D file for a slide deck or website, without knowing how to model? As long as your account plan includes 3D generation, you can now hand Muse Code an image and ask for a 3D model, and it will generate a `GLB`, `FBX`, or `USDZ` file for you. ⟦Picture handing a front-facing photo of an object to a mold maker: instead of learning sculpting tools yourself, they build the 3D model straight from the photo and hand it back.⟧

items.original: When your account includes 3D generation, ask for a 3D model and Muse Code makes a GLB, FBX or USDZ file from an image

title.zh-TW: 模型短暫斷線時對話會倒數等候不直接結束
title.en: Sessions wait with a countdown during brief model outages

body.zh-TW: 跑工作階段正順手，最怕模型突然短暫連線中斷、整個回合直接卡斷。現在遇到這種短暫斷線時，工作階段不會立刻結束回合，畫面上會出現清楚的倒數計時，撐過這段斷線後繼續往下跑。⟦好比通話途中車子剛好開進隧道，現在不會立刻掛斷電話，而是先告訴你剩幾秒恢復，出了隧道就接著講。⟧
body.en: When a session is running smoothly, nothing disrupts the flow like a brief model connection drop cutting off the whole turn. Now, during a brief outage like that, the session does not end the turn right away; instead, a clear countdown appears on screen so it can ride out the drop and keep going. ⟦Think of driving into a tunnel mid-call: instead of hanging up immediately, the call tells you how many seconds remain until the signal returns and picks right back up once you exit.⟧

items.original: Sessions now ride out a brief model outage inside the turn with a visible countdown instead of ending the turn

title.zh-TW: 中文或程式碼長對話會在爆窗前及時壓縮
title.en: Long code or CJK sessions now compact before overflowing

body.zh-TW: 貼進大段程式碼或中日韓文字聊長對話時，工作階段以前容易在還沒觸發壓縮前，就先撞上模型的上下文視窗上限。原因是在沒有提供代管網頁搜尋的請求裡，工作階段會丟棄供應商回報的實際提示長度。現在這項數值不再被丟棄，密集內容的工作階段就能趕在爆窗前完成壓縮。⟦換成裝箱寄貨時，箱裡早放滿鐵塊，以前店員沒看磅秤就硬塞到撐破，現在會先看準重量提早換大箱。⟧
body.en: When pasting large blocks of code or CJK text into a long session, the session previously tended to hit the model's context window limit before compaction could trigger. That happened because, in requests that offered no hosted web search, the session discarded the actual prompt size reported by the provider. Now that value is kept, so sessions with dense content can compact before overflowing the window. ⟦A shipping clerk packing a box full of iron blocks used to keep stuffing until the box burst without checking the scale, whereas now they check the weight first and switch to a larger box in time.⟧

items.original: Long sessions with dense content, such as code or CJK text, now compact before they overflow the model's context window. The session no longer discards the provider's reported prompt size when the request offered no hosted web search

title.zh-TW: 遠端橋接裝置不再取得主機殼層或全開權限
title.en: Remotely bridged devices no longer get a host shell or full permissions

body.zh-TW: 從另一台裝置透過信箱或遠端附加連進來操作時，安全性邊界現在收得更緊。透過這兩種方式橋接進來的裝置，不再能於主機上取得殼層操作權限，也不會拿到 `allowAll` 權限的工作階段。至於本機端原本的用戶端行為則完全維持不變。⟦彷彿把營業窗口跟後廚隔開，外部跑腿人員只能在窗口交接，走不進放著爐火與廚具的廚房；店內員工則照常進出。⟧
body.en: When you connect from another device through the mailbox or remote attach, the security boundary is now tighter. Devices bridged in through either method can no longer get shell access on the host or receive an `allowAll` session. Local clients, meanwhile, keep their existing behavior unchanged. ⟦Imagine separating a service counter from the back kitchen: outside couriers can only hand items over at the counter and cannot walk into the kitchen with its stoves and utensils, while in-house staff come and go as usual.⟧

items.original: A device bridged in over the mailbox or remote attach no longer gets a shell or an `allowAll` session on the host; local clients are unchanged

title.zh-TW: 從他處搬移 MCP 伺服器保留環境變數參照
title.en: Migrating MCP servers keeps environment variable references intact

body.zh-TW: 打算把原本在 Claude Code 或 Codex 設定好的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器搬來用嗎？以前搬移時遇到 `${VAR}` 這類變數參照，代理不是直接略過該伺服器，就是要求你貼上真實密鑰。現在搬移過程會直接把 `env`、`url` 和標頭裡的 `${VAR}` 參照原封不動留著。⟦跟搬家時只抄下「水電費自動扣款帳號代號」一樣，不用把銀行卡密碼抄在紙上交給別人，新家照樣能按代號扣款。⟧
body.en: Planning to bring over MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) servers you already configured in Claude Code or Codex? Previously, when a migration ran into variable references like `${VAR}`, the agent either skipped that server or asked you to paste the actual secret. Now the migration leaves `${VAR}` references in `env`, `url`, and header values intact. ⟦Moving into a new home works the same way if you only write down your utility autopay account code instead of handing someone your bank PIN on paper, so billing still goes through by code at the new place.⟧

items.original: When moving MCP servers over from Claude Code or Codex, the agent now keeps `${VAR}` references in `env`, `url`, and header values instead of leaving the server out or asking you to paste the secret

title.zh-TW: 用規劃技能寫設計文件改為每輪問一題
title.en: Planning a design doc with the plan skill asks one question per turn

body.zh-TW: 跟 AI 一起草擬方案，連續被追問往往讓人不知道先答哪個。現在用規劃技能寫設計文件，代理同一輪只會提出一個開放問題，不像以前一次最多問三題。
body.en: Drafting a proposal with AI can leave you unsure which question to answer first when several arrive at once. Now, when writing a design doc with the plan skill, the agent asks only one open question per turn instead of up to three at a time.

items.original: When the agent plans a design doc with the plan skill, it asks one open question per turn instead of up to three at once

title.zh-TW: 技能開關改用名稱儲存並補強路徑與警告
title.en: Skill toggles save by name with cleaner paths and warnings

body.zh-TW:
想固定技能的開關狀態，或自己寫了一份跟內建同名的技能嗎？

切換開關後，內建技能存為 `bundled:<id>`，外掛技能存為 `plugin:<plugin>:<skill>`，並清掉舊設定項目。搬動檔案仍有效；舊版會忽略這類開關。

內建技能路徑改為 `bundled://skills/<name>/SKILL.md`，不再列出內部套件名；舊的 `bundled://muse-core/...` 路徑與設定鍵仍可用。

`muse exec` 啟動時，若你的技能與內建同名，會提醒並附上 `bundled:<name>` 代碼供開啟內建版。

Windows 專案或使用者 `SKILL.md` 過大時，警告會列出實際超出容量，不再固定寫超出 1 位元組。
body.en:
Want to keep a skill's toggle state consistent, or wrote your own skill with the same name as a built-in one?

When you toggle a skill, built-in skills are saved as `bundled:<id>` and plugin skills as `plugin:<plugin>:<skill>`, clearing out older entries. Moving the files still works; older versions ignore switches saved this way.

Built-in skill paths now use `bundled://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` instead of naming an internal package; old `bundled://muse-core/...` paths and settings keys still work.

When `muse exec` starts up and your skill shares a name with a built-in one, it warns you and includes the `bundled:<name>` ID so you can still open the built-in version.

On Windows, when a project or user `SKILL.md` is too large, the warning now reports how much it actually exceeds the limit instead of always saying 1 byte over.

items.original:
Turning a skill on or off now saves it in settings under the skill's name (`bundled:<id>` for a built-in skill, `plugin:<plugin>:<skill>` for a plugin skill) and removes that skill's older entries, so the setting keeps working when a skill's files move; an older version ignores switches saved this way
Built-in skills show as `bundled://skills/<name>/SKILL.md` instead of naming an internal package; old `bundled://muse-core/...` paths and settings keys keep working
`muse exec` now also says at startup when your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, and shows the `bundled:<name>` id that still opens the built-in
On Windows, a too-large project or user `SKILL.md` warning now says how far over the limit the file really is, instead of always one byte over

title.zh-TW: 外掛獨立開關、異常停用與拒絕內建規則
title.en: Separate plugin toggles, safe fallback, and built-in rejection rules

body.zh-TW:
想單獨關掉內建功能，卻擔心設定出錯或撤銷不掉嗎？

`python-env` 與 `guidance-match-requested-length` 已拆為內建外掛，可用 `plugins.activation` 各自關閉。停用 `muse-core` 仍關閉兩者，自裝外掛不得用這兩代號。

讀不到設定檔時，外掛在當次執行一律停用，除非專案設定檔點名開啟，避免 hook（事件觸發的小程式）與連線伺服器意外啟動。

已安裝外掛的技能宣告 `replaces`，警告會點名外掛與該欄位，並忽略該欄位。

用 `muse plugins reject` 撤銷 `foreign-script-guard` 等編進執行檔的外掛，若無項可撤銷，會以 `builtin-plugin-not-revocable` 拒絕，並點名停用開關與環境變數；`muse-core` 仍報 0 筆成功。
body.en:
Want to turn off individual built-in features without worrying about broken settings or unrevocable plugins?

`python-env` and `guidance-match-requested-length` are now split into separate built-in plugins that you can disable individually via `plugins.activation`. Turning off `muse-core` still disables both, and self-installed plugins cannot use either ID.

When the settings file cannot be read, plugins stay disabled for that run unless a project settings file enables them by name, preventing hooks (small programs triggered by events) and connected servers from starting unexpectedly.

If an installed plugin's skill declares `replaces`, a warning names both the plugin and that field, and the field is ignored.

When you run `muse plugins reject` on a binary-compiled plugin like `foreign-script-guard` with nothing to revoke, it now refuses with `builtin-plugin-not-revocable` and names the disable switch and environment variable; `muse-core` still reports 0 items succeeded.

items.original:
An installed plugin that declares `replaces` on a skill entry now gets a warning naming the plugin and the field, and the field is ignored
The Python environment skill and the guidance that keeps a requested short answer short are now built-in plugins of their own, `python-env` and `guidance-match-requested-length`, so `plugins.activation` can turn each off by itself; settings that turn `muse-core` off still turn them off, and a plugin you install can no longer take either id
When the settings file cannot be read, plugins are switched off for that run unless a project settings file turns them on by name, so plugins you turned off cannot come back on with their hooks and connected servers
`muse plugins reject` on a plugin compiled into the binary (such as `foreign-script-guard`) with nothing to revoke now refuses (JSON error code `builtin-plugin-not-revocable`) and names the product gate and the environment variable that switch it off, instead of printing a count-0 rejection that changed nothing; bundled plugins such as `muse-core` keep the count-0 success

title.zh-TW: Three.js 與 3D 技能不再推薦舊陰影類型
title.en: Three.js and 3D skills drop deprecated shadow-map type

body.zh-TW: 內建的 Three.js 與 3D 視覺技能以前在建立立體場景會推薦一種現行 Three.js 已經棄用的陰影貼圖類型，導致主控台跳出警告。這兩項技能已經更新，現在不會再推薦該舊類型，做出來的場景既能保留柔和陰影，主控台也不會再出現這類警告。
body.en: The built-in Three.js and 3D visuals skills previously recommended a shadow-map type for 3D scenes that current Three.js has deprecated, triggering console warnings. Both skills have been updated and no longer recommend that old type, so generated scenes keep soft shadows without those console warnings.

items.original: The bundled Three.js and 3D visuals skills no longer recommend a shadow-map type that current three.js has deprecated, so scenes built from them keep soft shadows without a console warning

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段時補齊狀態說明並重啟 MCP
title.en: Session resume clarifies status and restarts MCP servers

body.zh-TW:
開著多個視窗或曾啟動失敗的舊對話，現在用恢復指令更容易接續。

執行 `/resume` 列出紀錄時，若有些工作階段正開在另一個 Muse 行程裡而被略過，現在會直接顯示略過了幾個。就算只剩這類工作階段，也不會再誤報 `No saved sessions found`。

用 `muse resume` 恢復在啟動階段就中斷的工作階段時，如果當時沒有對話遺失，它現在會直接說明這一點，不再只回報沒有存下紀錄。

先前行程若在 MCP 伺服器啟動到一半時結束，現在恢復該工作階段時會重新啟動那些伺服器，不再讓 MCP 保持停用、進而在有必備伺服器時拒絕執行回合。
body.en:
Older conversations left open across multiple windows or interrupted during startup are now easier to pick up with resume commands.

When `/resume` lists saved logs and skips sessions that are currently open in another Muse process, it now reports how many were skipped. Even if only those sessions exist, it no longer falsely reports `No saved sessions found`.

When `muse resume` restores a session that stopped during startup and no conversation was lost, it now states that directly instead of only reporting that no log was saved.

If the previous process ended while MCP servers were still starting up, resuming that session now restarts those servers instead of leaving MCP disabled and refusing turns when a server is required.

items.original:
`/resume` says how many sessions open in another Muse process it left out, and no longer reports "No saved sessions found" when those are the only ones
`muse resume` explains when a session stopped during startup and no conversation was lost, instead of only reporting that no log was saved
Resuming a session whose earlier process ended while its MCP servers were starting now starts them again, instead of leaving MCP disabled and refusing turns when a server is required

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮與重開後保留資料並消除誤報
title.en: Data retention and false-error fixes after compaction and session reopening

body.zh-TW:
把長對話壓縮或是關掉工作階段重新開啟後，狀態顯示與資料保留都已經修好。

壓縮時若遇到附帶影片的長訊息，完整文字現在會比照一般長訊息存下來。標註檔名的那一行也會像處理圖片那樣，寫明影片本身沒有被保存。

恢復已完成壓縮的工作階段時，旁邊不再誤出現 `runtime closed before context compaction completed` 錯誤列。

重新開啟已經壓縮完畢的工作階段時，畫面也不再誤顯示上下文壓縮未完成的訊息。

壓縮工作階段、離開再重新打開後，`/workflows` 清單裡仍會保留原本的工作流名稱、階段計畫與代理列，不再變成空白。
body.en:
Status display and data retention are now fixed after compacting a long conversation or closing and reopening a session.

When a long message with an attached video is compacted, its full text is now saved just like any other long message. The line that names the file also notes that the video itself was not saved, matching how images are handled.

Resuming a session that has already finished compaction no longer shows a false `runtime closed before context compaction completed` error row beside it.

Reopening a session whose compaction has already finished no longer falsely shows a message saying context compaction did not complete.

After compacting a session, quitting, and reopening it, `/workflows` still keeps the original workflow names, phase plan, and agent rows instead of turning into an empty list.

items.original:
When a long message with a video attached is shortened at compaction, its full text is now saved like any other long message, and the line naming the file says the video was not saved, as it already did for images
A resumed session whose compaction completed no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error row beside it
Reopening a session no longer says context compaction failed to complete when it finished
After compacting, quitting and reopening a session, its Workflows stay listed in `/workflows` with their names, phase plan and agent rows instead of an empty list

title.zh-TW: 背景指令的輸出讀取與引用預覽不再混雜
title.en: Cleaner output reading and quoted previews for background commands

body.zh-TW:
回頭翻閱背景指令留下的紀錄，指令本文與輸出現在不會混在一起。

即使背景指令一併存下了完整的執行指令，現在依然能正常讀到它另外存下來的輸出內容。

背景指令文字裡原本的引用參考行，現在會完整保留下來不被清掉。

重新接回舊工作階段時，背景指令的預覽內容會把引用的錯誤細節排除在外；較舊的工作階段在協定中也不再把指令文字標成完整的工具輸出。
body.en:
When you look back at records left by background commands, the command text and its output no longer get mixed together.

Even when a background command also saves the full command that was run, its separately saved output can still be read normally.

Quoted reference lines in background command text are now preserved in full instead of being stripped out.

When reconnecting to an older session, background command previews leave out quoted error details; older sessions also no longer mark command text as full tool output in the session protocol.

items.original:
Read saved output of a background command even when its full command is also saved
Preserve quoted reference lines in background command text
Older sessions no longer advertise command text as full tool output in the session protocol
Keep quoted error details out of resumed background command previews

title.zh-TW: 背景指令結束後會補送通知與最終摘要
title.en: Guaranteed completion notices and final summaries for background commands

body.zh-TW:
背景指令已經跑完，你不用再擔心模型漏接結束消息或交出空白結尾。

當背景指令結束後，若把完成通知寫進工作階段時曾失敗一次，下次報告時這則通知依然會送達模型；以前一旦存檔失敗，模型就永遠不會知道指令已經結束。

若背景指令在該回合結束後才完成，而且代理對結果的回覆剛好是空的，它現在會補寫一段簡短的最終摘要，不再毫無回應就結束。⟦像請同事去列印大批文件，就算第一次沒交回條或忘記在群組留言，下次匯報時進度單照樣會補交到桌上，最後也會附上一句結果說明，不會石沉大海。⟧
body.en:
Once a background command finishes, you no longer have to worry about the model missing the completion notice or ending with a blank reply.

When a background command finishes and saving its completion notice to the session fails once, the notice still reaches the model on the next report; previously, if saving failed, the model would never know the command had ended.

If a background command finishes after the turn ends and the agent's reply to the result happens to be empty, it now writes a short final summary instead of ending with no response. ⟦Asking a colleague to print a large batch of documents works the same way: even if they miss handing in the slip the first time or forget to post in the group chat, the progress sheet still lands on your desk at the next check-in, and a brief note on the result is included at the end instead of vanishing without a trace.⟧

items.original:
When a background command finishes after the turn ends and the agent's reply to its result is empty, the agent now writes a short final summary instead of ending with no answer
When a background command finishes and saving its completion notice to the session fails once, the notice now reaches the model on the next report; before, the model was never told the command had ended

title.zh-TW: 子代理訊息排隊、背景喚醒與最新回覆修復
title.en: Fixes for subagent message queuing, background wakeups, and latest replies

body.zh-TW:
交辦給子代理的任務在傳訊、壓縮或重開工作階段後，現在都能正常接上進度。

代理替子代理把訊息排進佇列時，工具結果現在只會說明訊息已排隊，不再顯示容易讓代理誤認成訊息編號的內部追蹤號。

設有目標時，子代理被自身背景工作喚醒並進行壓縮時，不會再存下損壞的檢查點，免得工作階段讀不到子代理或讓 `exec` 報錯結束。

有後續追問的子代理壓縮自身紀錄並重開工作階段後，讀取結果會回傳最新回答，不再誤判為過期；較早版本存下的工作階段仍會顯示過期。
body.en:
Tasks delegated to a subagent can now pick up cleanly after messaging, compaction, or reopening a session.

When an agent queues a message for a subagent, the tool result now only states that the message was queued and no longer shows an internal tracking number that the agent could mistake for a message ID.

When a goal is set, a subagent woken by its own background work and performing compaction no longer saves a broken checkpoint, preventing the session from failing to read the subagent or causing `exec` to exit with an error.

After a subagent with follow-up questions compacts its own history and the session is reopened, reading its result now returns the latest answer instead of falsely marking it as out of date; sessions saved by earlier versions still show as out of date.

items.original:
When the agent queues a message for a subagent, the tool result now says the message was queued for the subagent instead of naming an internal tracking number the agent could mistake for the message's id
When a goal is set, a subagent woken by its own background work no longer saves a broken checkpoint as it compacts, which could stop the session from reading the subagent and end an `exec` run with an error
After a subagent with follow-ups compacts its own history and the session is reopened, reading that subagent's result now returns its latest answer instead of saying the result is out of date; sessions saved by earlier versions still say it is out of date

title.zh-TW: 手動停止的子代理一律改為顯示 stopped
title.en: Manually stopped subagents now consistently show stopped

body.zh-TW: 在系統裡中斷分派出去的任務後，回頭檢查 `/subagents` 清單與詳情頁，以前卻會看到令人疑惑的 `cancelled` 字樣。現在無論是一般或巢狀子代理，只要是由你親手停掉，兩處畫面都會改為顯示 `stopped`，與實際的工作狀態一致。
body.en: After stopping a delegated task in the system, checking the `/subagents` list and detail view used to show a confusing `cancelled` label. Now, whether it is a regular or nested subagent, as long as you stopped it yourself, both views display `stopped` to match its actual work status.

items.original:
In `/subagents` and the subagent detail view, a subagent you stopped now reads `stopped` instead of `cancelled`, matching its work status
In `/subagents`, a nested subagent you stopped now reads `stopped` instead of `cancelled`, matching its work status

title.zh-TW: Shell 指令啟動失敗提醒與結束清理更明確
title.en: Clearer shell startup failure alerts and exit cleanup

body.zh-TW:
在 Linux 上，沙盒若因資料夾位置被空檔案（如 `~/.config`）佔住而失敗，錯誤會點名該檔案，並提示等其他沙盒指令都結束後刪除重跑。

未安裝 `zsh` 等原因導致指令無法啟動時，錯誤訊息會直接指出失敗的程式與資料夾，不再只顯示 `No such file or directory`。

按下 Esc 中斷或逾時後，若無法確認處理程序是否結束，指令仍顯示取消或逾時，另外附上清理未確認的訊息 `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`，讓你和模型知道衍生程式可能還在跑。

在 Windows 退出 `tbh` 或結束 `tbh exec` 時，未開沙盒的 PowerShell 背景工作階段啟動的程式也會一併結束，不再留在背景。這與 macOS、Linux 原本的處理一致。
body.en:
On Linux, if the sandbox fails because an empty file such as `~/.config` is occupying a needed directory path, the error names that file and tells you to delete it and rerun once all other sandboxed commands have finished.

When a command fails to start because `zsh` is not installed or for similar reasons, the error message now points directly to the failing program and folder instead of only showing `No such file or directory`.

After interrupting with Esc or hitting a timeout, if it cannot be confirmed that the processes have ended, the command still shows as cancelled or timed out and adds `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`, letting you and the model know spawned programs may still be running.

On Windows, quitting `tbh` or finishing `tbh exec` now also terminates programs started by an unsandboxed PowerShell background session instead of leaving them in the background. This matches how macOS and Linux already behave.

items.original:
On Linux, when a sandboxed shell command cannot start because an empty file such as `~/.config` sits where a directory is needed, the error now names that file and says to remove it and run the command again once no sandboxed command is running
When a shell command cannot start, for example because `zsh` is not installed, the error now names the program and folder that failed instead of only "No such file or directory"
When you stop a shell command (Esc, or it hits its time limit) and its processes cannot be confirmed to have ended, the command still shows as cancelled or timed out, and now also shows `cleanup not confirmed: <reason>`, so you and the model know something it started may still be running
On Windows, quitting tbh or finishing `tbh exec` now also ends the programs a background PowerShell session started (run without the sandbox), as it already did on macOS and Linux, instead of leaving them running

title.zh-TW: 關閉沙盒時的起始權限提示改寫為使用者範圍
title.en: Startup permission note scoped to current user when sandbox is off

body.zh-TW: 關掉 Shell 沙盒時，工作階段一開始顯示的權限說明以前會寫成指令可以修改主機上的任何檔案。現在這段文字改得更準確，只會說明指令能修改目前這位使用者在這台主機任何位置有權寫入的檔案。
body.en: When the shell sandbox is turned off, the permission note shown at the start of a session used to state that commands could modify any file on the host. That text is now more accurate, stating only that commands can modify files that the current user has permission to write anywhere on this host.

items.original: With the shell sandbox off, the session-start permission note now says a command can change any file this user can write, anywhere on this host, instead of claiming it can change any file on the host

title.zh-TW: 修正任務列多餘標籤與工具重試標記
title.en: Fixes for stray task row labels and tool retry marks

body.zh-TW:
在終端機觀察執行進度或下載檔案時，畫面上終於不會再出現讓人誤判的殘留文字或錯誤圖示。

指令只印出一行空白行時，任務列不會再多出孤零零的 `output:` 或 `status:` 字樣。

用 `web_fetch` 存下 PDF 這類二進位檔案時，回傳結果不再提到這個工具並不接受的提示詞。

被修正並重試的呼叫若重試成功，畫面會改為顯示成功標記；要是重試後的指令本身依然失敗，則會保留失敗標記。
body.en:
When watching execution progress or downloading files in the terminal, misleading leftover text and wrong icons no longer appear on screen.

When a command prints only a blank line, task rows no longer show a stray `output:` or `status:` label.

When using `web_fetch` to save a binary file such as a PDF, the returned result no longer mentions a prompt that the tool does not accept.

If a corrected and retried call succeeds on retry, the UI switches to a success mark; if the retried command itself still fails, it keeps the failure mark.

items.original:
Task rows no longer show a stray output: or status: word when a command printed only a blank line
When `web_fetch` saves a binary file such as a PDF, its result no longer mentions a prompt the tool does not take
A corrected call shows the success mark when its retry succeeded, and keeps the failure mark when the retried command itself failed

title.zh-TW: Windows 乾淨 worktree 結束後會正確清除
title.en: Clean worktrees on Windows now remove properly on exit

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 用 `--worktree create` 建立乾淨的 worktree（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，工作階段結束後原本應該自動清掉。但以前清理常會因為 `Permission denied` 失敗，導致這個工作區被留在原地。這個問題已經修好，現在這類乾淨的工作區會在工作階段結束時正確移除。
body.en: On Windows, when creating a clean worktree (a feature that lets you open multiple parallel copies of the same project) with `--worktree create`, it is supposed to be cleaned up automatically after the session ends. Previously, cleanup often failed with `Permission denied`, leaving the workspace behind. That issue is now fixed, and clean workspaces like this are properly removed when the session ends.

items.original: On Windows, a clean `--worktree create` session worktree is now removed when the session ends instead of being kept after a "Permission denied" cleanup failure

title.zh-TW: 停寫紀錄時不再新增指定空目錄與離開紀錄
title.en: No extra empty folders or exit records when session logging is off

body.zh-TW:
你加上 `--no-session-log` 跑完後，以前資料夾裡還是會多出幾個用不到的項目。

在 Linux 或 macOS 終端機或執行 `exec` 時加上這個參數，不會再於資料夾裡建出空的 `session-server` 和 `runtime` 資料夾。

用 `tbh serve`（含 `--listen` 模式）搭配 `--no-session-log` 啟動時，不會再把 `serve-exit.jsonl` 寫進資料夾。它仍會在標準錯誤輸出印出離開原因。

⟦就像退租時說好不留任何雜物，以前房客走後桌上還是會擺幾個空紙箱和一張退房單，現在房間裡乾乾淨淨，只剩門口口頭交代一句離開原因。⟧
body.en:
After running with `--no-session-log`, a few unused items used to still show up in your folder.

Adding this flag in the Linux or macOS terminal or when running `exec` no longer creates empty `session-server` and `runtime` folders in that directory.

When starting `tbh serve` with `--no-session-log`, including `--listen` mode, `serve-exit.jsonl` is no longer written to the folder. It still prints the exit reason to standard error.

⟦When a tenant moves out after agreeing to leave nothing behind, there used to still be a few empty cardboard boxes and a checkout slip left on the table; now the room is completely empty, with only a quick spoken note at the door explaining why they left.⟧

items.original:
On Linux or macOS, `--no-session-log` in the terminal or `exec` no longer creates empty `session-server` and `runtime` folders in your data folder
A `tbh serve` host started with `--no-session-log`, including `--listen`, no longer writes its exit record (`serve-exit.jsonl`) into your data folder; it still prints why it exited on stderr

title.zh-TW: muse serve 模型判定與目標排程工具啟動
title.en: muse serve Model Selection and Goal and Cron Tool Startup

body.zh-TW:
透過 `muse serve` 提供的工作階段，在模型判斷與啟動檢查上現在更貼近終端機介面。

挑選審核批示用的模型時，`muse serve` 現在會比照終端機介面從工作階段本身與模型目錄來選，不再一律拿主機的預設模型來審核。

搭配 Meta 模型與模型清單讀取時，`muse serve` 會按啟動時使用的模型視窗來回報上下文用量（清單沒列出的模型也算），不再誤用預設模型視窗或乾脆不回報。

若 `muse serve` 工作階段的工具清單指定了內建的目標或排程工具（如 `report_progress` 或 `cron_list`），現在能正常啟動，不會再報未知工具名稱錯誤。
body.en:
Sessions served through `muse serve` now match the terminal interface more closely for model selection and startup checks.

When picking a model for approval reviews, `muse serve` now selects from the session itself and the model catalog just like the terminal interface, instead of always using the host's default model.

When working with a Meta model and reading a model list, `muse serve` reports context usage against the context window of the model it starts with (including models not on the list), rather than falling back to the default model's window or reporting nothing.

If a `muse serve` session's tool list specifies a built-in goal or cron tool (such as `report_progress` or `cron_list`), it now starts normally instead of failing with an unknown tool names error.

items.original:
Sessions served by `muse serve` now pick the approval reviewer's model as the TUI does, from the session's model and the model catalog, instead of always reviewing on the host's default model
With a Meta model and a model list to read, `muse serve` reports context usage against the window of the model it starts with, including a model the list does not show, instead of the default model's window or none
`muse serve` sessions whose `run.toolset` names a goal or cron tool the session provides, such as `report_progress` or `cron_list`, now start instead of failing with an unknown tool names error

title.zh-TW: 回溯忙碌的工作階段不會再無限期枯等
title.en: Rewinding a Busy Session No Longer Waits Indefinitely

body.zh-TW: 想從某個工作階段倒帶回溯時，如果來源工作階段當時太忙、騰不出手來處理，以前畫面會一直乾等下去。這個問題已經修好，現在只要超過請求逾時時間就會直接回報失敗，不會再無止境卡住。
body.en: Previously, when rewinding from a session that was too busy to handle the request, the interface would wait indefinitely. This is now fixed so it fails once the request timeout is reached instead of hanging forever.

items.original: A rewind no longer waits forever when the session it starts from is too busy to take it; it now fails after the request timeout

title.zh-TW: 正式版不再誤套測試設定而暫停寫入紀錄
title.en: Release Builds No Longer Pause History Writes From Test Settings

body.zh-TW: 在正式發行的軟體版本中，以前若不慎繼承到開發時的實驗參數，程式可能會假裝磁碟空間已滿，或是突然停止記錄工作階段歷史。這項異常已經修復，正式發行版不會再被這些測試設定影響。
body.en: In release builds, inheriting experimental development settings by mistake could previously cause the app to simulate a full disk or stop recording session history. This issue is now fixed so release builds are no longer affected by those test settings.

items.original: Inherited test settings no longer simulate a full disk or pause session history writes in release builds

title.zh-TW: 協定開發者：壓縮後可正確呈現巢狀子代理
title.en: Protocol Developers: Nested Subagents Display Properly After Compaction

body.zh-TW:
給串接工作階段協定的開發者：經過壓縮的工作階段在讀取或恢復後，被裁減的子代理資料現在更能還原階層與狀態。

在壓縮過的工作階段回傳裡，被裁減的子代理會帶上已知的自身識別碼；若是巢狀子代理，已知的父代理識別碼也會附上，讓用戶端能將它排在父代理底下。

當工作階段經過第二次壓縮後，在兩次壓縮之間就已完成的子代理會正確標為已完成，不再誤顯示為執行中。跨越壓縮分界才記錄到啟動的已完成子代理也會被保留，並同樣帶出巢狀子代理的父代關聯。⟦跟把厚厚的會議紀錄一再濃縮一樣，雖然內文變精簡了，外包團隊的完工狀態與上下級隸屬關係仍會清楚附在後面，不會讓人分不清誰歸誰管。⟧
body.en:
For developers integrating the session protocol: after reading or resuming a compacted session, pruned subagent data now better restores hierarchy and status.

In responses for compacted sessions, a pruned subagent now includes its own ID when known, and for a nested subagent, its parent subagent ID is also included when known so clients can display it under its parent.

When a session goes through a second compaction, subagents that finished between the two compactions are now accurately marked as finished rather than shown as running. Finished subagents whose spawn was recorded across the compaction boundary are also preserved, along with parent links for nested subagents. ⟦Much like condensing thick meeting minutes over and over, even though the main text gets shorter, the completion status and reporting hierarchy of outsourced teams stay clearly attached at the end so no one loses track of who reports to whom.⟧

items.original:
On a compacted `session/read` or `session/resume`, a `prunedSubagents` entry now carries the subagent's own `subagentId` and, for a nested subagent, its parent's `parentSubagentId` when they are known, so a client can show a pruned nested subagent under its parent
After a session is compacted a second time, the `prunedSubagents` list on `session/read` and `session/resume` shows a subagent that finished between the two compactions as finished instead of running, keeps a finished subagent whose spawn was recorded across the cut, and lists the parent of a pruned nested subagent so the nested subagent shows under it

title.zh-TW: 協定開發者：分支參數、目標時間與回合數更新
title.en: Protocol Developers: Fork Parameters, Goal Timestamps, and Turn Counts

body.zh-TW:
給串接工作階段協定的開發者：工作階段的分支、目標通知與回合統計欄位都有補充。

建立工作階段分支時，現在比照啟動與恢復工作階段，可以傳入新工作階段的模型與設定（屬實驗性欄位）。若模型遭拒或有設定未套用，回應裡也會分別附上拒絕說明與警告訊息。

代理透過目標工具修改目標後，收到的目標變更通知現在會一併帶上該目標的建立時間與更新時間。

列出、讀取或恢復工作階段時，回傳的回合總數現在會把每一輪都算進去，包含失敗的回合、被打斷且撤回的回合，以及仍在執行中的回合。
body.en:
For developers integrating the session protocol: session forking, goal notifications, and turn count fields have all been expanded.

When forking a session, you can now pass the new session's model and configuration just like when starting or resuming a session (experimental fields). If the model is refused or any settings are not applied, the response also includes a refusal explanation and warning messages.

After an agent modifies a goal through goal tools, the goal-changed notification now also includes that goal's created and updated times.

When listing, reading, or resuming a session, the returned total turn count now includes every turn, including failed turns, interrupted and withdrawn turns, and turns still running.

items.original:
`session/fork` takes the new session's `modelId` and `config` like `session/start` and `session/resume`, reports a refused model in `modelIdRefusal` and unapplied settings in `warnings` (experimental members)
The `session/goalChanged` notification now carries the goal's created and updated times after the agent's goal tools change it
`session/list`, `session/read` and `session/resume` count every turn of a session in `turnCount`, including a turn that failed, one that was interrupted and withdrawn, and one still running

title.zh-TW: 協定開發者：工作區開新工作階段減少掃描外掛
title.en: Protocol Developers: Fewer Plugin Scans When Starting Workspace Sessions

body.zh-TW: 給串接協定的開發者：當專案裡裝了大量擴充套件，每次建立新對話的等待時間現在可以縮短了。系統在整理指示時不再多跑一輪檢查，整體啟動流程少掃描一次已安裝外掛，工作階段能更快進入就緒狀態。
body.en: For developers integrating the protocol: when a project has many extensions installed, the wait time when starting a new conversation is now shorter. The system no longer runs an extra check while resolving instructions, so the overall startup flow scans installed plugins one time fewer and the session becomes ready sooner.

items.original:
A session started over the session protocol in a workspace scans the installed plugins one time fewer, so it is ready sooner when many plugins are installed
A new session started over the session protocol in a workspace no longer scans the installed plugins again just to resolve its developer instructions, so it is ready sooner when many plugins are installed

title.zh-TW: exec --list-models 列出模型清單
title.en: exec --list-models lists available models

body.zh-TW: 在終端機執行 `exec` 卻不小心打錯 `--model` 的名稱，不用退出畫面也能補救。執行 `exec --list-models` 會一行一個印出供應商提供的所有模型 ID，照著改對再重跑即可。⟦就像在飲料店唸錯品項時，直接看一眼櫃檯價目表，就能立刻改點正確的那一杯。⟧
body.en: If you run `exec` in the terminal and mistype the `--model` name, you can fix it without leaving the screen. Running `exec --list-models` prints every model ID your provider offers, one per line, so you can correct it and rerun. ⟦Picture mispronouncing a drink name at a beverage shop: one glance at the counter menu lets you immediately reorder the right cup.⟧

items.original: `exec --list-models` prints the model IDs your provider offers, one per line, so a mistyped `--model` is recoverable without leaving the terminal

title.zh-TW: 太久的 MCP 呼叫可先轉入背景執行
title.en: Move slow MCP calls to the background

body.zh-TW: 遇到某個 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）工具呼叫跑太久，現在不必乾等它卡住整個對話。按下 `Ctrl+B` 或直接送出下一則訊息，這個呼叫就會轉入背景繼續跑，等它跑完，結果會自動接回原本的對話裡。⟦好比在餐廳點了需要現做的餐點，拿到震動叫號器就能先回座位聊天，不用一直罰站等在櫃檯前。⟧
body.en: When an MCP (a protocol that lets AI connect to external tools) tool call takes too long, you no longer have to sit and wait while it blocks the whole conversation. Press `Ctrl+B` or simply send your next message to move the call into the background, and its result will rejoin the conversation once it finishes. ⟦Think of ordering a made-to-order dish at a restaurant: once they hand you a buzzer, you can head back to your table and chat instead of standing by the counter.⟧

items.original: A slow MCP tool call can move to the background with Ctrl+B or when you send another message, and its result joins the conversation when it finishes

title.zh-TW: 技能與驗證提醒改為預設關閉
title.en: Skill and verify reminders are now off by default

items.original: The skill and verify reminders are now off by default, so turns end without the verify check's wait and sessions spend fewer tokens on skill suggestions. Turn either back on in `/plugins` or by setting `plugins.skill-reminder.enabled` or `plugins.verify-reminder.enabled` to `true` in `settings.json`

title.zh-TW: 過長輸出統一改用截斷與存檔區塊呈現
title.en: Long output now uses unified truncation and saved blocks

body.zh-TW:
跑指令、讀檔或抓網頁一次吐出大量內容時，對話視窗常被塞滿。

指令的過長輸出改以 `<persisted-output>` 或 `<truncated-output>` 區塊傳給模型，顯示頭尾內容與略過大小。

讀檔、搜尋等工具的過長輸出，會用簡短的 `<persisted-output>` 區塊標出完整檔案，無法存檔時改用 `<truncated-output>`。

截斷的背景指令通知、Monitor 事件與抓取網頁，也在 `<persisted-output>` 區塊列出完整存檔。

終端機指令失敗且沙盒指引超過上限時，會保留已儲存的輸出，並回報訊息已縮短。⟦如同收到幾百頁的厚重紙本報告時，郵差只先遞給你附頭尾摘要的索引單，完整原文則收進檔案櫃供隨時調閱。⟧
body.en:
When running a command, reading a file, or fetching a web page dumps a lot of content at once, the chat window often gets flooded.

Long command output now goes to the model in a `<persisted-output>` or `<truncated-output>` block, showing the beginning, the end, and the size of the omitted part.

Long output from file reads, searches, and other tools uses a short `<persisted-output>` block pointing to the full file, or `<truncated-output>` when nothing can be saved.

Truncated background command notices, Monitor events, and fetched web pages also list the saved full file in a `<persisted-output>` block.

When a terminal command fails and the sandbox guidance exceeds the limit, the saved output is kept and the message reports that it was shortened. ⟦A courier handing over a massive paper report works the same way: you first get an index sheet with the opening and closing summary, while the full original goes into a filing cabinet for whenever you want to pull it.⟧

items.original:
Long command output now reaches the model in the same `<persisted-output>` or `<truncated-output>` block, showing its start and end and the size of the part left out
Long output from file reads, searches and other tools now reaches the model as a short `<persisted-output>` block that names the file holding the full output, or a `<truncated-output>` block when nothing could be saved
Background command notices, Monitor events and fetched web pages that had to be cut now name the saved full output in the same `<persisted-output>` block
A shell command that fails with sandbox guidance longer than the output limit keeps its saved output and reports that the message was shortened

title.zh-TW: 內建技能新舊代號與企業名單規則更新
title.en: Updated built-in skill IDs and enterprise list rules

body.zh-TW:
在設定檔、受管技能檔或企業允許與封鎖清單裡，現在都能寫入內建技能的 `bundled:<id>` 與舊寫法。寫進 `allowed_identities` 的技能不管 `allowed_sources` 設定都會放行，想保留特定技能直接列在這裡即可。該處若寫舊寫法只代表內建技能而不含同名使用者技能，但寫進 `denied_identities` 則兩者都擋。

受管技能檔若把同一技能寫了兩次，例如新舊寫法並存或同時列出 `plugin:<pkg>:<skill>` 與路徑，該檔案仍會保留。兩邊設定值相同就照常套用，互相衝突就會關閉該技能並跳出列出兩個鍵名的警告。開關或重設內建技能時，設定檔裡其他寫法也會跟著移除。⟦彷彿公司換發新式員工證時，舊編號仍暫時通用，但只要同一人的兩張通行證權限打架，門禁就會先鎖卡並通知管理員。⟧
body.en:
In settings files, managed skill files, or enterprise allow and deny lists, you can now specify a built-in skill using `bundled:<id>` or its older spellings. Skills listed in `allowed_identities` are admitted regardless of `allowed_sources`, so you can list any specific skill there to keep it available. An older spelling in `allowed_identities` refers only to the built-in skill and not a user skill with the same name, whereas in `denied_identities` it blocks both.

If a managed skill file lists the same skill twice, such as mixing old and new spellings or placing `plugin:<pkg>:<skill>` alongside its path, the file is still kept. Matching values apply as normal, while conflicting values turn that skill off and raise a warning naming both keys. Turning a built-in skill on or off, or resetting it, also removes its other spellings from that settings file. ⟦Imagine a company issuing new staff badges where old ID numbers still work for now, yet the moment one person's two passes have conflicting permissions, the door system locks the card and alerts an admin.⟧

items.original: Settings, managed skill files and enterprise allow and deny lists accept a built-in skill's `bundled:<id>` name and its older spellings, and a skill named in `allowed_identities` is admitted whatever `allowed_sources` says (an older spelling there names only the built-in skill, never a user skill of that name, while in `denied_identities` it refuses both); name a skill there to keep it available whatever its source. A managed skill file that names one skill twice (two spellings, or a plugin skill's `plugin:<pkg>:<skill>` id beside its path) is kept: matching values apply, and conflicting values turn that skill off with a warning naming both keys. Turning a built-in skill on or off, or resetting it, removes the other spellings of it from that settings file

title.zh-TW: 技能撞名時明確分辨並改列內建代號
title.en: Clearer handling and built-in IDs for skill name collisions

body.zh-TW:
自訂或外掛技能跟內建技能取了一樣的短名稱，新版把優先順序與代號標示清楚了。

呼叫短名稱時如果只有已安裝外掛跟內建技能撞名，Muse 會直接開啟內建技能，不再跳出來要你二選一。

如果是你自己的使用者或專案技能跟內建技能同名，終端機介面會在啟動時主動提醒，並告訴你用 `bundled:<name>` 這個代號依然能打開內建版。

執行 `muse plugins inspect` 檢視外掛時，內建技能現在也會照技能清單的格式列出如 `bundled:plan` 的代號，不再顯示帶外掛前綴的 ID。
body.en:
When a custom or plugin skill shares a short name with a built-in skill, the new version makes the precedence and ID clear.

If you invoke a short name and only an installed plugin collides with a built-in skill, Muse opens the built-in skill directly instead of asking you to choose.

If your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, the terminal UI alerts you at startup and shows that `bundled:<name>` still opens the built-in version.

When running `muse plugins inspect`, built-in skills now use the same ID format as the skills list, such as `bundled:plan`, instead of a plugin-prefixed ID.

items.original:
When you name a skill by its short name and only an installed plugin shares that name with a built-in skill, Muse opens the built-in skill instead of asking you to choose
When your own user or project skill has the same name as a built-in skill, the TUI says so at startup and shows the `bundled:<name>` id that still opens the built-in
`muse plugins inspect` lists each built-in skill by the id the skills list uses, such as `bundled:plan`, instead of a plugin-qualified id

title.zh-TW: 外掛檢查與安裝明確提示略過舊繼承欄位
title.en: Plugin validation and install clearly note ignored formerUnits

body.zh-TW: 外掛作者或管理員使用 `muse plugins validate` 與 `muse plugins install` 時，若資訊檔帶有 `formerUnits` 欄位，現在會看到 `ignored-former-units` 提示。因為只有隨產品內建的外掛能接手舊外掛的設定，這個欄位會被略過。不過外掛依然會完成安裝，裡面的技能和 hook（特定事件發生時會被觸發的小程式）都能照常運作。⟦就像拿舊門牌去新社區報到，管理室會跳過那張舊證件不認帳，但照樣讓你辦好入住、屋裡的家電都能正常用。⟧
body.en: When plugin authors or admins run `muse plugins validate` or `muse plugins install`, a manifest containing a `formerUnits` field now displays an `ignored-former-units` notice. Because only plugins bundled with the product can take over a former plugin's settings, this field is ignored. The plugin still finishes installing, and its skills and hooks (small programs triggered when specific events happen) continue to work normally. ⟦Suppose you check into a new apartment complex with an old street-number plate: the management office ignores that outdated card, yet still checks you in so all the appliances inside work fine.⟧

items.original: `muse plugins validate` and `muse plugins install` now say a plugin manifest's `formerUnits` field is ignored (`ignored-former-units`), because only plugins that ship in the product can take over a former plugin's settings; the plugin still installs and its skills and hooks still work

title.zh-TW: 讀不到 settings.json 時預設關閉技能
title.en: Skills default to off when settings.json is unreadable

body.zh-TW: 如果 `settings.json` 暫時無法讀取，過去會默默把你在那份檔案裡關閉的技能重新啟用。現在只要讀不到 `settings.json`，該次執行的技能啟用狀態一律預設為關閉，不再意外打開已停用的技能。
body.en: Previously, if `settings.json` was temporarily unreadable, skills you had disabled in that file were silently re-enabled. Now, whenever `settings.json` cannot be read, skill activation defaults to off for that run so disabled skills are never turned back on by mistake.

items.original: When settings.json cannot be read, skill activation defaults to off for that run instead of silently re-enabling skills the unreadable file had turned off

title.zh-TW: 目標卡過濾隱藏的終端機控制碼
title.en: Goal cards filter hidden terminal control codes

body.zh-TW: 打開目標檢視畫面時，文字裡若夾帶了不該直接顯示的指令，過去會原封不動被印出來。現在目標卡不再輸出這些藏在目標文字裡的原始終端機控制序列。
body.en: Previously, when opening the goal view, any hidden instructions embedded in the text were printed as-is. Goal cards now strip out these raw terminal control sequences hidden inside goal text.

items.original: Security: Goal cards no longer print raw terminal control sequences hidden in goal text

title.zh-TW: 修改指定四種設定檔前先徵求核准
title.en: Ask for approval before modifying four specified config files

body.zh-TW: Muse 準備寫入 `~/.npmrc`、`~/.pypirc`、`~/.docker/config.json` 或 `~/.kube/config` 之前，現在會先徵求你的核准才會修改。⟦有如請幫手整理書桌時，一般文件可以自行歸位，遇到放存摺和印章的抽屜一定要先問過你才敢動手。⟧
body.en: Before Muse writes to `~/.npmrc`, `~/.pypirc`, `~/.docker/config.json`, or `~/.kube/config`, it now asks for your approval first. ⟦When you ask an assistant to tidy your desk, everyday papers can be put away on their own, while the drawer holding your bankbooks and personal seals stays untouched until they ask you first.⟧

items.original: Security: Writes to `~/.npmrc`, `~/.pypirc`, `~/.docker/config.json` or `~/.kube/config` now ask for approval before Muse changes them

title.zh-TW: 外掛 hook 執行程式碼變動後須重審
title.en: Plugin hooks require re-review after code changes

body.zh-TW: 已安裝的外掛在更新後若改動了執行的程式碼，裡面的 hook 都會再次請你審查確認。你在這一版之前就核准過的 hook，這次也會再詢問確認一次。⟦換作社區物業調整了巡邏或門禁合約，就算住戶去年簽過同意書，今年換新內容還是得請你重新過目簽字。⟧
body.en: When an update changes the code an installed plugin runs, its hooks will ask for your review again. Hooks you approved before this release will also ask for confirmation once more. ⟦A neighborhood property manager revising a patrol or gate-access contract still has to ask residents to read and sign the new terms, even if they signed a consent form last year.⟧

items.original: Security: Installed plugin hooks ask for review again when an update changes the code they run, and hooks you approved before this release ask once more

title.zh-TW: 強化保護檔在別名與捷徑下的存取鎖定
title.en: Stronger access locks for protected files via aliases and symlinks

body.zh-TW:
在 WSL2 DrvFs 這類不區分大小寫的掛載磁區上，檔案工具現在會把 `auth.json`、`trust.json` 等受保護檔案解析到實際位置。即使改用不同大小寫的路徑像是 `MUSE/auth.json` 開啟，也會和原本拼法一樣被拒絕。如果被拒絕的檔案位於這類磁區，沙盒終端機也會因為路徑遮罩無法涵蓋所有別名而拒絕啟動。

`auth.json` 與 `trust.json` 的檔案鎖現在改放在解析後的實際寫入位置旁，因此透過 symlink（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）存取時，各種寫法都會共用同一把鎖，不再各鎖各的。⟦好比替同一間保險箱掛了大小寫不同的門牌與捷徑，以前換個寫法就認不出來，現在全認準同一扇門與同一把鎖。⟧
body.en:
On case-insensitive mounts such as WSL2 DrvFs, file tools now resolve protected files like `auth.json` and `trust.json` to their actual location. Opening one through a differently cased path such as `MUSE/auth.json` is denied just like the exact spelling. If a denied file resides on such a mount, the sandboxed terminal also refuses to start because path masks cannot cover every alias.

File locks for `auth.json` and `trust.json` now sit beside the resolved write destination, so accessing them through a symlink (a shortcut file pointing to another location) makes every spelling share one lock instead of locking separately. ⟦Hanging differently cased doorplates and shortcuts on the same vault used to make it unrecognizable under another spelling, whereas now everything points to the same door and the same lock.⟧

items.original:
On case-insensitive mounts such as WSL2 DrvFs, Muse's file tools now resolve protected files like `auth.json` and `trust.json` to the file they actually name, so opening the same file through a differently-cased path (for example `MUSE/auth.json`) is denied just like the exact spelling; a sandboxed shell refuses to start when a denied file lives on such a mount, because no path mask can cover the alias
Auth and trust file locks now sit beside the resolved write destination, so a symlinked auth.json or trust.json shares one lock across every spelling instead of two

title.zh-TW: exec --json 補齊用量與真實時間
title.en: exec --json completes usage counts and real timestamps

body.zh-TW:
寫自動化腳本剖析 `muse exec --json` 輸出，過去常因重複編號、固定日期與漏算呼叫次數而失真。

`run.usage` 那一行現在會統計整趟執行的每一次模型呼叫，不再因為中途做過上下文壓縮就只算後半段。如果無法統計整趟執行，則會略過該行並將通知印到標準錯誤。

`exec --json` 的每一行現在都會帶上唯一的 `id` 和真實的 `recorded_at` 時間，取代過去重複的佔位編號與固定的 `2026-06-04` 時間。這樣腳本就能直接依據 JSONL 輸出串接資料並計算耗時。⟦跟結帳收據補上每張獨立單號與真實刷卡時間一樣，中間就算換過紙捲，整筆消費也能對得清清楚楚。⟧
body.en:
Automation scripts parsing `muse exec --json` output used to get skewed results from duplicate IDs, a fixed date, and missed call counts.

The `run.usage` line now counts every model call across the entire run, rather than only counting the later half after a mid-run context compaction. If the whole run cannot be counted, that line is omitted and a notice is printed to stderr.

Each `exec --json` line now carries a unique `id` and the real `recorded_at` time, replacing the repeated placeholder IDs and fixed `2026-06-04` timestamp. Scripts can now join data and calculate durations directly from the JSONL output. ⟦Just as checkout receipts gain individual receipt numbers and real card-swipe timestamps, the entire purchase reconciles cleanly even if the paper roll is swapped mid-transaction.⟧

items.original:
The `run.usage` line of `muse exec --json` now counts every model call of the run; after a context compaction inside the run it counted only the later calls. When exec cannot count the whole run, it leaves the line out and prints a notice to stderr
`exec --json` lines now carry a unique `id` and the real `recorded_at` time instead of the same placeholder ids and fixed 2026-06-04 times in every run, so scripts can join and time runs from the JSONL output

title.zh-TW: 啟動時若紀錄檔被刪會立刻中止不重寫
title.en: Startup aborts instead of rewriting if the log is deleted

body.zh-TW:
新工作階段啟動過程如果紀錄檔被刪掉，過去會重寫一份沒有原本權限設定的新紀錄檔，讓之後的 `--session-id` 讀到錯誤設定。

現在無論是直接啟動，還是透過工作階段伺服器執行 `session/start` 啟動，只要紀錄檔在啟動中途被刪除，就會立刻中止並提示該檔案已遭刪除。這樣就不會再產生一份缺少原本權限設定的新紀錄檔。⟦像門禁名單剛開好卻被抽走時，警衛寧可當場喊停也不隨便補發空白通行證，免得之後放錯人進門。⟧
body.en:
If a new session's log file was deleted during startup, it used to rewrite a new log without the original permission settings, causing a later `--session-id` run to read the wrong configuration.

Now, whether started directly or via `session/start` through the session server, startup immediately aborts and reports that the log file was deleted if it disappears mid-start. This prevents creating a new log missing the original permission settings. ⟦Once a freshly prepared access list goes missing, a guard halts entry on the spot rather than handing out blank passes that could let the wrong person in later.⟧

items.original:
When a new session's log is deleted while the session starts, the start now stops and says so, instead of writing a new log without the session's permission settings that a later `--session-id` run would pick up
When a new session's log is deleted while a client starts the session through the session server (`session/start`), the start now stops and says the log was deleted, instead of writing a new log without the session's permission settings

title.zh-TW: 異常退出與當機後接續工作階段更完整
title.en: More complete session resumes after abnormal exits and crashes

body.zh-TW:
工作階段中途當機或非正常結束後想接著做，這批修復讓檢查點保存與啟動提示更可靠。

沒正常退出就結束的工作階段，就算中間重開過 Muse，接續時依然會看到異常退出的警告。

重開工作階段時，剛好在儲存檢查點或進行上下文壓縮期間開始的那一輪對話，不會再被遺漏。

切換過模型供應商的工作階段在當機接續後能繼續正常使用，舊版本已存下的紀錄則維持不變。

當機後若只能從上一個檢查點重開，啟動通知會列出接續過程退回檢查點前已經取消的工具呼叫與 `!` 指令。

用 `/new` 或 `/clear` 開啟的工作階段現在會儲存檢查點，不像以前完全沒存而導致壓縮後重開得重讀全部歷史。
body.en:
When you need to continue after a mid-session crash or abnormal exit, these fixes make checkpoint saving and startup notices more reliable.

Resuming a session that ended without a clean exit still shows the abnormal-exit warning, even if Muse was restarted in between.

Reopening a session no longer drops a turn that started while a checkpoint was being saved or a context compaction was running.

Sessions that switched model providers continue working normally after a crash resume, while logs saved by earlier builds remain unchanged.

After a crash, when a session can only reopen from its last checkpoint, the startup notice lists the tool calls and `!` commands that were already cancelled before falling back to that checkpoint.

Sessions started with `/new` or `/clear` now save checkpoints, instead of saving none and forcing a full history re-read when reopened after compaction.

items.original:
Resuming a session that ended without a clean exit now shows the abnormal-exit warning even when Muse was started again in between
Reopening a session no longer leaves out a turn that started while a session checkpoint or a context compaction was being saved
Sessions that switch model providers keep working after a crash resume; sessions saved by earlier builds are unchanged
After a crash, when the session could only reopen from its last checkpoint, the startup notice now lists the tool calls and `!` commands the resume had already cancelled before it fell back to that checkpoint
A session started with `/new` or `/clear` now saves session checkpoints; before, it saved none, so reopening it after a context compaction read its whole history

title.zh-TW: 工作階段紀錄縮減體積並修好跨機同步
title.en: Smaller session logs and fixed cross-machine sync

body.zh-TW:
在兩台電腦之間搬移對話紀錄，或對話越積越長時，以往容易碰到檔案衝突、查詢卡住與硬碟佔用過大的問題。這幾項讀取與寫入行為都已經調整改善。

查詢工作階段清單時剛好遇上索引升級，現在不會再卡住不動。

啟動 Muse 不會再改寫先前的工作階段檔案。透過檔案同步工具跨機複製的紀錄，也不再跳出「the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse」而遭拒絕。

由於每次模型請求寫入的追蹤紀錄更精簡，硬碟上的工作階段紀錄檔也跟著變小。

在長工作階段裡開始新一輪對話時，不用再把前面每一輪的紀錄全部重讀一遍。
body.en:
Moving conversation logs between two computers or letting sessions grow long used to cause file conflicts, stalled queries, and excessive disk usage. Several read and write behaviors have now been improved.

Querying the session list no longer hangs when an index upgrade happens at the same time.

Starting Muse no longer modifies earlier session files. Logs copied across machines by a file-sync tool are no longer rejected with "the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse".

Because each model request writes a leaner trace entry, session log files on disk are smaller as well.

Starting a new turn in a long session no longer re-reads the records of every earlier turn.

items.original:
Listing sessions no longer hangs when the session index is upgraded in the middle of the request
Starting Muse no longer writes into your earlier sessions' files, so a session that a file-sync tool copies between machines is no longer refused with "the session log was replaced by another file outside Muse"
Session logs on disk are smaller, because each model request now writes a shorter trace entry
Starting a new turn in a long session no longer re-reads the records of every earlier turn

title.zh-TW: 無紀錄模式不再把快取寫進資料夾
title.en: No-session-log mode stops writing caches to your folder

body.zh-TW: 想開一個不留痕跡的對話或進行唯讀接續，在終端機或 `tbh exec` 加上 `--no-session-log` 參數現在更徹底。這類工作階段不會再把內建技能與外掛的快取（把算過或查過的資料暫存起來直接用的檔案）寫進你的資料夾。如果資料夾裡原本就有就沿用，否則只保留結束時會刪除的暫存副本。⟦像借用朋友電腦開無痕視窗查資料時，只暫用現成工具、不把私人暫存檔塞進他的資料夾，關掉視窗就乾乾淨淨。⟧
body.en: Starting a traceless conversation or a read-only resume with `--no-session-log` in the terminal or `tbh exec` is now more thorough. These sessions no longer write built-in skill and plugin caches into your folder. If they already exist in the folder, they are reused; otherwise, only a temporary copy is kept and deleted on exit. ⟦Borrowing a friend's computer in an incognito window lets you use existing tools without stuffing personal temp files into their folders, leaving everything clean when you close the window.⟧

items.original: A terminal or `tbh exec` session started with `--no-session-log`, including a read-only resume, no longer writes the built-in skill and plugin caches into your data folder; it reuses them when they are already there and otherwise keeps a temporary copy that is removed when it exits

title.zh-TW: 上下文壓縮的保留準則與異常狀況修復
title.en: Context compaction retention rules and edge-case fixes

body.zh-TW:
把長對話壓縮變短的過程，現在更能正確保留指令並避開幾項儲存衝突。

長對話壓縮後保留下來的過去指令，現在只會是實際執行過的指令，不會再誤抓中間剛好提到指令關鍵字的檔案或紀錄行；代理自己跑過的指令則留給文字摘要處理。

執行 `/compact` 卻未能存下結果時，之後接續該工作階段不會再誤報「runtime closed before context compaction completed」錯誤。

在背景完成自動上下文壓縮的同時，若有搭配工具 hook 執行的 `!` 指令剛好結束，現在不會再失敗並遺失輸出。

沒有寫入自身紀錄檔的工作階段在做完上下文壓縮後，重複啟動子代理時不會再找不到第一次啟動的紀錄。

最新一輪對話若包含貼上的圖片，執行 `/compact` 現在會正常壓縮對話，不再把它當成無效對象而拒絕。
body.en:
Compacting long conversations now preserves commands more accurately and avoids several storage conflicts.

Past commands kept after compacting a long conversation are now only commands that were actually run, rather than file or log lines that happen to mention a command keyword mid-line; commands the agent ran itself are left to the written summary.

When `/compact` fails to save its result, resuming that session later no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error.

If a `!` command running with a tool hook finishes just as automatic context compaction completes in the background, it no longer fails and loses its output.

After context compaction in a session that does not write its own log file, starting a subagent again no longer fails to find the record of its first start.

If the latest turn includes a pasted image, running `/compact` now compacts the conversation normally instead of rejecting it as an invalid target.

items.original:
After a long conversation is compacted, the commands it keeps from earlier work are real commands, not file or log lines that only mention a command word mid-line; commands the agent ran itself are left to the written summary
Resuming a session no longer shows a false "runtime closed before context compaction completed" error after a `/compact` whose result could not be saved
A `!` command that ends while the session finishes an automatic context compaction in the background no longer fails and loses its output when a tool hook ran for it
After a context compaction in a session that does not write its own session log, a repeated subagent start no longer fails its lookup of the first start
`/compact` in a session whose latest turn included a pasted image now compacts the conversation instead of refusing it as an invalid target

title.zh-TW: 分支對話與旁聊能完整保留前後輪脈絡
title.en: Forked sessions and side chats preserve full turn context

body.zh-TW:
從既有對話開出分支或旁聊繼續問下去，模型現在不會再漏看中間講過的內容。

由 `muse serve` 託管的分支工作階段，過去從第三輪開始只會把繼承自母對話的紀錄、分支第一輪與最新訊息送給模型而漏掉中間各輪，現在已經補回。

由 `muse serve` 託管且做過壓縮的工作階段，開出的分支或旁聊現在會從壓縮後的所有操作接續，不再重複收到重申委派設定的冗餘附註，也不會漏掉最新幾輪。

分支對話中已經被接受的後續接問輪次，現在都會妥善保留下來。

切換模型供應商之後建立的完整上下文分支可以繼續正常運作，舊版本儲存的分支則維持原樣。
body.en:
When you branch off an existing conversation into a fork or side chat, the model no longer misses turns in the middle.

Forked sessions hosted by `muse serve` used to send the model only the turns inherited from the parent, the fork's first turn, and the newest message starting from the third turn, dropping the turns in between; those missing turns are now included.

A fork or side chat opened from a compacted session hosted by `muse serve` now continues from everything done after compaction, no longer receives a redundant note restating delegation settings, and no longer drops the newest turns.

Accepted follow-up turns in forked conversations are now properly preserved.

Full-context forks created after switching model providers continue to work normally, while forks saved by earlier builds remain unchanged.

items.original:
A forked session hosted by `muse serve` no longer loses its own earlier turns from what the model sees; from the fork's third turn on, the model was sent the turns inherited from the parent, the fork's first turn and the newest message, but none of the fork's turns in between
A fork or side chat of a compacted session hosted by `muse serve` now starts from everything the session did after the compaction; a fork could be sent a redundant note restating its delegation settings, and in rarer cases a fork or side chat started without the session's newest turns
Forked conversations preserve accepted followup turns
A full-context fork taken after switching model providers keeps working; forks saved by earlier builds are unchanged

title.zh-TW: Workflow 代理清理與額度計算問題修正
title.en: Fixes for Workflow agent cleanup and token accounting

body.zh-TW:
跑多輪 Workflow 容易遇上的檢查點停存、代理掛起與 token 漏算問題，新版都有對應修正。

Workflow 一旦結束，已完成的子代理就會從儲存的工作階段移出，不再塞進後續每一個檢查點，長工作階段跑很多次 Workflow 也不再因此停存檢查點。

沒有回應的 Workflow 代理或 Auto-review 審查員在取消 30 秒後就會強制結束，不會再無限期掛著。

剛好在 Workflow 快完成的那一刻停止它，狀態不再錯留成 `unresolved`。

Workflow 子代理在完成幾次模型呼叫後才失敗，那些已完成的呼叫所消耗的 token 現在照樣計入 Workflow 的 token 總數，並從你設的 token 預算裡扣除。
body.en:
Issues commonly seen when running multiple Workflows—stopped checkpoint saving, hung agents, and uncounted tokens—have been fixed in this release.

Once a Workflow ends, its finished subagents are removed from the saved session instead of being carried into every subsequent checkpoint, so long sessions running many Workflows no longer stop saving checkpoints.

An unresponsive Workflow agent or Auto-review reviewer is forcefully terminated 30 seconds after cancellation instead of hanging indefinitely.

Stopping a Workflow right as it is about to finish no longer leaves its status stuck as `unresolved`.

When a Workflow subagent fails after completing several model calls, the tokens used by those completed calls still count toward the Workflow's token total and are deducted from your configured token budget.

items.original:
Long sessions that run many Workflows no longer stop saving checkpoints: once a Workflow has ended, its finished subagents drop out of the saved session instead of being carried in every later checkpoint
A Workflow agent or an Auto-review reviewer that has stopped responding is now ended 30 seconds after it is cancelled, instead of staying open indefinitely
Stopping a Workflow at the moment it finishes no longer leaves it shown as `unresolved`
When a Workflow subagent's run fails after it has completed model calls, the tokens of those completed calls now count in the Workflow's token total and against a token budget you set

title.zh-TW: 設有 hook 時中止工具呼叫的狀態更準確
title.en: More accurate status when stopping tool calls with hooks configured

body.zh-TW:
已設定 `PreToolUse` hook 時，若在工具呼叫即將開始前中止執行或子代理，現在會以已取消結束，不再報錯「tool batch ended without result」。

同一批若有多個工具呼叫被 hook 中止，其中某個呼叫經 `PostToolUseFailure` hook 以 `updatedInput` 修正後也觸發中止。現在它的中止原因不會再覆蓋掉較早那次呼叫的中止原因。⟦跟餐廳臨時撤單一樣，櫃台會註記為已取消而非出餐失敗，後面幾道菜的退單理由也不會蓋掉最先喊停的那一張。⟧
body.en:
When a `PreToolUse` hook is configured, stopping a run or subagent just before its tool calls start now ends it as cancelled instead of failing with the error "tool batch ended without result".

If multiple tool calls in the same batch are stopped by hooks, and one of those calls also triggers a stop after a `PostToolUseFailure` hook corrects it with `updatedInput`, its stop reason no longer overwrites the stop reason of the earlier call. ⟦At a restaurant when an order is canceled unexpectedly, the counter marks it as cancelled rather than a failed dish, and the cancellation reasons for later dishes do not overwrite the first one that called a halt.⟧

items.original:
Stopping a run or subagent just before its tool calls start, with a `PreToolUse` hook configured, now ends it as cancelled instead of failed with "tool batch ended without result"
When hooks stop a turn on more than one tool call of a batch, a stop on a call that a `PostToolUseFailure` hook corrected with `updatedInput` no longer replaces the stop reason of an earlier call

title.zh-TW: 無實質改動的 hook 不再寫進工作階段紀錄
title.en: Hooks making no substantive changes no longer write to the session log

body.zh-TW:
來自設定檔或 hooks 檔的 hook，會在工作階段啟動、接續、清除、壓縮或分支時觸發。如果它以 0 退出、標準錯誤只有空白，且沒有新增或修改任何上下文、系統訊息或錯誤，就不會寫進工作階段紀錄。其他情況和外掛 hook 在這些事件執行時都在結束後照舊紀錄。若這類事件或子代理啟動時把純文字印到標準輸出，因為會成為上下文，所以同樣會留下記錄。

`Stop` hook 同樣以退出碼 0 結束、標準錯誤只有空白，而且沒讓該輪繼續、沒加系統訊息也沒失敗時，不會留下記錄。其餘執行結果則在結束時照常寫進紀錄。⟦就像巡邏員繞了一圈回報一切正常且沒留便條，值班簿便不再多記一筆，只有真的出狀況或交辦事項時才寫上去。⟧
body.en:
A hook from a settings or hooks file triggers when a session starts, resumes, clears, compacts, or forks. If it exits with 0, writes only whitespace to standard error, and adds or modifies no context, system message, or error, it is not written to the session log. Other runs and plugin hooks executing on these events are still recorded as before after they finish. If plain text is printed to standard output during these events or when a subagent starts, it becomes context and is therefore still recorded.

Similarly, a `Stop` hook leaves no record if it finishes with exit code 0, writes only whitespace to standard error, does not keep the turn going, adds no system message, and does not fail. All other execution results are written to the log as usual when they finish. ⟦A patrol guard who finishes a round, reports everything is fine, and leaves no note does not get an extra entry in the duty logbook; only actual incidents or handoff items are written down.⟧

items.original:
