items.original: **Antigravity's Gemini 4 Argon now reads the shared Gemini quota.** Antigravity CLI 1.5.16 dropped Argon's separate pool, so Argon shares the Gemini weekly and 5-hour limits. usage still looked for the old Argon pool, and Orchestrator models read the Claude / GPT pool. Now both read the Gemini pool in the status line, and the report counts Argon and Orchestrator conversations toward Gemini instead of dropping them. When the menu bar switches from Argon to Gemini, the burn rate starts over instead of showing a sudden jump.

title.zh-TW: 回報問題會自動填好環境資訊
title.en: Reporting an issue now prefills your environment info

body.zh-TW:
用 usage 碰到錯誤想找開發者反映，卻懶得自己查電腦規格嗎？macOS 的面板選單與 Windows 的系統匣選單現在都加入了「回報問題」（英文介面為 Report an Issue）。

點下去會在程式碼平台 GitHub 開啟一份新問題單，裡頭已套好錯誤回報範本的各個段落並填妥環境區塊。區塊包含 usage 版本、安裝方式、作業系統、CPU、Python、語言、面板主題，以及顯示哪些 AI 卡片，且不含任何檔案路徑、使用者名稱、額度數字或紀錄檔。⟦如同把家電送回原廠維修，以前得自己抄下機型與序號填表，現在櫃檯先幫你印好規格欄，你只需寫上哪裡故障。⟧
body.en:
Run into a bug in usage and want to report it to the developers without looking up your computer specs yourself? Both the macOS panel menu and the Windows tray menu now include "Report an Issue".

Clicking it opens a new issue on GitHub with the bug report template's sections and a prefilled Environment block. The block includes your usage version, install method, OS, CPU, Python, language, panel theme, and which AI cards are shown, and it contains no file paths, usernames, quota numbers, or logs. ⟦Think of bringing an appliance back to the manufacturer for repair: before, you had to copy down the model and serial number onto the form yourself, whereas now the counter prints the specs section for you and you only need to write what broke.⟧

items.original: **Report an Issue opens a prefilled bug report.** The panel menu (macOS) and tray menu (Windows) gain the item. It opens a new GitHub issue with the bug template's sections and an Environment block: usage version, install method, OS, CPU, Python, language, panel theme and which AI cards are shown. It includes no paths, usernames, quota figures or logs.

title.zh-TW: 絨毛小夥伴多了六隻並輪流登場
title.en: Six more Plush Pals join and take turns onstage

body.zh-TW:
打開面板看各家 AI 額度的空檔，卡片底下那排隊伍又添了新面孔。這次先多了刺蝟「Prickle」與水獺「Shelly」使總數來到 13 隻。接著再加入蝸牛「Swirl」、螃蟹「Pinch」、河豚「Puff」和鳳頭鸚鵡「Tuft」，現在一共有 17 隻。每隻都一樣有五種姿勢，每次面板載入時誰先上場都是隨機決定的。

雖然數量變多，卡片下方的這一排不會因此擠得更近。站不下的小夥伴會先在畫面外等待，每隔幾分鐘，排在最後的那隻會跳出去，等最久的那隻跳進來輪流上場。⟦就像長椅寬度固定，來聚會的朋友變多了也不用硬擠，坐不下的先在旁邊等，時間到再讓等最久的補上空位。⟧
body.en:
While you open the panel to check your AI quotas, the lineup under the cards has gained new faces. First came Prickle the hedgehog and Shelly the otter, bringing the total to 13. Then Swirl the snail, Pinch the crab, Puff the pufferfish, and Tuft the cockatoo joined in, making 17 in all. Each one still has five poses, and who starts onstage is chosen at random each time the panel loads.

Even with more pals, the row under the cards does not squeeze any closer together. Pals that do not fit wait offstage, and every few minutes, the last one in line hops out while the one that has waited longest hops in to take its turn. ⟦Picture a bench of fixed width: when more friends show up to the gathering, nobody has to squeeze in—those who cannot fit wait on the side, and when time is up, the friend who has waited longest steps into the open spot.⟧

items.original:
**Two new Plush Pals: Prickle the hedgehog and Shelly the otter.** There are now thirteen pals. The row under the cards never squeezes them closer than before: pals that do not fit wait offstage, and every few minutes the last pal in line hops out and the one that has waited longest hops in. Who starts onstage is shuffled each time the panel loads.
**Four more Plush Pals: Swirl the snail, Pinch the crab, Puff the pufferfish and Tuft the cockatoo.** There are now seventeen pals, each with the same five poses, and they take turns in the line like the others.

title.zh-TW: 歷史紀錄更省記憶體並放大檔案快取上限
title.en: History uses less memory with a larger file cache limit

body.zh-TW:
長期累積大量 Codex 對話檔後，usage 現在會把相同資料合併共用，重新整理也免去反覆重算的功夫。從磁碟快取（把讀過的資料暫存起來直接用）載入相同數值時，現在只保留一份共用。拿真實資料重新整理三次後，記憶體用量約從 174 MiB 降到 162 MiB。

每個檔案快取的上限也從 4,096 提高到 16,384。Codex 紀錄檔數量超過舊上限時，不會每次重新整理都重新解析其中一部分。⟦跟把辦公室裡一模一樣的表單改成只留一份共用、再把檔案櫃換成四倍大一樣，空間既省下來，舊資料也不必一直被擠出去重抄。⟧
body.en:
When large amounts of Codex conversation files build up over time, usage now merges and shares identical data, saving refreshes from repeating the work. When loading equal values from disk caches, it now keeps only one shared copy. After refreshing three times on real data, memory usage dropped from about 174 MiB to 162 MiB.

The per-file cache limit also rose from 4,096 to 16,384. When the number of Codex log files exceeds the old limit, usage no longer reparses part of them on every refresh. ⟦An office keeps one shared copy of identical forms and swaps in a filing cabinet four times the size, saving space while keeping old records from getting pushed out and recopied.⟧

items.original: **Less memory for history, and no reparsing on large Codex histories.** Equal values loaded from the disk caches now share one copy (about 174 MiB → 162 MiB after three refreshes on real data). The per-file cache limit rose from 4,096 to 16,384, so a Codex history with more files than the old limit no longer reparses part of itself on every refresh.

title.zh-TW: IDE 與 Cowork 用 Claude 也能更新額度
title.en: Claude quota updates in IDEs and Cowork too

body.zh-TW:
明明已經切進編輯器繼續跟 AI 對話，選單列上的數字卻好幾個小時一動也不動，也沒半點提醒。過去 usage 只從終端機底下的狀態列讀取 Claude 額度。但是 IDE（寫程式用的編輯器）外掛與 Cowork 不會畫出狀態列，選單列就只能停在最後一次終端機工作階段的數字。

現在只要狀態列超過 15 分鐘沒回報新額度，而 Claude Code 自己的快取有同帳號的較新數字，usage 就會改顯示快取數值並標出資料是多久前的。這份數字可能會落後 20 到 30 分鐘。

切換帳號後也不再顯示另一個帳號的額度。額度通知改按帳號分開記錄，從額度用完的帳號切到另一個帳號時，usage 不會把它當成額度重置。⟦過去只盯著玄關溫度計，沒更新就一直停在舊度數；現在它久沒動會改看氣象站紀錄並標出時間，不同房間的數值也分開記不再混在一起。⟧
body.en:
You switch into your editor and keep chatting with AI, yet the number in the menu bar sits unchanged for hours with no warning at all. Previously, usage read Claude quota only from the status line at the bottom of the terminal. However, IDE (code editor) extensions and Cowork never draw a status line, so the menu bar stayed stuck on the number from your last terminal session.

Now, whenever the status line has reported no new quota for more than 15 minutes and Claude Code's own cache has a newer number for the same account, usage shows the cached value instead and notes how old the data is. This figure can lag by 20 to 30 minutes.

Quota from another account is also no longer shown after you switch accounts. Quota notifications are now tracked per account, so switching from an exhausted account to another one no longer reads as a quota reset. ⟦Before, you only watched the entryway thermometer and stayed stuck on an old reading when it stopped updating; now, if it sits still too long, you check the weather station record with its timestamp instead, and readings from different rooms are logged separately so they never mix.⟧

items.original: **Claude quota now updates while you work in an IDE extension or Cowork.** Before, usage read Claude quota only from the status line, which IDE extensions and Cowork never draw, so the menu bar kept the last terminal session's number for hours with no warning. Now, when the status line has reported no new quota for 15 minutes and Claude Code's own cache is newer for the same account, usage shows the cache and says how old it is (it can lag by 20–30 minutes). Quota recorded for another account is no longer shown after you switch accounts, and quota notifications are tracked per account, so switching from an exhausted account no longer reads as a reset.

title.zh-TW: 面板新增「絨毛小夥伴」主題
title.en: New "Plush Pals" Panel Theme

body.zh-TW:
查看用量想少點枯燥，現在有動物陪你看額度。到 **⚙ 設定 → 切換面板** 選「絨毛小夥伴」，共 18 種主題，固定亮色不受系統深淺影響。米白卡片配咖啡縫邊，底下 11 個原創絨毛角色散步，點選看名字，偶爾聊天打盹。

每條額度進度條站一位角色，停在目前百分比。5 小時與週額度較近上限那條用到 80% 會緊張，用完睡著，重置時醒來歡呼。

小夥伴只在要緊時出泡泡，一次一個：額度到 80%、用完與重置，或睡著後重置前約 10 分鐘伸懶腰。現速將提前用完會報剩餘時間，並推薦有空位的工具。Claude 或 Codex 回報故障及恢復時也會出現泡泡。今日用量超昨天整排歡呼，過半夜也有泡泡。每天首次造訪時，依週額度剛重置、隔幾天回來、週一或週五，或當下時段換招呼。12 月飄雪，隊尾日換一棵毛氈聖誕樹。

⟦過去只盯數字，現在公仔見底打盹、補滿歡呼。⟧
body.en:
To make checking usage less dry, animals now keep you company while you watch your quotas. Go to **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel** and pick "Plush Pals", one of 18 themes, fixed in its light look regardless of system appearance. Cream cards with brown stitched edges sit above 11 original plush characters strolling along; click one to see its name, and now and then they chat or doze off.

One character stands on each quota bar at its current percentage. Between the 5-hour and weekly quotas, the one closer to its limit looks worried at 80%, falls asleep when it runs out, and wakes up cheering when it resets.

The pals only show speech bubbles when it matters, one at a time: when a quota hits 80%, runs out, or resets, or when a sleeping pal stretches about 10 minutes before reset. If the current pace will empty a quota early, it reports the time left and recommends a tool that still has room. Bubbles also appear when Claude or Codex reports an outage or recovers. When today's usage passes yesterday's, the whole row cheers, and there is a bubble after midnight too. On each day's first visit, the greeting adapts to a freshly reset weekly quota, returning after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day. In December, snow falls, and a different felt Christmas tree stands at the end of the line each day.

⟦Picture staring only at numbers before, whereas now plushies doze off at empty and cheer when refilled.⟧

items.original: **New panel theme: Plush Pals.** Cream cards with a brown stitched rim, and eleven original plush animals that stroll along a row under the cards. One pal sits on each quota bar at its current percentage; it looks worried from 80% and falls asleep when the quota runs out (whichever of the 5-hour and weekly quotas is closer to the limit), and wakes up cheering when it resets. The pals speak up only when it matters, one speech bubble at a time: when a quota reaches 80%, runs out or resets; when a sleeping pal's quota is about 10 minutes from resetting (it stretches); when the current pace would empty a quota early (saying how long is left, and which other tool still has room); when Claude or Codex reports an outage and when it recovers; when today's usage passes yesterday's (the line cheers); on the day's first visit, with a greeting that fits (a weekly quota that just reset, a return after a few days, Monday or Friday, or the time of day); and after midnight. Now and then two pals in line chat or one dozes off. In December snow falls across the panel and a felt Christmas tree, a different one each day, stands at its end. Click a pal to see its name. Pick it from **⚙ Settings → Switch Panel**; there are now 18 themes. The panel always uses its light look, whatever the system appearance.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式選詞更準並可單獨標懂名詞
title.en: Beginner Mode Picks Better Terms and Marks Them One by One

body.zh-TW:
用新手模式學名詞，以前只懂一兩個詞卻得按 9 全標，還常被無關的檔名或路徑佔掉三個提示位置。現在按 4～6 就能單獨標懂對應的那一個名詞，按 9 照舊三個一起標。分支名稱、檔名、路徑、單獨數字與 PR（請求把修改併回主線）編號不再佔位，每個提示也都會真的出現在 Claude 的回答裡。

同一概念的兩種寫法現在也算同一個詞。標過「分支」或「branch」懂了，兩者就不再當新詞提示；標過「PR」或「Pull Request」懂了，「PR」和「pull request」也不會再跳出。上述詞彙只要自己打出任一種寫法，就算你會了。

⟦以前背詞像整串鑰匙一起收、還常夾進門牌號，現在能拆開單獨收好，同一把的中英文兩把也只要認得一支就算過關。⟧
body.en:
When learning terms in Beginner Mode, you previously had to press 9 to mark all three even if you only knew one or two, and unrelated file names or paths often took up the three hint slots. Now pressing 4–6 marks just the corresponding term understood, while 9 still marks all three. Branch names, file names, paths, bare numbers, and PR (pull request) numbers no longer take up slots, and every hint actually appears in Claude's reply.

Two names for the same concept now count as one term. Once you mark "分支" or "branch" understood, neither appears as a new hint; once you mark "PR" or "Pull Request" understood, "PR" and "pull request" stop popping up too. Typing either form of those terms yourself counts as knowing it.

⟦Think of studying terms before like putting away a whole keyring with house numbers mixed in; now you can unclip and store each key on its own, and recognizing either the Chinese or English copy of the same key counts.⟧

items.original:
**Beginner Mode lets you mark terms one at a time and skips project names.** Press 4–6 to mark a single term understood; 9 still marks all three. Branch names, PR numbers, file names, paths and bare numbers no longer take the three hint slots, and every hint must appear in Claude's answer.
**Beginner Mode treats two names for one idea as one term.** Once you mark "分支（branch）" or "PR（Pull Request）" understood, "branch", "分支", "PR" and "pull request" stop appearing as new hints, and typing either name counts as knowing it.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式紀錄保存與提示比對更可靠
title.en: Beginner Mode Saves Progress and Matches Hints More Reliably

body.zh-TW:
多視窗存檔打架與解答斷句這類新手模式的小狀況，現在都有解了。

兩個對話同時存檔時，每次改動都在存檔前一刻重讀名詞紀錄，較不會弄丟「懂了」。紀錄讀不到時不再先請 Haiku 挑詞，5 小時額度的暫停改看該額度自己的讀取與重置時間。

白話解釋改請 Haiku 寫出完整短句，長度上限加倍到 80 個字元，不再被切成半句。之前存成半句的解釋，下次那個詞再出現時會換成完整版。

用一種寫法學會的詞，不論先遇到哪種寫法，換另一種都不會再回來。回答只有 `RAPID` 字樣時不再算出現 `API`，`PR #42`、Windows 路徑與 `fix/test` 分支名也不再佔位。Haiku 在清單前多寫一句話時，缺欄位的單一詞彙不再連累其他詞消失，每則回答讀名詞紀錄的次數也變少。

現在多視窗並行時，標記較不易漏存、解釋看得到整句，提示也只留回答真正用到的詞。
body.en:
Small Beginner Mode hiccups like competing window saves and cut-off explanations are now fixed.

When two conversations save at once, each change re-reads the term list right before saving so "understood" marks are less likely to be lost. When the list is unreadable, it no longer asks Haiku for terms first, and the 5-hour quota pause now follows that quota's own reading and reset times.

Plain-language explanations now ask Haiku for a complete short sentence, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters so they are no longer cut in half. Any explanation saved half-finished is replaced with the full version the next time that term appears.

A term learned under one spelling never comes back under the other, whichever you saw first. Replies containing only `RAPID` no longer count as showing `API`, and `PR #42`, Windows paths, and `fix/test` branch names no longer take up slots. When Haiku adds a line of preamble before the list, a single term with a missing field no longer causes the other terms to disappear, and each reply reads the term list fewer times.

Now when multiple windows run in parallel, marks are less likely to drop, explanations show full sentences, and hints keep only the terms the reply actually uses.

items.original:
**Beginner Mode loses fewer "understood" marks when two conversations save at once.** Each change now re-reads the term list right before saving. It also stops asking Haiku for terms while the term list is unreadable, and the 5-hour pause now follows that quota's own reading time and reset.
**Beginner Mode explanations are no longer cut off mid-sentence.** Haiku is asked for a complete short phrase, and the length limit doubles to 80 characters. An explanation saved half-finished is replaced the next time its term comes up.
**Beginner Mode hints only what the answer really uses.** A term learned under one name no longer comes back under its other name, whichever came first. `API` no longer counts as appearing just because the answer says `RAPID`. PR numbers like `PR #42`, Windows paths and branch names such as `fix/test` no longer take hint slots, and one malformed term after a line of preamble no longer drops the others. Each reply also reads the term list fewer times.

title.zh-TW: 刪除私有或內部儲存庫前會再確認 fork
title.en: Confirming forks again before deleting private or internal repositories

body.zh-TW:
清理不再維護的 GitHub 儲存庫，不少人習慣在 `gh repo delete` 後面補上 `--yes` 直接跳過確認。現在要刪的如果是私有或內部儲存庫，而且會一併刪掉底下的 fork（從原儲存庫另外複製出去的獨立副本），指令就會先跳出警告。這時你得再確認一次，就算已經加上 `--yes` 也一樣。

如果是沒有人手輸入的非互動式流程或代理程式，執行刪除就必須明確加上同意連帶刪除的參數：

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦就像管理員要關掉大樓的總電源，以前只要拿到授權單就直接斷電，現在發現線路還接著其他人的設備，就會先暫停並要求再確認，連自動排程也得另外寫明同意一併斷電。⟧
body.en:
When cleaning up unmaintained GitHub repositories, many people add `--yes` after `gh repo delete` to skip confirmation. Now, if the repository you are deleting is private or internal and will also delete its forks (independent copies made from the original repository), the command warns you first. You then have to confirm a second time, even if you already passed `--yes`.

For non-interactive workflows or agents without manual input, running the deletion requires explicitly adding the flag that accepts cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

⟦Picture a building manager shutting off the main power: previously, an authorization slip was enough to cut it right away, but now if the lines still feed other people's equipment, the process pauses for a second confirmation—and even automated schedules must separately state they agree to cut power to those as well.⟧

items.original:
## Protect private forks when deleting repositories

`gh repo delete` now warns when deleting a private or internal repository will also delete its forks. The additional confirmation is required even with `--yes`.

Non-interactive workflows and agents must explicitly accept the cascading deletion:

```shell
gh repo delete OWNER/REPO --yes --accept-cascading-deletion-of-private-forks
```

title.zh-TW: --attach 憑證檢查延後至上傳端點並由伺服器裁定 GitHub App 權限
title.en: Defer `--attach` Credential Checks to Upload Endpoint and Let Server Arbitrate GitHub App Permissions

body.zh-TW: 在自動化流程中使用 GitHub CLI 發布內容時，若想隨附測試日誌或建置成品，通常會使用 `--attach` 參數打包檔案。⟦就像去快遞站寄送特殊包裹，以前臨櫃店員只要在清單上找不到對應代號就當場拒收，現在門市先將包裹轉交後端物流中心，由總部依照權限統一核對資格。⟧過去命令列工具會在終端機本機端提前檢查身分，容易直接攔下自動化工具的上傳請求。現在 GitHub CLI 將 `--attach` 的憑證檢查延後到上傳端點處理。GitHub 伺服器端會直接裁定哪些 GitHub App 的安裝權杖（token，向伺服器驗證身分的授權令牌）具備附加檔案的權限。使用 GitHub App 執行排程任務時，能否附加檔案，改由 GitHub 伺服器裁定；`--attach` 的憑證檢查則延後到上傳端點處理。
body.en: When publishing content in automated workflows using GitHub CLI, if you want to include test logs or build artifacts, you typically use the `--attach` flag to bundle files. ⟦Picture sending a special package at a courier station: counter clerks previously rejected parcels on the spot whenever a matching code was missing from their list, but now the station forwards packages to the backend logistics center so headquarters can centrally verify eligibility based on permissions.⟧ Previously, the command-line tool checked credentials early on the local terminal side, easily blocking upload requests from automated tools outright. Now, GitHub CLI defers `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint. The GitHub server directly arbitrates which GitHub App installation tokens (authorization credentials used to verify identity with the server) have permission to attach files. When running scheduled tasks with a GitHub App, whether files can be attached is decided by the GitHub server; `--attach` credential checks are deferred to the upload endpoint.

items.original:
Allow server to arbitrate which GitHub App installation tokens can attach files by @martinajir in [#14804](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14804)
Defer `--attach` credential checks to the upload endpoint by @BagToad in [#14805](https://github.com/cli/cli/pull/14805)

title.zh-TW: `gh` 可改用會自動續期的登入憑證（預覽）
title.en: `gh` can sign in with auto-refreshing credentials (preview)

body.zh-TW:
一般用 `gh` 登入 GitHub，拿到的 token（證明你身分的授權令牌）發下來就不會過期。現在可以改選會過期的 OAuth 憑證：`gh` 會存一把短效的 access token，另配一把會輪替的 refresh token（專門用來換新令牌的憑證）。access token 需要時會自動換新，你不必重新登入。⟦公司門禁卡改成每天自動換發的臨時卡，以前一張卡用到離職，現在卡片天天換新，你照樣每天刷卡進門。⟧這是預覽功能，要自己選擇開啟。只想這一次登入用它，打：

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

想以後每次登入都優先用它，打：

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```
body.en:
Normally, signing in to GitHub with `gh` gives you a token (the pass that proves who you are) that never expires. You can now opt into expiring OAuth credentials instead: `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token (a credential used only to get a new pass). The access token is refreshed automatically whenever needed, so you stay signed in without authenticating again. ⟦An office swapped its permanent badges for temporary ones reissued every day: you used to keep one badge until you left the company, and now it renews daily while you still just tap in each morning.⟧ This is a preview you have to opt into. To use it for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

items.original:
## Expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens (preview)

`gh` can now sign in with expiring OAuth credentials that it refreshes automatically. When you opt in, `gh` stores a short-lived access token alongside a rotating refresh token and refreshes the access token whenever it is needed, so you stay signed in without having to authenticate again.

To opt in for a single sign-in, run:

```shell
gh auth login --expiring
```

To prefer expiring credentials for every sign-in, run:

```shell
gh config set expiring_credentials enabled
```

title.zh-TW: 用會過期的 `gh` 憑證時，查狀態、接 git 和寫腳本要注意的事
title.en: Living with expiring `gh` credentials: status, git and scripts

body.zh-TW: 開了自動續期後，想知道憑證還剩多久，就打 `gh auth status`：它會顯示憑證能不能續期、access token 何時到期。它和 `gh auth token` 都會在需要時自動續期。github.com 和 GHE.com 支援這種 token，其他主機會退回一般不過期的 token。git 走 HTTPS 的話，建議用 git 2.46 以上，並執行 `gh auth setup-git`，讓 `gh` 當 git 的 credential helper（替 git 提供登入資料的程式）。這樣 git 不會把憑證留到過期之後。⟦跟鮮奶一樣，以前能囤一箱慢慢喝，現在得隨喝隨買。⟧腳本和擴充別把 `gh auth token` 的輸出存起來，每次要用都重新執行它；透過 `GH_TOKEN` 或 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 給的 token 則永遠不會續期。
body.en: Once expiring credentials are on, you may want to know how long yours has left. `gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires, and both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` refresh the access token automatically when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token. If git talks to GitHub over HTTPS, the advice is to use git 2.46 or newer and run `gh auth setup-git` so `gh` acts as git's credential helper (the program that hands git its sign-in details). That way git does not cache the credential past its lifetime. ⟦Treat it like fresh milk: you could once stock up a crate and drink it slowly, and now you buy it as you need it.⟧ So scripts and extensions should not store the output of `gh auth token`; run it again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

items.original:
`gh auth status` shows whether a credential is refreshable and when the current access token expires. Both `gh auth status` and `gh auth token` automatically refresh the access token when needed. Expiring tokens are available on github.com and GHE.com; on hosts that do not issue them, `gh` falls back to a regular non-expiring token.

If you use HTTPS as your git protocol, we advise using git 2.46 or newer and letting `gh` act as your git credential helper by running `gh auth setup-git`. This way `gh` serves and refreshes the expiring credential for git, and git does not cache it past its lifetime.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Expiring access tokens should not be cached. Scripts and extensions that store the output of `gh auth token` will eventually hold an expired token, so run `gh auth token` again each time a token is needed. Tokens supplied through `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_TOKEN` are never refreshed.

For more information, see [Authenticating with GitHub CLI](https://docs.github.com/github-cli/github-cli/authenticating-with-github-cli#using-expiring-refreshable-tokens).

title.zh-TW: 新指令 `gh issue artifact`，在終端機管理 issue 的附件文件（私人預覽）
title.en: New `gh issue artifact` manages issue artifacts from the terminal (private preview)

body.zh-TW:
規劃一個新功能時，你可能想把規劃書、流程圖或網頁原型直接掛在 GitHub issue（記錄待辦與問題的討論串）上。`gh issue artifact` 把 issue artifacts 帶到命令列，提供 `list`、`view`、`create`、`edit`、`download`、`delete` 六個指令，例如：

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

⟦替每張工單配一個專屬資料夾，規劃書和原型都收在裡面，還記得每一版，想退回第 5 版也行。⟧artifacts 也能用 GitHub 網址指定，Markdown 文件可以用 `--attach` 附上圖片和影片。這是私人預覽，只有加入預覽的使用者和組織能用，而且只對加入預覽的儲存庫有效；申請方式在官方的預覽公告討論串。
body.en:
When planning a new feature, you may want to hang the plan, a flow chart or a web prototype right on a GitHub issue (the thread that tracks a task or problem). `gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line with six commands, `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download` and `delete`, for example:

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

⟦Give every work ticket its own folder that holds the plan and the prototype and remembers every version, so rolling back to version 5 is easy.⟧ Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents take image and video attachments with `--attach`. This is a private preview: only users and organizations enrolled can use it, and the commands work only for repositories in the preview; access instructions are in the official preview announcement discussion.

items.original:
## Manage issue artifacts with `gh issue artifact` (private preview)

`gh issue artifact` brings issue artifacts to the command line. Users and organizations enrolled in the private preview can use the `list`, `view`, `create`, `edit`, `download`, and `delete` commands to manage issue artifacts.

```shell
# Create a Markdown document with an attached image
gh issue artifact create 142 signin-plan.md --attach ./signin-flow.png

# Create an HTML document
gh issue artifact create 142 menu-prototype.html

# List or view artifacts
gh issue artifact list 142
gh issue artifact view 142 2

# Update a document or restore an earlier version
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --body-file signin-plan-v2.md
gh issue artifact edit 142 2 --restore-version 5
```

Artifacts can also be addressed by their GitHub URLs, and Markdown documents support image and video attachments with `--attach`.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Issue artifacts are in private preview. These commands only work for repositories enrolled in the preview. See the [Issue Artifacts private preview announcement and feedback discussion](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/205881) for access instructions and to share feedback.
